action.name: Psychic Bolt
entries: rs 8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) psychic damage.

action.name: Mind Ravage (Recarga 5)
entries: The catonoctrix unleashes a torrent of psychic energy. Each creature within 20 feet of the catonoctrix must make a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 (10d8) psychic damage and is stunned for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't stunned. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reaction.name: Precognitive Dodge
entries: The catonoctrix adds 4 to its AC against one attack that would hit it. To do so, the catonoctrix must see the attacker and be within 30 feet of it.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The catonoctrix casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

trait.name: Feline Terror
entries: Each creature in the swarm must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or fall prone and become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the swarm's Feline Terror for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Keen Senses
entries: The swarm has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, hearing, or smell.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny cat. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

action.name: Bites
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 0 ft., up to two creatures in the swarm's space. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage, or 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The catscratch has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Nine Lives (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When the catscratch would be reduced to 0 hp, it instead drops to 9 hp.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the catscratch moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the catscratch can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The catscratch makes one bite attack and one claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. A felid or feline humanoid that fails this saving throw contracts Catscratch Fugue.

action.name: Claws
entries: mw +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Vomit (Recarga 5)
entries: The catscratch vomits poisonous bile in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A felid or feline humanoid that fails this saving throw contracts Catscratch Fugue.

trait.name: Rubbery Flesh
entries: The catterball is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form, and it has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple. In addition, it can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Standing Leap (Ball Form Only)
entries: The catterball's long jump is up to 60 feet and its high jump is up to 30 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Snap Back (Extended Form Only)
entries: The catterball violently returns to its true form. Each creature within 5 feet of the catterball must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 4 (1d8) thunder damage, or 9 (2d8) if the catterball has extended its reach to 15 feet, and is deafened for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't deafened. A deafened creature can make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Change Form
entries: The catterball can extend its body, roll up into a ball, or return to its true form. Each time it extends its body, its reach with its slam attack increases by 5 feet, to a maximum of 15 feet, and its Armor Class decreases by 1.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: A cauchemange larva has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage. If the cauchemange larva scores a critical hit against a creature not infected by another cauchemange larva, the larva burrows into the target. Once inside a target, the larva is a disease. For seven days, each time the host finishes a long rest, the host must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw.

On a failure, the host gains no benefit from that rest. After seven days, the cauchemange erupts from its host's body as an adult cauchemange that is either corporeal or incorporeal. This exit deals the host 20 (4d8 + 2) slashing damage.

name: Cauchemar
languages: understands Abyssal, Common, and Infernal but can't speak

trait.name: Aura of Dread
entries: A creature hostile to the cauchemar that starts its turn within 20 feet of the cauchemar must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw, unless the cauchemar is incapacitated. On a failed save, the target is frightened until the start of its next turn.

While frightened in this way, the target can't perform any actions except move up to half its speed. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the cauchemar's Aura of Dread for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Confer Fire Resistance
entries: The cauchemar can grant resistance to fire damage to anyone riding it.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The cauchemar sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cauchemar makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its hooves.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

action.name: Ethereal Stride
entries: The cauchemar and up to three willing creatures within 5 feet of it magically enter the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

action.name: Sulfur Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: The cauchemar exhales nauseating sulfurous smoke in a 15-foot cone. The smoke spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 14 (4d6) fire damage and spends its action on each of its turns retching and reeling for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Creatures that don't need to breathe or are immune to fire automatically succeed on this saving throw. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and does not suffer any other effects.

trait.name: Consumption
entries: As a bonus action, a cauldronborn can consume one potion within 5 feet of it that is not being worn or carried. Along with the potion's effect, the cauldronborn's hp maximum increases by 3 (1d6) and it gains the same number of hp.

trait.name: Detect Elixir
entries: The cauldronborn can pinpoint the location of potions and magic items within 60 feet of it. Outside of 60 feet, it can sense the general direction of potions within 1 mile of it.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The cauldronborn regains 2 hp at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp.

trait.name: Sprint
entries: The cauldronborn triples its speed until the end of its turn when moving toward a potion it has detected.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cauldronborn makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Call Potion (Recarga 5)
entries: The cauldronborn releases a hungry screech, magically reaching out to nearby potions. All potions within 10 feet of the cauldronborn magically move toward the cauldronborn by rolling out of backpacks, hopping off of belts, unburying themselves, etc. A creature wearing or carrying a potion must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or its potion moves to within 5 feet of the cauldronborn. The target must make a separate saving throw for each potion it is attempting to keep in its possession.

trait.name: Straddler
entries: The caustic charger can end its move in the space of a prone Large or smaller creature. A creature standing up from prone in the same space as the charger can move to a space within 5 feet of the charger as part of standing up.

trait.name: Wastes Walk
entries: Difficult terrain composed of rocks or sand doesn't cost the caustic charger extra movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The caustic charger makes two Ram attacks. It can replace one Ram attack with a Tentacles attack.

action.name: Ram
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the charger moved at least 10 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target has disadvantage on the saving throw.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The paralyzed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the caustic charger attacks a target that is not in the charger's space, the target takes half the acid damage and has advantage on the saving throw.

bonus.name: Slurp
entries: The caustic charger feeds on a creature paralyzed by its Tentacles attack. The target must succeed on a CD 15 Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by half the amount of acid damage dealt by the Tentacles attack that caused the paralysis, and the charger regains hp equal to that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

action.name: Bite
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape CD 13). Until this grapple ends, the ankheg can bite only the grappled creature and has advantage on attack rolls to do so.

action.name: Acid Spray (Recarga 6)
entries: The ankheg spits acid in a line that is 30 feet long and 5 feet wide, provided that it has no creature grappled. Each creature in that line must make a CD 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Cauthooj
languages: understands Sylvan but can't speak any language

trait.name: Staccato Strike
entries: As a bonus action, the cauthooj uses subtle alterations in the pitch and tone of its song to direct one creature confused by its Warbling Song to make an attack against a target the cauthooj chooses. If no target is in reach or range, or the creature is unable to attack for any other reason, this ability has no effect.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cauthooj uses its Warbling Song, then makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Beak
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Warbling Song
entries: The cauthooj gives a strange, ululating cry that causes nearby creatures to lash out violently and without control. Each creature within 120 feet that can hear the cauthooj must succeed on a DC 16 saving throw or be confused (as per the confusion spell) until the end of the cauthooj's next turn.

reaction.name: Hop-Dodge
entries: When the cauthooj is the target of a melee attack and is adjacent to another enemy that is also within the reach of the melee attack, the cauthooj nimbly hops aside, redirecting the attack against the adjacent enemy. The cauthooj then moves up to half its speed, not provoking opportunity attack.

trait.name: Bravery
entries: The cavalier has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

trait.name: Light's Fury
entries: The cavalier deals an extra 9 (2d8) radiant damage when it hits with a weapon attack.

trait.name: Skilled Rider
entries: While mounted, the cavalier may force an attack targeted at their mount to target them instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cavalier makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Lance
entries: mw 7 to hit (with disadvantage against a target within 5 ft.), reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: mw,rw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cavalier is an 8th-level spellcaster that uses Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13; 5 to hit with spell attacks). They have the following paladin spells prepared:

trait.name: Action Surge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The cavalier can take one additional action on top of its regular action and possible bonus action.

trait.name: Threatening
entries: Creatures provoke an opportunity attack from the cavalier when they move 5 feet or more while within the cavalier's reach, and if the cavalier hits a creature with an opportunity attack, the target's speed is reduced to 0 until the end of the current turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cavalier makes two Longsword attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: mw +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, and the target is marked until the end of the cavalier's next turn. This effect ends early if the cavalier is incapacitated or it dies, or if someone else marks the target. While it is within 5 feet of the cavalier, a creature marked by the cavalier has disadvantage on any attack roll that doesn't target the cavalier.

reaction.name: Warding Maneuver (3/Day)
entries: If the cavalier or a creature it can see within 5 feet of it is hit by an attack, it can roll a d8 and add it to the target's AC against that attack. If the attack still hits, the target has resistance against the attack's damage.

bonus.name: Punish the Marked
entries: The cavalier can make a melee weapon attack against a creature marked by it if the creature dealt damage to anyone other than the cavalier during the last turn. The cavalier's melee weapon attack has advantage on the attack roll, and if it hits, the attack's weapon deals an extra 5 damage to the target.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The badger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: When the badger burrows, it leaves tunnels behind.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The badger makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. If both claw attacks hit a Large or smaller creature, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) slashing damage.

trait.name: Chirp
entries: Creatures within 20 feet of a chirping cave cricket can't be heard unless they scream. Spellcasters in the area must make a successful DC 9 Constitution saving throw to cast a spell correctly. Failure indicates the spell is not cast, but the slot is not expended. The chirping doubles the chance of attracting wandering monsters, if applicable.

action.name: Kick
entries: m +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Darkness Shroud
entries: The cave dragon naturally suppresses light near it. Bright light within 15 feet of the dragon becomes dim light, and dim light within 15 feet becomes nonmagical darkness.

trait.name: Magical Tunneler
entries: The cave dragon can burrow through nonmagical unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the dragon can choose whether to leave the material it moves through undisturbed or leave a 5-foot diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

action.name: Poison Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: The dragon exhales a cone of black, poisonous gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and is poisoned until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: In the first round of combat, the cave drake has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The cave drake has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The cave drake can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The cave drake has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cave drake makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Blinding Spit (Recarga 5)
entries: rw +4 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: The target is poisoned for 1 minute and must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be blinded while poisoned in this way.

trait.name: Concealed Burrow
entries: Cave eels conceal their burrows skillfully, so they have tactical advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to be hidden at the beginning of an encounter. An attacking cave eel lunges from its cave, bites a victim within 5 feet, and then withdraws back into its burrow without triggering an opportunity attack. While in a burrow, a cave eel has threequarters cover (+5 bonus to AC and Dex saving throws). The only way to negate this benefit is for a character to ready an action and attack the cave eel with a reaction as it extends its body to strike.

trait.name: Viselike Jaws
entries: When a cave eel withdraws back into its burrow with a grappled character in its jaws, that character's body effectively becomes a shield protecting the eel, giving it total cover inside its burrow (it has only three-quarters cover against the character it grapples). While the eel has a character grappled this way, it doesn't need to extend from its burrow to attack the grappled character, who it bites automatically.

action.name: Bite
entries: m +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage and the target is grappled and restrained (see Viselike Jaws, above).

trait.name: Flammable Blood
entries: If the cave fisher drops to half its hit points or fewer, it gains vulnerability to fire damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The cave fisher can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cave fisher makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Retract Filament
entries: One Large or smaller creature grappled by the cave fisher's Adhesive Filament must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the cave fisher, and the cave fisher makes one Claw attack against it. Anyone else who was attached to the filament is released. Until the grapple ends on the target, the cave fisher can't use Adhesive Filament.

bonus.name: Adhesive Filament
entries: The cave fisher extends a sticky filament up to 60 feet, and the filament adheres to anything that touches it. A creature the filament adheres to is grappled by the cave fisher (escape CD 13), and ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage. The filament can be attacked (AC 15; 5 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). A weapon that fails to sever it becomes stuck to it, requiring an action and a successful CD 13 Strength check to pull free. Destroying the filament deals no damage to the cave fisher. The filament crumbles away if the cave fisher takes this bonus action again.

trait.name: Adhesive Filament
entries: The cave fisher can use its action to extend a sticky filament up to 60 feet, and the filament adheres to anything that touches it. A creature adhered to the filament is grappled by the cave fisher (escape DC 13), and ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage. The filament can be attacked (AC 15; 5 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage), but a weapon that fails to sever it becomes stuck to it, requiring an action and a successful DC 13 Strength check to pull free. Destroying the filament causes no damage to the cave fisher, which can extrude a replacement filament on its next turn

trait.name: Flammable Blood
entries: If the cave fisher drops to half its hit points or fewer, it gains vulnerability to fire damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The cave fisher can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cave fisher makes two attacks with its claws.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Filament
entries: One creature grappled by the cave fisher's adhesive filament must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw, provided that the target weighs 200 pounds or less. On a failure, the target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the cave fisher, and the cave fisher makes a claw attack against it as a bonus action. Reeling up the target releases anyone else who was attached to the filament. Until the grapple ends on the target, the cave fisher can't extrude another filament.

trait.name: Filament
entries: A creature struck by a cave fisher's filament becomes grappled by the sticky thread and is pulled 20 feet closer to the cave fisher. A grappled creature can use its action to rip the filament free with a DC 13 Strength check, or can attack the filament directly (AC 12, 5 hp, resistant to all but slashing damage). Alcohol or universal solvent dissolves the adhesive and releases the creature caught by the filament. A cave fisher can have only one creature grappled at a time.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cave fisher attacks once with its filament or twice with claws.

action.name: Claw
entries: m +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Filament
entries: r +3 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: the target is grappled and pulled 20 feet closer to the cave fisher (see below).

trait.name: Sunlight Petrification
entries: If the giant starts its turn in sunlight, it takes 20 radiant damage. While in sunlight, it moves at half speed and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. If the giant is reduced to 0 hp while in sunlight, it is petrified.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes three attacks. two with its handaxe and one with its tusks.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) slashing damage.

action.name: Tusks
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Rock
entries: rw 12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Sunlight Petrification
entries: If the cave giant shaman starts its turn in sunlight, it takes 20 radiant damage. While in sunlight, it moves at half speed and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. If the giant is reduced to 0 hp while in sunlight, it is petrified.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cave giant shaman makes two attacks: one with its club and one with its tusks.

action.name: Club
entries: mw +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d4 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tusks
entries: mw +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Rock
entries: rw +13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one creature. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cave giant shaman is a 14th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (save DC 18, 10 to hit with spell attacks). The shaman has the following wizard spells prepared:

entries: The cave goat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

trait.name: Sturdy Climber
entries: The cave goat has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb rocky surfaces.

action.name: Ram
entries: mw +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

name: Cave Goblin
sourceGroup: Ultimate Bestiary: Revenge of the Horde

trait.name: Cavern Camouflage
entries: The cave goblin has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while underground in caves and caverns.

trait.name: Cavern Stalker
entries: The cave goblin can attempt to hide even when only lightly obscured by dim light.

trait.name: Hive Mind
entries: The cave goblin gains a +1 bonus to its Intelligence and Wisdom modifiers for each cave goblin within 40 ft. of it, up to a maximum of +5.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: The cave goblin has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight if it, the target of its attack, or what it is trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the cave goblin surprises a creature and hits it with a weapon attack during the first round of combat, the weapon deals an additional die of damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: mw,rw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: rw +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Cave Goblin Brute
sourceGroup: Ultimate Bestiary: Revenge of the Horde

trait.name: Cavern Camouflage
entries: The cave goblin brute has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while underground in caves and caverns.

trait.name: Cavern Stalker
entries: The cave goblin brute can attempt to hide even when only lightly obscured by dim light.

trait.name: Hive Mind
entries: The cave goblin brute gains a +1 bonus to its Intelligence and Wisdom modifiers for each cave goblin within 40 ft. of it, up to a maximum of +5.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: The cave goblin brute has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight if it, the target of its attack, or what it is trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the cave goblin brute surprises a creature and hits it with a weapon attack during the first round of combat, the weapon deals an additional die of damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cave goblin brute makes two jawbone club attacks.

action.name: Jawbone Club
entries: mw +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

name: Cave Goblin King
sourceGroup: Ultimate Bestiary: Revenge of the Horde

trait.name: Cavern Camouflage
entries: The cave goblin king has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while underground in caves and caverns.

trait.name: Cavern Stalker
entries: The cave goblin king can attempt to hide even when only lightly obscured by dim light.

trait.name: Commander
entries: All cave goblins within 120 feet of the cave goblin king who can see and hear it, can make an extra weapon attack with disadvantage as a bonus action. If within 20 feet of the cave goblin king, the attack does not suffer disadvantage.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: The cave goblin king has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight if it, the target of its attack, or what it is trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

action.name: Club
entries: mw +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Divert Attack
entries: When a creature the cave goblin king can see targets it with an attack, the cave goblin king chooses another goblin within 5 feet of it. The two goblins swap places, and the chosen goblin becomes the target instead.

name: Cave Goblin Runt
sourceGroup: Ultimate Bestiary: Revenge of the Horde

trait.name: Cavern Camouflage
entries: The cave goblin runt has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while underground in caves and caverns.

trait.name: Cavern Stalker

trait.name: Hive Mind
entries: The cave goblin runt gains a +1 bonus to its Intelligence and Wisdom modifiers for each cave goblin within 40 ft. of it, up to a maximum of +5.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: The cave goblin runt has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight if it, the target of its attack, or what it is trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the cave goblin runt surprises a creature and hits it with a weapon attack during the first round of combat, the weapon deals an additional die of damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: mw,rw +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Blood Drain
entries: Immediately after making a constriction attack against a grappled creature, the cave leech can try to drag that creature to its mouth, where it bites the creature automatically and drains its blood, inflicting 4 (1d8) piercing damage. The target can resist being dragged with a Strength contest against the cave leech; the cave leech must win the contest to drag the character to its mouth. A character who wins this contest does not break the cave leech's grapple. The cave leech can try a Strength contest against every creature it makes a constriction attack against until it wins a Strength contest and drains one creature's blood. It can drain blood from the same creature or a different creature each round, but it must win a Strength contest each time.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cave leech attacks eight times, in any combination of tentacle attacks and constriction attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: m +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled and restrained.

action.name: Constriction
entries: m automatic hit, one creature grappled by a tentacle. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target can be dragged to the cave leech's mouth to be drained of blood (see above).

trait.name: Adhesive (Object or Terrain Form Only)
entries: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A creature adhered to the cave mimic is also grappled by it (escape DC 15). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage. It can choose for a creature to not be affected by this trait.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object or Terrain Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object or terrain feature.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

trait.name: Object Mimicry (Object or Terrain Form Only)
entries: The mimic can shape minor pseudopods into Medium or smaller objects. A creature that sees such an object can tell it is an imitation with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check. A creature with at least half its body in contact with the object, such as sitting on an imitation chair, is subjected to the mimic's Adhesive trait.

trait.name: Stretched Form (Terrain Form Only)
entries: The mimic can occupy another creature's space and vice versa.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The cave mimic can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 15-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cave mimic makes four Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the cave mimic is in object or terrain form, the target is subjected to the mimic's Adhesive trait.

action.name: Stalagteeth (Terrain Form Only) (Recarga 4)
entries: The cave mimic launches a harpoon-like pseudopod, shaped like a stalactite or other similarly pointed object, at one creature in its space. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 24 (7d6) piercing damage and have the harpoon pseudopod stuck in it. While the pseudopod is stuck, the target is restrained and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns, and the mimic can use a bonus action to pull the target up to 30 feet toward the mimic's nearest wall, ceiling, or similar surface. A creature, including the target, can take its action to detach the harpoon pseudopod by succeeding on a DC 15 Strength check. If the target detaches the harpoon while it is stuck to the ceiling of the mimic, the target takes falling damage as normal.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The cave mimic transforms into a Gargantuan object or stretches itself out as terrain no larger than a 35-foot cube or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

name: Cave Sovereign
languages: understands all but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.

trait.name: Deathlights
entries: When a creature that can see the cave sovereign's glowing antennae starts its turn within 30 feet of the cave sovereign, the cave sovereign can force it to make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw if the cave sovereign isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is stunned until the start of its next turn. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save is incapacitated and its speed is reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn as it remains transfixed in place by the lights.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the cave sovereign until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the cave sovereign in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The cave sovereign's antennae shed dim light in a 5-foot radius. This radius increases to 20 feet while at least one creature is incapacitated or stunned by Deathlights. At the start of its turn if no creatures are incapacitated or stunned by Deathlights, the cave sovereign can suppress this light until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: The cave sovereign is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the cave sovereign's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the cave sovereign fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The cave sovereign has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Sinuous Form
entries: Provided there is suitable room to accommodate its bulk, the cave sovereign can squeeze through any opening large enough for a Small creature.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The cave sovereign can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cave sovereign makes one Bite attack and two Slam attacks. It can make one Tail attack in place of its Bite attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) poison damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the cave sovereign can't use its tail on another target.

action.name: Consume Soul (Recarga 5)
entries: The cave sovereign chooses up to three creatures it can see within 60 feet of it that are incapacitated or stunned by Deathlights. Each target must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature stunned by Deathlights has disadvantage on this saving throw. The cave sovereign then regains hit points equal to half the total psychic damage dealt.

A Humanoid slain by this attack rises 1d4 rounds later as a zombie under the cave sovereign's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The cave sovereign can have no more than thirty zombies under its control at one time.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The cave sovereign moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attack.

legendary.name: Telekinetic Reel
entries: The cave sovereign magically pulls a creature it can see that is incapacitated or stunned by its Deathlights up to 20 feet straight toward it.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The cave sovereign uses Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Tail Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The cave sovereign makes one Tail attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, or radiant damage from sunlight, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The troll takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. If a troll dies from sunlight, its corpse turns into stone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. If both claw attacks hit the same creature, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) slashing damage and must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Claw

trait.name: Rocky Camouflage

reaction.name: Rock Hide
entries: When the cave troll is hit with a weapon attack, it momentarily hardens its skin, gaining resistance to non-magical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from that attack.

name: Cavefish Zombie
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the cavefish zombie must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the zombie's Stench for 24 hours.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the cavefish zombie to 0 hp, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hp instead.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Variable Illumination
entries: The cavelight moss sheds bright light in a 5- to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The moss can alter the radius as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cavelight moss makes two Tendrils attacks. If both attacks hit a Large or smaller creature, the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and at the start of each of the target's turns, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion. The cavelight moss then gains 5 temporary hp. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw can't suffer further levels of exhaustion from the cavelight moss's grapple for the next 24 hours. The cavelight moss can have only one creature grappled at a time.

action.name: Tendrils
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The cavern troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The cavern troll regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. If it takes acid or thunder damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the two-headed troll's next turn. The cavern troll dies only if it starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Sunlight Petrification
entries: A cavern troll exposed to natural sunlight can move or take an action, but not both, nor can it take bonus actions. The troll must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw and the end of each of its rounds, turning to stone on a failed save. A greater restoration spell (or similar effect) restores a petrified cavern troll. Spells like sunburst and other effects that create powerful natural sunlight do not petrify the cavern troll, though it does become stunned until the end of its next turn after being exposed to such an effect.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cavern troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Claws

action.name: Dagger

action.name: Hydropump (Recarga 5)
entries: The ceadeus releases a high pressure stream of water in an 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 72 (16d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage and not on a successful one.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The ceadeus makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The ceadeus makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Torpedo (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The ceadeus swims up to its swim speed, during this move it may swim through other creatures without provoking attacks of opportunity. Any creatures the ceadeus moves through must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (4d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The ceanataur can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Scuttle
entries: As a bonus action, the ceanataur can moves up to its half speed in a straight line.

action.name: Claws
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead or a construct, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or lose 2 (1d4) hit points at the start of each of its turns due to an bloody wound. Each time the ceanataur hits the wounded target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound increases by 2 (1d4). Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.

action.name: Poison Spit
entries: rw 4 to hit, reach 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (2d4) poison damage. On a hit, the target must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until cured. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Octopodan Camouflage
entries: Ceemal can attempt to hide even when they are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, or other natural phenomena.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ceemal makes two Fillet Knife or two Acid Spit attacks.

action.name: Fillet Knife
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, another Abomination within 5 feet of the target regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

action.name: Acid Spit
entries: rw 6 to hit, range 20/40 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) acid damage, and the target is poisoned until the start of Ceemal's next turn.

reaction.name: Wail of Loss
entries: When another Abomination who Ceemal can see is reduced to 0 hit points by an enemy within 60 feet of Ceemal, Ceemal releases a psychic wail. The enemy must make a CD 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: To Me, Sweetie (3/Day)
entries: Ceemal chooses an ally within 30 feet of them who can hear them. The ally can use their reaction to move up to their speed toward Ceemal without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The ghost can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The ghost enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

action.name: Horrifying Visage
entries: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the ghost that can see it must succeed on a CD 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

action.name: Possession (Recarga 6)
entries: One humanoid that the ghost can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a CD 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the ghost; the ghost then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The ghost can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the ghost ends it as a bonus action, or the ghost is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the ghost reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

entries: The centaur mummy targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the mummy, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all mummies (but not mummy lords) for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Charge
entries: Once per turn, if the centaur scout moves at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee spear attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The centaur scout makes two attacks: one with its spear and one with its hooves.

action.name: Spear
entries: mw,rw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Hooves
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the centaur moves at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a pike attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The centaur makes two attacks: one with its sickle and one with its hooves or two with its longbow.

action.name: Sickle
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: rw 6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The centaur is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, 6 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the centaur moves at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a pike attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) piercing damage.

trait.name: Lightfooted
entries: The centaur can take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

trait.name: Skirmish Advantage
entries: The centaur gains advantage on its first attack roll this turn if it has moved at least 15 feet from its space at the beginning of its turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The centaur makes two attacks: one with its pike and one with its hooves or two with its longbow.

action.name: Pike
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: rw 6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Skirmisher
entries: When an enemy the centaur can see ends its turn within 5 feet of it, the centaur can move up to half its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The centaur makes two attacks, using Pike or Longbow in any combination.

action.name: Pike
entries: m 6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: r 4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Trampling Charge (Recarga 5)
entries: The centaur moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space the centaur enters is targeted once by the following effect. Salvación (str): CD 14. Fallo: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The centaur makes two attacks, using Forest Staff or Sun Ray in any combination.

action.name: Forest Staff
entries: m 7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

action.name: Sun Ray
entries: r 7, range 90 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the centaur's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The centaur casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

bonus.name: Entangling Trail (Recarga 5)
entries: The centaur moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack. Each creature within 5 feet of the centaur as it moves is targeted once by the following effect. Salvación (str): CD 15. Fallo: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Centipede Poison
entries: The first time a character takes damage from a centipede nest, the character must make a successful DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the character is immune to the poison from that swarm. On a failed save, the character becomes paralyzed. A paralyzed character repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns; on a successful save, the paralysis ends and the character becomes poisoned instead. The character remains poisoned for 5 minutes.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarming nest can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. The swarm can move through an opening large enough for an individual Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points. Once a character takes damage from a centipede nest, the centipedes are on him or her, and the character continues taking 1 piercing damage every round at the start of the centipede nest's turn, even if the character moves away from the swarm. This continues until three actions have been spent smashing, sweeping, and plucking off all the centipedes that crawled onto the character.

action.name: Bite
entries: m automatic hit, reach 0 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target might suffer the effect of Centipede Poison; see above.

name: CEO Viktra Mordenheim
languages: Common, Draconic, Dwarvish, Elvish, Goblin, Halfling

trait.name: Bolster Inventions
entries: At the end of each of Viktra's turns, each of her Construct allies in a 5-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from Viktra gains 5 Temporary Hit Points. This trait doesn't function if Viktra has the Incapacitated condition.

trait.name: Darklord Restoration
entries: If Viktra dies, she revives with all her Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Mordenheim Kinetics.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Domain)
entries: If Viktra fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Viktra makes two Lightning Rod attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Syringe.

action.name: Lightning Rod
entries: m,r 6, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Lightning damage, and the target can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Syringe
entries: Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 16, one creature Viktra can see within 5 feet. Fallo: The target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. While Poisoned in this way, the target suffers one of the following effects (Viktra's choice). The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The target succeeds automatically after 1 minute:

entries.name: Corrosive Serum
entries: The target takes 10 (4d4) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns, and its Speed decreases by 10 feet.

entries.name: Deadly Serum
entries: The target takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns, and it can't regain Hit Points.

entries.name: Mind-Altering Serum
entries: The target takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage at the start of each of its turns, and it has Disadvantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration.

legendary.name: Shocking Prod
entries: Viktra moves up to half her Speed and makes one Lightning Rod attack. Viktra can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

legendary.name: Static Explosion
entries: Salvación de Destreza (Dexterity): DC 16, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere [Area of Effect] centered on a point Viktra can see within 90 feet. Fallo: 5 (2d4) Lightning damage. Éxito: Half damage.

spellcasting.name: Activate Constructs (1/Day)
headerEntries: Viktra casts Animate Objects, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

trait.name: Sensitive Ears
entries: While underground the cephadrome ears are very sensitive, Thunder skills or spells used within 60 feet force the cephadrome to use its reaction to move towards the surface. If it reaches the surface while still having movement left, it launches into the air and lands prone on the ground.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The cephadrome has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cephadrome makes two attacks, one hipcheck attack and one tail attack or two sand blast attacks.

action.name: Hipcheck
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Sand Blast
entries: rw 8 to hit, reach 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: Cephal has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces Cephal Lorentus to 0 hit points, he must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5+the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, he drops to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Dagger
entries: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller living creature that is incapacitated or restrained, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take an additional 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage as Cephal attempts to consume the victim's brain. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, or it is already at 0 hit points, it dies.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Cephal Lorentus is a 7th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, 6 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Sensitive Ears

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The Cephalos has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

action.name: Hipcheck
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tail

action.name: Sand Blast
entries: rw 6 to hit, reach 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Ceratops
sourceGroup: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ceratops has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ceratops makes one Gore attack and one Stomp attack.

action.name: Gore
entries: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) piercing damage. If the ceratops moved at least 20 feet in a straight line toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 11 (2d10) piercing damage; if the target is a creature, it also must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 20 feet from the ceratops and have the prone condition.

action.name: Stomp
entries: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the triceratops moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a CD 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the triceratops can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Gore
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 24 (4d8 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Impacto: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

name: Cerbero
languages: understands Infernal, Primordial but can't speak

trait.name: Fury
entries: When Cerbero drops a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, it can take a bonus action to move up to its speed and make one bite attack.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The cerbero has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Three Heads
entries: Cerbero can't be surprised and has advantage
on Wisdom (Perception) tests and on saving
throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened,
frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: Because of its three heads, Cerbero gets two extra reactions that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Sleepy
entries: Cerbero is particularly vulnerable to any effects

that may put it to sleep, and it has disadvantage on any saving throw against such effects. In addition, if Cerbero is targeted by the sleep spell, its current hit points are halved to determine how many hit points the spell can affect.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Cerbero makes three bite attacks and two claws attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw (Rakshasa)
entries: mw +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8+ 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Bark (Recarga 5)
entries: Cerbero's barking is deafening. Any creature that can hear it within 60 feet of it must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 31 (7d8) thunder damage and is deafened. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't deafened. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: Movement
entries: Cerbero moves up to its speed.

legendary.name: Bite
entries: Cerbero makes a bite attack.

legendary.name: Raging Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Cerbero makes a claws attack against any creature within 10 feet of it.

legendary.name: Bark (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Cerbero recharges its Bark and uses it.

legendaryHeader: Cerbero can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Cerbero regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

name: Cerebral Stalker
languages: Believed to understand Common and possibly others, but never speaks

trait.name: Cocoon (3/Day)
entries: As an action, a cerebral stalker can cocoon a grappled foe with sticky webbing. The webs completely encase the victim, excluding the top of the victim's head, its eyes, and its nose. The cocooned victim is restrained and anchored by the webs to the cerebral stalker's body. The cocooned creature can, as an action, attempt to break free with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check or Dexterity (Acrobatics) saving throw. The webbing can be cut open enough for a trapped character to escape with 8 points of slashing damage against AC 10.

trait.name: Consume Brain
entries: Once it has its victim underground, the cerebral stalker begins gnawing on the victim's head, rapidly chewing through bone and tissue, dealing 13 (2d8 + 4) points of piercing damage each round. When the victim dies, the cerebral stalker reaches its goal: the victim's brain, which it promptly devours. A victim slain in this manner reanimates in 1d4 rounds as a zombie. Typically, the cerebral stalker "tosses" them back up to the surface of the ground so their traveling companions can witness the reanimation and deal with their newly undead friend. Zombies created in this manner are under no one's control.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: A cerebral stalker can glide through any sort of natural earth or stone as easily as a fish swims through water. Its gliding leaves no sign of its passage or hint of its presence to creatures that don't possess tremorsense. It can bring cocooned victims along with it, but they have no special capacity for breathing while underground. Getting into the ground, however, is not as easy for the cerebral stalker as moving underground. It must spend four moves on four rounds (no dashing) melding into the ground. On the first round, the creature sinks to its knees; on the second round, to its waist; on the third round, to its neck; and on the fourth round, the stalker and any creature it has cocooned disappear completely underground. Melding into the ground does not provoke an opportunity attack. If the cerebral stalker is grappled while sinking into the ground, it must win a Str contest against its grapplers to sink farther that round. Dispel magic or a similar spell cast on a sinking cerebral stalker paralyzes it the same as a hold monster spell. The spot where the cerebral stalker sank radiates magic for one hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cerebral stalker bites once and attacks twice with claws, or it uses its fear gaze or cocoon ability.

action.name: Bite
entries: m +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: m +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage and the target is grappled and restrained.

action.name: Fear Gaze
entries: r automatic hit, range 30 ft., one creature that can see the cerebral stalker. Hit: Target must make a successful DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1d4 rounds.

name: Cerebrograft
languages: telepathy 30 ft. The languages of its creator

trait.name: Dual Minds
entries: The cerebrograft has Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and Unconscious conditions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cerebrograft makes two Slam attacks and uses Telekinetic Grip.

action.name: Slam
entries: m 9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Telekinetic Grip
entries: The cerebrograft reaches out with its mind to hold one creature or object it can see within 120 feet of it in its psychic grasp. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Salvación de Fuerza (Strength): DC 16. Fallo: The target is moved up to 30 feet in any direction and has the Restrained condition until the start of the cerebrograft's next turn or until the cerebrograft has the Incapacitated condition.

If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is telekinetically moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The cerebrograft can also exert fine control on objects with its telekinesis, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

action.name: Psychic Crush (Recarga 5)
entries: Salvación de Inteligencia (Intelligence): DC 16, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the cerebrograft. Fallo: 22 (4d10) Psychic damage, and the target has the Dazed condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: The target instead has the Stunned condition (save ends). Éxito: Half damage only.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the mammoth moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a CD 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the mammoth can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The cerodon deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Gore
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Impacto: 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Impacto: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the cervidal moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The cervidal has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Speak With Beasts
entries: The cervidal can communicate with beasts as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cervidal makes three attacks. one to Ram and two with its Rapier.

action.name: Ram
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage.

action.name: Rapier
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Dispelling Horns (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action when the cervidal hits a target with a Ram attack, it can choose one of three effects:

action.name: Break Enchantment
entries: If the target that is charmed, frightened, or possessed by a celestial, an elemental, a fey, a fiend, or an undead, the target hit is no longer charmed, frightened, or possessed by such creatures.

action.name: Dismissal
entries: If the target is an illusion, it is immediately dispelled. If the target is a a fey, a fiend, or an undead, the cervidal can attempt to drive the creature back to its home plane. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be sent back to its home plane (if it isn't there already). If they aren't on their home plane, undead are sent to the Shadowfell, and fey are sent to the Feywild.

action.name: Dispel Magic
entries: Any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. For each spell of 4th level or higher on the target, the cervidal must make a Charisma ability check. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a successful check, the spell ends.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cervidal casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devil makes two attacks with its chains.

action.name: Chain
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 14) if the devil isn't already grappling a creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Animate Chains (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Up to four chains the devil can see within 60 feet of it magically sprout razor-edged barbs and animate under the devil's control, provided that the chains aren't being worn or carried.

Each animated chain is an object with AC 20, 20 hit points, resistance to piercing damage, and immunity to psychic and thunder damage. When the devil uses Multiattack on its turn, it can use each animated chain to make one additional chain attack. An animated chain can grapple one creature of its own but can't make attacks while grappling. An animated chain reverts to its inanimate state if reduced to 0 hit points or if the devil is incapacitated or dies.

reaction.name: Unnerving Mask
entries: When a creature the devil can see starts its turn within 30 feet of the devil, the devil can create the illusion that it looks like one of the creature's departed loved ones or bitter enemies. If the creature can see the devil, it must succeed on a CD 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its turn.

trait.name: Diabolical Restoration
entries: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devil makes two Chain attacks and uses Conjure Infernal Chain.

action.name: Chain
entries: m 7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two chains, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Conjure Infernal Chain
entries: The devil conjures a fiery chain to bind a creature. Salvación de Destreza (Dexterity): DC 15, one creature the devil can see within 60 feet. Fallo: 9 (2d4 + 4) Fire damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of the devil's next turn, at which point the chain disappears. If the target is Large or smaller, the devil moves the target up to 30 feet straight toward itself. Éxito: The chain disappears.

reaction.name: Unnerving Gaze
entries: Disparador: A creature the devil can see starts its turn within 30 feet of the devil and can see the devil. Respuesta: Salvación de Sabiduría (Wisdom): CD 15, the triggering creature. Fallo: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its turn. Éxito: The target is immune to this devil's Unnerving Gaze for 24 hours.

entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

action.name: Chain Slam
entries: The chain devil ascendant slams a Medium or smaller creature grappled by its chain into another creature or a solid surface within its reach. If slammed into another creature, both creatures must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or take 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half the bludgeoning damage and isn't stunned.

action.name: Whirling Chains (Recarga 6)
entries: The chain devil ascendant moves up to half its walking speed and targets each creature within 15 feet of it during its movement. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage.

The chain devil ascendant's movement during this action will not provoke opportunity attack. If the chain devil ascendant has a creature grappled by any of its chains (not the animated ones), the creature automatically fails is saving throw but is immediately released to a random space within 10 feet of the chain devil ascendant's space where it began to use Whirling Chains.

action.name: Animate Chains (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)

Each animated chain is an object with AC 20, 20 hit points, resistance to piercing damage, and immunity to psychic and thunder damage. When the devil uses Multiattack on its turn, it can use each animated chain to make one additional chain attack. An animated chain can grapple one creature of its own but can't make attacks while grappling. An animated chain reverts to its inanimate state if reduced to 0 hit points or if the devil is incapacitated or dies.
