entries: rw 5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) poison damage. The target gets marked with pheromones for one minute. Any plant type creature has advantage on all attacks against the marked creature and is aware of its exact position as long as the creature is within 120 feet of it. A creature can spend an action to remove the spores.

action.name: Rain of Blight
entries: Each creature in a 10-foot-radius centered on a point within 60 feet of the fungal battery must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 7 (2d6) poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Cloud of Spores
entries: The fungal battery releases a cloud that fills a 15 foot cube centered on itself. Each creature in the cloud other than the fungal battery must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save a creature takes 4 (1d8) poison damage and can't take reactions until the beginning of its next turn. The area of the cloud is heavily obscured and lasts until the beginning of the fungal battery's next turn.

name: Fungal Bombard
sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark

action.name: Marking Spores
entries: rw 6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) poison damage. The target gets marked with pheromones for one minute. Any plant type creature has advantage on all attacks against the marked creature and is aware of its exact position as long as the creature is within 120 feet of it. A creature can spend an action to remove the spores.

action.name: Rain of Blight
entries: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius centered on a point within 60 feet of the fungal bombard must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 14 (4d6) poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Cloud of Spores
entries: The fungal bombard releases a cloud that fills a 10-foot radius centered on itself. Each creature in the cloud other than the fungal bombard must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save a creature takes 9 (2d8) poison damage and can't take reactions until the beginning of its next turn. The area of the cloud is heavily obscured and lasts until the beginning of the fungal bombard's next turn.

name: Fungal Crawler
sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark

trait.name: Maul
entries: The fungal crawler has advantage on attack rolls against creatures it has grappled.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fungal crawler makes two claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, it becomes grappled, escape DC 15. While grappling, the fungal crawler can only make claw attacks against the target it has grappled.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage. This attack deals an extra 9 (2d8) damage if the attack is made with advantage.

name: Fungal Grabber
sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fungal grabber makes two claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, it becomes grappled, escape DC 13. While grappling, the fungal grabber can only make claw attacks against the target it has grappled.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage. This attack deals an extra 4 (1d8) damage if the attack is made with advantage.

name: Fungal Scratcher
sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage. This attack deals an extra 4 (1d8) damage if the attack is made with advantage.

name: Fungal Servant
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The fungal servant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: A destroyed fungal servant gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the fungal servant's heart.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fungal servant can use its Dreadful Glare and makes one attack with its rotting fist.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to spores. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or other magic.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: The fungal servant targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the fungal servant, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened until the end of the fungal servant's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all fungal servants for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The fungal servant makes one attack with its rotting fist or uses its Dreadful Glare.

legendary.name: Blinding Spores
entries: Blinding spores swirls magically around the fungal servant. Each creature within 5 feet of the fungal servant must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendary.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The fungal servant utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the fungal servant that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the fungal servant's next turn.

legendary.name: Channel Negative Energy (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The fungal servant magically unleashes negative energy. Creatures within 60 feet of the fungal servant, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of the fungal servant's next turn.

legendary.name: Whirlwind of Spores (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The fungal servant magically transforms into a whirlwind of spores, moves up to 60 feet, and reverts to its normal form. While in whirlwind form, the fungal servant is immune to all damage, and it can't be grappled, petrified, knocked prone, restrained, or stunned. Equipment worn or carried by the fungal servant remain in its possession.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The fungal servant is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, 9 to hit with spell attacks). The fungal servant has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the trolling remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a patch of mushrooms.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the trolling dies, it explodes in a burst of mind-affecting spores. Salvación de Sabiduría (Wisdom): DC 13, each creature that isn't a troll in a 10-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the troll. Fallo: 9 (2d8) Psychic damage and has the Weakened condition (save ends). Éxito: Half damage only.

action.name: Spore Slam
entries: m 5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: A fungoid attacks twice with fists.

action.name: Fist
entries: m +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Fungus Bat Poison
entries: A creature that fails a DC 11 Consti saving throw against fungus bat poison suffers the usual effects of being poisoned. In addition, if the creature typically moves around on legs, it loses the use of its legs for 1d4 rounds. It falls prone immediately, and it can't stand up again until after the 1d4 rounds have elapsed. A successful saving throw against fungus bat poison does not impart any immunity against future poisonings.

action.name: Bite
entries: m +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage and the target must make a successful DC 11 Constitution saving throw or suffer the effect of fungus bat poison (see above).

trait.name: Sickening Aura
entries: A fungus gargoyle stinks like rotting vegetable matter. Creatures that begin their turn within 10 feet of a fungus gargoyle must make a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for as long as they remain within 10 feet of any fungus gargoyle and for 1d4 rounds afterward.

trait.name: Spore Poisoning
entries: A creature affected by spore poisoning must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw at the end of every hour. On a successful saving throw, there is no effect; on a failed saving throw, the creature adds one level of exhaustion to its current exhaustion level. A creature can't recover from exhaustion while suffering from spore poisoning. The character recovers from exhaustion by normal means once the poison is neutralized with magic.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: A fungus gargoyle attacks twice with claws or once with spore breath.

action.name: Claw
entries: m +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Spore Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: a automatic hit, range 10 ft. line, creatures in line. Hit: affected creatures must make a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion and suffer spore poisoning (see above).

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the rajang moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Fist Attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Hypermetabolism
entries: The rajang has advantage on saving throws against being paralyzed, poisoned, put to sleep, or stunned.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the rajang fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The rajang's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rajang makes three fist attacks.

action.name: Electric Volley
entries: rw 13 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) lightning damage and each creature within 15 feet of the target (excluding the target) must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Fist
entries: mw 13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Kick
entries: mw 13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Meteor (Recarga 6)
entries: The rajang jumps at least 15 feet as part of its movement, it can then use this action to roll into a ball and come crashing down in a space, within 40 feet of it, that contains one or more creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 22 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or be knocked prone and take 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 31 (9d6) lightning damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed 5 feet out of the rajang's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is with in range, the creature instead falls prone in the rajang's space.

action.name: Lighting Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: The rajang exhales lightning in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 58 (13d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Kick
entries: The rajang makes one Kick attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The rajang moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Quake (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The rajang reaches for the sky and slams its body onto the ground causing the ground to shake violently. Each creature within 30 feet of the rajang must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. Any creature that fails this save by 5 or more is also stunned until the end of their next turn.

legendary.name: Volley (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The rajang makes one attack with its electric volley.

name: Furnace Golem
languages: Understands the language of it's creator but can't speak

trait.name: Cold and Fire Sensitivity
entries: If a furnace golem takes cold damage, its speed is halved, it can't take bonus actions, and it can make only one attack until the end of its next turn. If it is attacked with fire, it takes no damage but instead heals 1 hit point per 3 points of fire damage the attack would have inflicted. Excess hit points are gained as temporary hit points.

trait.name: Furnace
entries: As a bonus action at the start of its turn, a furnace golem can try to shove a grappled opponent into its interior furnace. The furnace golem makes a Strength check that is opposed by the grappled creature's Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. If the grappled creature wins the contest, nothing happens. If the furnace golem wins the contest, the grappled creature is shoved into the furnace, where it is blinded and restrained. The trapped creature takes 13 (2d8 + 4) fire damage and gains one level of exhaustion at the start of each of its turns. The creature remains trapped until it uses an action to win an opposed Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against the furnace golem's Constitution check. Alternatively, a creature outside the furnace golem can attempt a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against the golem's Constitution check to drag the trapped character free, but the rescuer automatically takes 13 (2d8 + 4) fire damage whether the attempt succeeds or fails. Only one creature of up to Medium size can be inside the golem's furnace.

trait.name: Heat
entries: A furnace golem's entire form is extremely hot. Creatures that attack a furnace golem with unarmed attacks or with natural weapons take 4 (1d8) fire damage each time one of their attacks hits.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: A furnace golem has tactical advantage on saving throws versus spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: A furnace golem attacks twice with fists or once with flame breath. It can't attack with its fists while it has a creature grappled.

action.name: Fist
entries: m +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 1d8 fire damage. If both attacks hit the same target, the target is grappled (see Furnace, above).

action.name: Flame Breath (Recarga 6)
entries: a automatic hit, 50 ft. line; creatures in line. Hit: 45 (10d8) fire damage, or half damage with a successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw.

name: Fury of Kostchtchie
sourceGroup: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

trait.name: Chilling Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the fury must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) cold damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The fury has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fury makes two Fist or Rock attacks.

action.name: Fist
entries: mw 13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage, or 17 (5d6) cold damage if the target took damage from the fury's Chilling Aura since the end of the fury's last turn.

action.name: Rock
entries: rw 13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Charge
entries: The fury can move up to its speed toward an enemy it can see.

trait.name: Honourable
entries: If the kabuto ends its turn prone and restrained by a creature that is grappling it, it becomes subdued. It immediately stops behaving aggressively and spends its turn disengaging and moving away from the area.

action.name: Pincer
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage and, if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, the kabuto can't target another creature with its Pincer attack and, if the creature is Large or smaller, it is restrained.

action.name: Toss
entries: The kabuto throws one creature it is grappling with their pincer directly upward, causing it to reach a height in feet equal to (1d4 + 1) × 10. If the creature collides with an obstacle that prevents it from reaching the specified height, it takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage before falling down.

bonus.name: Blind Charge
entries: The kabuto lowers its head, picking a direction. At the end of the next turn, the kabuto charges, moving in the chosen direction until it collides with a creature or obstacle, or moves a distance equal to its walking speed. If the kabuto collides with a Large or smaller creature, that creature must make a CD 13 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. If the kabuto collides with a solid object, like a thick wall, it takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Take Flight
entries: The kabuto gains a flying speed equal to its walking speed until the end of its next turn. While it has this flying speed, it loses its resistance to slashing damage and gains vulnerability to slashing damage instead. If it takes 10 or more slashing damage in a single instance, it loses its flying speed and can't use this bonus action until its wings regrow in 10 (3d6) weeks.

trait.name: Resilient
entries: A fyr has tactical advantage on all saving throws.

trait.name: Weapon Attunement
entries: Fyrs have an ability to attune themselves with any wood-handled weapon, so that they get a +1 attack bonus with such a weapon once they've handled for at least 10 minutes. This bonus is already included in the battleaxe attack line above.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: m +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.

action.name: Headbutt
entries: m +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a successful DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is knocked prone, the fyr can make an immediate battleaxe attack against it as a bonus action.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: A fyr's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 11, 3 to hit with spell attacks). A fyr doesn't need material components to use these abilities.

entries: The fzeg has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the fzeg fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the fzeg reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the fzeg can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The fzeg regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If the fzeg takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the fzeg's next turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The fzeg can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid or back into its true form, that of a wolf-humanoid hybrid. It can transform its body parts as part of attacking with them and can choose whether the change remains after making the attack. Other than its size, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it's wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The fzeg can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fzeg uses its howl, then attacks once with its bite and twice with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) necrotic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. A humanoid slain after being bitten rises the following night as a fzeglaich under the fzeg's control.

action.name: Claws

action.name: Howl
entries: Each creature of the fzeg's choice that is within 300 feet of the fzeg and able to hear it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the fzeg's Howl for the next 24 hours or until it is stunned by the fzeg.

action.name: Night Children (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)

trait.name: Air Envelope
entries: If it has at least 1 hit point, the gadabout can generate an air envelope around itself when in a vacuum. This air envelope can sustain the gadabout and one other creature in its space indefinitely.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The gadabout doesn't require food or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gadabout makes two Branch attacks.

action.name: Branch
entries: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

action.name: Wrap
entries: The gadabout enters the space of a willing Medium or Small creature within 5 feet of itself and gently wraps its branches around the target. The target is grappled (escape DC 0). Any attempt by the target to escape the grapple causes the gadabout to use its reaction to move into the nearest unoccupied space. While grappled by the gadabout, the target determines where the gadabout moves on the gadabout's turns and accompanies the gadabout wherever it goes.

action.name: Club
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Archery
entries: Gaetane gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls he makes with ranged weapons (bonus included below).

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: Gaetane has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: Gaetane can use his action to polymorph into a rat-humanoid hybrid or into a giant rat, or back into his true form, which is humanoid. His statistics, other than his AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. Gaetane reverts to its true form if he dies.

action.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Gaetane makes two melee attacks with his bite, or three ranged attacks with his longbow.

action.name: Bite (Rat or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with Player Characters as Lycanthropes.

action.name: Longbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: rw 10 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much poison damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Gaetane is a 10th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, 6 to hit with spell attacks). Gaetane has the following ranger spells known:

name: Gaismagorm

trait.name: Archdemon Mode (Mythic Trait; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest).
entries: If the gaismagorm would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 307 (15d20 + 150) hit points, and it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, the gaismagorm can now use its Meteor Rain and the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour.

trait.name: Gargantuan Monster
entries: When the gaismagorm moves, it can move through and end its turn in a Medium or smaller creature space. When it does, that creature must succeed on a DC 25 Strength or Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage, be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day).
entries: If the gaismagorm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The gaismagorm's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gaismagorm makes one Bite attack and two Wingarm attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (6d8 + 9) piercing damage.

action.name: Boulder
entries: rw 17 to hit, range 90/360 ft., one target. Hit: 45 (8d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wingarm
entries: mw 17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage. If the gaismagorn jumped at least 10 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, it creates a pillar of rock from underneath the target, filling a 5-foot-square that is 10-feet tall and the target must succeed on a DC 25 Strength or Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage, be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone.

action.name: Tail
entries: mw 17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 25 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

action.name: Vacuum Explosive Clap (Normal State Only; (Recarga 5))
entries: The gaismagorm jumps up to 30 feet into an unoccupied space and takes a deep breath. Each creature in a 300-foot cone must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or take 55 (10d10) thunder damage and be pulled into an unoccupied space near the cone's origin. The gaismagorm must use its Explosive Clap at the end of the next creature's next turn.

action.name: Meteor Rain (Archdemon Mode Only; (Recarga 6))
entries: The gaismagorm fires a fireball into the sky causing a swirling orange vortex above it. Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points within 300-feet of the gaismagorm. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on each point must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage plus 70 (20d6) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The sphere spreads around corners. A creature in the area of more than one fiery burst is affected only once.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The gaismagorm makes one Bite or Tail attack.

legendary.name: Explosive Clap (Normal State Only; Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The gaismagorm spits out an explosive ball, charging it up before detonating it. Each creature in a 30-foot cube originating from the gaismagorm must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 38 (11d6) fire damage and be pushed 10 feet away on a failed save, or half as much damage and isn't pushed on a successful one.

legendary.name: Wingarm Sweep (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The gaismagorm swipes its arm across a 15-foot long line that is 35-feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 23 (4d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage, be pushed 10 feet away, and knocked prone on a failed save, or half as much damage, is still pushed 10 feet away, but isn't knocked prone.

mythic.name: Backblast
entries: The gaismagorm charges up an explosive ball before firing it downwards. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from the gaismagorm must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) fire damage and be pushed 10 feet away on a failed save, or half as much damage and isn't pushed on a successful one. The gaismagorm then uses the explosion's momentum to jump 15 feet away from the blast.

mythic.name: Qurio Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The gaismagorm fires a qurio powered beam across a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw, taking 52 (15d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

mythic.name: Rampage (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The gaismagorm makes three Wingarm attacks. If it hits with all three, the third attack's damage is doubled.

mythicHeader: If the gaismagorm's Archdemon Mode trait has activated in the last hour, it can use the options below as legendary actions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gaj makes one Mandibles attack and uses Mind-Probing Antennae or Paralyze (if available).

action.name: Mandibles

Until the grapple ends, the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage at the start of each of the gaj's turns. While it is grappling a creature, the gaj can't use its mandibles to attack other creatures.

action.name: Mind-Probing Antennae
entries: The gaj targets one creature grappled by it. The target must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage, and the gaj magically pulls one piece of information from the target's mind that the gaj wants to know. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage, and the gaj learns nothing.

action.name: Paralyze (Recarga 6)

Roll 1d4, On a 1 blue represents stone knife; On a 2 yellow represents paralysis knife; On a 3 purple represents poison knife; and on a 4 black represents blind knife.

action.name: Stone Knife

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Blind Knife

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Paralysis Knife

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Sleep Knife

trait.name: Blood Frenzy

trait.name: Gluttonous Attraction
entries: At the start of its turn, if a creature can see the gaki, it must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is overcome with a desire to kill and eat the ghost, and it must move as close to the gaki as it can.

trait.name: Hungry Frenzy
entries: The gaki has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hp.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The gaki can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack

Medium or Large corpses are filled with a greenish pollen from one of the tree's branches. The abdominal wound heals in 1d4 days, and the slain creature then rises as a gallows tree zombie connected by a tether-vine to the gallows tree that created it. Gallows tree zombies possess none of their former abilities.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If Gar fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Water Walk
entries: Gar can stand and move on liquid surfaces as if they were solid ground.

trait.name: Watery Fall
entries: When Gar drops to 0 hit points, his body collapses into a pool of inky water that rapidly disperses. Anything he was wearing or carrying is left behind.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gar makes two melee attacks, one with his claw and one with Drown.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, Gar can't attack other creatures with his claw.

action.name: Drown
entries: mw,rw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Gar is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16, 8 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following druid spells prepared:

trait.name: Enrage (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When the garangolm is reduced to half of its maximum hit points, it goes into a rage for 10 minutes and it immediately saves against all ongoing conditions and effects, then thrusts its arms into the earth to form gauntlet-like masses, semi-molten rock on its right arm whilst its left is covered in mossy growths that drips water.

trait.name: Standing Leap (Enraged Only)
entries: The garangolm's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 25 feet, without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The garangolm makes two Fist attacks. While enraged it can make one Molten Fist attack and one Mossy Fist attack.

action.name: Boulders
entries: rw 13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., Up to three targets in a 240-cone. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Fist
entries: mw 13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Headbutt
entries: mw 13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the garangolm moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 16 (3d10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

action.name: Molten Fist (Enraged Only)
entries: mw 13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage and the target ignites in flames. At the start of each of its turns, the target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save. On a successful save, the flames are doused. If the target or a creature within 5 feet of it uses an action to put out the flames, or if some other effect douses the flames (such as the target being submerged in water), the effect ends.

action.name: Mossy Fist (Enraged Only)
entries: mw 13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted with waterblight for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Elemental Slam ((Recarga 5); Enrage Only)
entries: The garangolm pulls a large chunk of heated earth from the ground and smashes it with both fists, creating an explosion in a 30-foot radius around it. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) cold damage plus 24 (7d6) fire damage and be afflicted with waterblight for 1 minute on a failed save, or half as much damage and isn't afflicted with waterblight on a successful one. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The garangolm makes one Fist attack. If it is enraged, it can instead make one Molten Fist attack or one Mossy Fist attack.

legendary.name: Bellyflop
entries: The garangolm falls prone in a space within 10 feet of it that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 21 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or be knocked prone and take 17 (4d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed 5 feet out of the garangolm's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls prone in the garangolm's space. The garangolm can then expend an extra legendary action to stand up.

legendary.name: Rocket Jump (Costs 2 Actions; Enraged Only)
entries: The garangolm uses its molten fist to jump up to 80 feet away into an unoccupied space without provoking opportunity attacks. It then makes one Mossy Fist attack.

legendary.name: Violent Roar (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The garangolm releases a guttural roar. Each creature that is within 20 feet of the garangolm must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is instead stunned until the end of its next turn.

name: Garden Guardian
sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark

trait.name: Hatred Beyond Time
entries: When the Garden Guardian's shield is destroyed or otherwise removed from combat, the Garden Guardian's Annihilating Glare attack loses its recharge property.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The garden guardian is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the garden guardian fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The garden guardian has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The garden guardian's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Stone Armament
entries: The Garden Guardian carries a shield and a spear. Each of which are large objects that are controlled by the Garden Guardian as long as they are within 240 ft. of it. Each of them have an AC of 18, 100 hit points and are immune to poison and psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Garden Guardian uses its Annihilating Glare if available and uses its Command Shield or its Command Spear.

action.name: Annihilating Glare (Recarga 6)
entries: The Garden Guardian fires a wide ray of corruptive energy in a 60 ft. cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) necrotic damage on a failed save and half as much on a successful one.

action.name: Command Shield
entries: The Garden Guardian moves its shield up to 60 ft. and does one of the following;
• Aegis. As long as the shield is within 5 ft. of the Garden Guardian, any attack targeting the Garden Guardian is redirected at the shield instead.

• Plummet. The shield is flung up into the air and lands at a point within 60 ft. of the shield's initial position. Once the shield reaches its destination or impacts against a solid surface, each creature and object within 10 ft. of the point of impact must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage. A creature that fails the saving by 5 or more is stunned until the end of the Garden Guardian's next turn.

action.name: Command Spear
entries: Command Spear. The Garden Guardian moves its spear up to 30 ft. and makes two of the following attacks with the spear;
• Impale. Melee Weapon Attack: 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage.
• Feed the Soil. Ranged Spell Attack: 11 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (3d8) necrotic damage and the creature takes 5 (2d4) necrotic damage at the beginning of its next turn.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The Garden Guardian makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary.name: Coordinate
entries: The Garden Guardian moves up to half of its speed and its shield and spear move up to 15 ft..

legendary.name: Command (2 Actions)
entries: The Garden Guardian uses its Command Shield or Command Spear. It can only command an item the Garden Guardian did not command since the start of its last turn.

legendary.name: Focus Hate (3 Actions)
entries: The DC of the Garden Guardian's next Annihilating Glare is increased by 2 (20). The Garden Guardian can only use this action when its shield is destroyed.

name: Gargantua
sourceGroup: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

trait.name: Weird Aura
entries: At the start of each of the gargantua's turns, each creature of the gargantua's choice within 30 feet of it must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target sees the gargantua as a manifestation of the target's worst fears; it takes 17 (5d6) psychic damage and has the frightened condition until the start of the target's next turn. On a successful save, a target is immune to this gargantua's Weird Aura for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gargantua makes two Slam or Rock attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw 15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: rw 15 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Flick
entries: Immediately after the gargantua takes damage from a Large or smaller creature it can see within 20 feet of itself, it attempts to flick the creature away. The target must succeed on a CD 23 Strength saving throw, or the target takes 18 (3d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage, is pushed horizontally up to 100 feet away from the gargantua, and has the prone condition.

reaction.name: Spell Mimicry (1/Day)
entries: Immediately after a creature the gargantua can see casts a spell of 5th level or lower, the gargantua tries to copy the spell. That creature must succeed on a CD 19 Charisma saving throw, or the gargantua immediately casts the same spell at the same level (+11 to hit with spell attacks, spell save CD 19), requiring no material components and choosing the spell's targets.

bonus.name: Baleful Hex
entries: The gargantua curses one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a CD 19 Wisdom saving throw or have the incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: The gargantua teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space that it can see within 120 feet of itself.

name: Gargantuan Drolem
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The drolem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The drolem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The drolem's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The drolem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drolem can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes one Bite attack, two Claw attacks, and one Tail attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) acid damage, and the damage type is acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison, depending on drolem type.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: mw +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Dragon's Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: The drolem exhales acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison (depending on drolem type) in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 63 (18d6) acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the drolem's choice that is within 120 feet of the drolem and aware of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the drolem's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: The rug is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the rug must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While it is grappling a creature, the rug takes only half the damage dealt to it, and the creature grappled by the rug takes the other half.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the rug remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal rug.

action.name: Smother
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Impacto: The creature is grappled (escape CD 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, blinded, and at risk of suffocating, and the rug can't smother another target. In addition, at the start of each of the target's turns, the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The gargoctopus can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Shifting Camouflage
entries: The gargoctopus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The gargoctopus can climb on difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gargoctopus makes four tentacle attacks or one bite attack and three tentacle attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, the gargoctopus can automatically hit the target with its tentacle, and it can't use the same tentacle on another target. The gargoctopus can grapple up to four creatures at one time.

action.name: Fling
entries: One Medium or smaller creature grappled by the gargoctopus is thrown up to 20 feet in a random direction and is knocked prone. If the target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Tentacle Slam (Recarga 5)
entries: The gargoctopus slams the creatures grappled by it into a solid surface. Each grappled creature must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and is stunned until the end of the gargoctopus' next turn. On a success, a target takes half the damage and isn't stunned.

action.name: Ink Cloud (Recarga 6)
entries: A 20-foot-radius cloud of darkness extends around the gargoctopus. The area is heavily obscured until the start of the gargoctopus' next turn. If underwater, the gargoctopus can use the Dash action as a bonus action after releasing the cloud.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gargoyle makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The gargoyle doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gargoyle makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: m 4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

name: Gargoyle Brute
sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark

trait.name: Clumsy Flight
entries: When the gargoyle ends its movement while being in the air, it falls. The gargoyle takes half damage from falling when it is able to use its wings.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the gargoyle brute remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a inanimate statue.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gargoyle makes two attacks with its claws.

action.name: Claws
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the creature is a Medium or smaller sized creature it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be either knocked prone or pushed 5 ft. away from the gargoyle.

action.name: Beak
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.

name: Garish Augment
languages: One national language; Deep Speech or Infernal (see text)

trait.name: Augmented Movement
entries: The garish augment has two other movement modes selected from: burrow 10 feet, climb 30 feet, and swim 30 feet.

trait.name: Augmented Spit
entries: The garish augment deals acid, necrotic or poison damage with its spit (choose one).
Being within 5 ft. of a hostile creature doesn't cause the garish augment to have disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Augmented Strikes
entries: The garish augment deals bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage with its strike (choose one).

trait.name: Jumper
entries: The garish augment jumps twice as far as its ability check to do so indicates.

trait.name: Unnatural Presence
entries: Effects that detect aberrations or fiends can detect the garish augment.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The garish augment makes three melee or ranged attacks in any combination.

action.name: Strike
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) damage of the type from Augmented Strikes.

action.name: Spit
entries: rw 6 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) damage of the type from Augmented Spit.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: When hit by a melee attack or ranged weapon attack from an attacker the garish augment can see, the garish augment adds 2 to its AC.

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The garlicle has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

trait.name: Tearful Stench
entries: Each creature other than an alliumite (Creature Codex) or garlicle within 5 feet of the garlicle when it takes damage must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the Tearful Stench of all alliumite and garlicles for 1 minute.

action.name: Walking Staff
entries: mw +0 to hit (6 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d6 - 2) bludgeoning damage, 2 (1d8 - 2) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands, or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

action.name: Cloves of Fate (Recarga 4)
entries: The garlicle plucks cloves from its head and throws them at up to three creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Roll a d4 for each creature. The garlicles allies have +1 on the roll while its enemies have a −1 on the roll. Determine the result and consult the following table.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The garlicle's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

name: Garlycanthrope
sourceGroup: L'Arsene's Ledger of Treasures and Trinkets

trait.name: Eyes of the Grave
entries: The garlycanthrope always knows the location of any undead within 60 feet of it that isn't behind total cover and that isn't protected from divination magic. It growls gently in the direction to warn its owner.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless, the garlycanthrope is indistinguishable from a normal head of garlic.

trait.name: Garlicol
entries: Due to the garlycanthrope's pungent aroma, vampires and their spawn have disadvantage on attack rolls while within 15 feet of it.

trait.name: Nose of the Changed
entries: The garlycanthrope can smell the presence of any shapechangers within 120 feet of it. It gives a soft bark in the direction from which their scent comes.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

action.name: Pong (1/Day)
entries: The garlycanthrope releases a puff of strong-smelling powder in a 30-foot radius. For the next 8 hours, any non-garlycanthrope creature that passes through the area has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks made to locate and/or track any creature using smell for 1 hour.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The garmvvolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The garmvvolf has three heads. While it has more than one head, the garmvvolf has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious. Whenever the garmvvolf takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the garmvvolf dies.

At the end of its turn, the garmvvolf grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire damage since its last turn. The garmvvolf regains 10 hp for each head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the garmvvolf moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Bite attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the garmvvolf can make one Bite attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the garmvvolf sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The garmvvolf makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

action.name: Tripartite Howl (Recarga 5)
entries: The garmvvolf's heads exhale a three-part howl, one filled with poisonous spittle, one a thunderous bellow, and one a frightful bay, in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 17 (5d6) poison damage and 17 (5d6) thunder damage and becomes frightened for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't frightened. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the garmyr can gain Advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have Advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Scent of Blood
entries: The garmyr's melee attacks deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a Bloodied creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The garmyr makes three Battleaxe attacks. It can also Howl, if available.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: m 8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 10 feet straight away from the garmyr. Critical Hit: The target has the Prone condition.

action.name: Howl (Recarga 6)
entries: Salvación de Sabiduría (Wisdom): DC 16, each Hostile [Attitude] creature in a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the garmyr that can hear it. Fallo: The target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

reaction.name: Retaliate
entries: Disparador: A creature hits the garmyr with a melee attack. Respuesta: The garmyr makes a Battleaxe attack against that creature.

bonus.name: Aggressive
entries: The garmyr takes the Dash action to move toward a Hostile [Attitude] creature it can see.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The garmyr has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the garmyr's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

trait.name: Skilled Hunter
entries: The garmyr's ranged attacks ignore Half and Cover.

trait.name: Kill Shot
entries: The garmyr's ranged attacks deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a Bloodied creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The garmyr makes three attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: m 6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: m,r 6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage if wielded with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Longbow
entries: r 7, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the start of the garmyr's next turn.

reaction.name: Skirmisher
entries: Disparador: A Hostile [Attitude] creature ends its movement within 5 feet of the garmyr. Respuesta: The garmyr moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

spellcasting.name: Hunter's Quarry
headerEntries: The garmyr casts Hunter's Mark, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The garmyr has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the garmyr's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

trait.name: Aura of the Blood Moon
entries: The garmyr projects a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] of carnage. Creatures have the Bloodied condition while within the Emanation [Area of Effect], even if they have more than half of their Hit Points remaining. This effect ends if the garymyr is Incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The garmyr makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Bite
entries: m 6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: m,r 6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage if wielded with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Blood Call
entries: m,r 7, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The garmyr casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to spell attacks):

bonus.name: Feast
entries: The garmyr makes a Bite attack against a Bloodied target.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The war dog has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the war dog's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

action.name: Bite
entries: m 6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Prone condition.

bonus.name: Feast
entries: The war dog makes a Bite attack against a Bloodied target.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The garmyr has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the garmyr's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The garmyr makes two attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: m 5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: m,r 5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage if wielded with two hands to make a melee attack.

bonus.name: Feast
entries: The garmyr makes a Bite attack against a Bloodied target.

name: Garra
sourceGroup: Eberron: Rising from the Last War

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Javelin
entries: Ataque (mw,rw): +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Impacto: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Garret wears a Ring of Warmth (included in his statistics) and wields a Gambler's Blade longsword.

trait.name: Bardic Inspiration (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, Garret can give one chosen creature (other than him) a d6 inspiration die. The chosen creature must be within 60 feet of Garret and able to hear him. entries: The gearforged templar whirls its greatsword in a great arc. Each creature within 10 feet of the gearforged must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (5d10) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Defensive Zone
entries: When a creature enters the gearforged templar's reach, the templar makes one Greatsword attack against the creature.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The gearforged templar adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the templar must be able to see the attacker and must be wielding a melee weapon.

name: Gearkeeper Construct
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The gearkeeper is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Rapid Shifting
entries: Opportunity attacks made against the gearkeeper have disadvantage.

trait.name: Whirling Blades
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the gearkeeper takes 4 (1d8) slashing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gearkeeper makes two Arm Blade attacks, or one Arm Blade attack and one Spear Launcher attack.

action.name: Arm Blade
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Spear Launcher
entries: rw 9 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target is knocked prone.

action.name: Shrapnel Blast (Recarga 6)
entries: The gearkeeper jettisons a spray of jagged metal in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The gearmass can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Clanging Mass
entries: The gearmass is filled with metal objects that clang, scrape, and clink together as it moves. When it moves, it has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to stay silent until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The gearmass doesn't require sleep.

trait.name: Rust Metal
entries: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the gearmass corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the gearmass is destroyed after dealing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gearmass makes two Gear Slam or Cog Toss attacks. If it hits one creature with both Gear Slam attacks, the target is grappled (escape DC 14), and the gearmass uses Engulf on the target.

action.name: Gear Slam
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Cog Toss
entries: rw 6 to hit, reach 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The gearmass engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the gearmass's turns or take 14 (4d6) acid damage.

Any nonmagical ferrous metal armor, weapons, or other items the target is wearing corrode at the start of each of the gearmass's turns. If an object is either metal armor or a metal shield being worn or carried, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If an object is a metal weapon, it rusts as described in the Rust Metal trait.
If the gearmass moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The gearmass can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While Gedovius remains motionless, he is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Gedovius' weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Sadistic Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage plus 1d6 psychic damage when Gedovius hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: Gedovius deals an extra 17 (5d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Gedovius that isn't incapacitated and Gedovius doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gedovius makes four attacks: one with his bite, one with gore, and two with his claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:1211 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Gore
entries: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: Gegazol can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost her extra movement.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Gegazol fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Gegazol has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If destroyed while her soul vessel remains intact, Gegazol's unconscious body rejuvenates within 5 feet of the soul vessel, where she regains 78 (12d12) hit points each day. When she has regained half her hit points, she regains consciousness.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature not immune to the poisoned condition that starts its turn within 30 feet of Gegazol must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until the start of that creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to Gegazol's stench for 1 hour.

trait.name: Turning Defiance
entries: Gegazol and undead within 120 feet of her have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gegazol can use her frightful presence. She then makes three attacks: one with her bite and two with her claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (2d12 + 8) piercing damage, 9 (2d8) cold damage and 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: mw 15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of Gegazol's choice within 120 feet of and aware of her must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Gegazol's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Breath of Long Night (Recarga 5)
entries: Gegazol exhales frozen material and rot in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) cold damage and 45 (10d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Those who fail the save also gain two levels of exhaustion until the end of Gegazol's next turn, and those who fail by 5 or more are also blinded for 1 minute. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: Daemon Sight
entries: Gegazol gains truesight out to 120 feet until the end of her next turn and can make a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary.name: Tail
entries: Gegazol makes a tail attack.

legendary.name: Wings of Winter (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Gegazol beats her wings. Each creature within 30 feet of her must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage and 9 (2d8) cold damage, and then fall prone. Gegazol can then fly up to half her flying speed.

name: Geist
languages: any languages it knew in life

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The geist can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The geist can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The geist enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

action.name: Possession (Recarga 6)
entries: One creature that the geist can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the geist; the geist then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The geist now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The geist can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the geist ends it as a bonus action, or the geist is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the geist reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this geist's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends. The geist can instead target the corpse of a creature, effectively using its own life force to animate the corpse as a zombie. The animated corpse uses zombie statistics and returns to death if the geist ends the possession.

trait.name: Acidic Touch
entries: At the start of the gelatinooze's turn, it can choose to secrete a small dose of acid (no action required). Each creature that is grappling it or that it is grappling takes acid damage equal to the gelatinooze's Constitution modifier.

trait.name: Dissolve Metal (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Over the course of 1 minute, the gelatinooze can dissolve up to 1 pound of nonmagical metal it is touching.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) acid damage.

trait.name: Ooze Cube
entries: The cube takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the cube's Engulf and has disadvantage on the saving throw.
Creatures inside the cube can be seen but have Cover.

A creature within 5 feet of the cube can take an action to pull a creature or object out of the cube. Doing so requires a successful DC 12 Strength check, and the creature making the attempt takes 10 (3d6) acid damage.
The cube can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time.

trait.name: Transparent
entries: Even when the cube is in plain sight, it takes a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a cube that has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter the cube's space while unaware of the cube is surprised by the cube.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) acid damage.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The cube moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the cube enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the cube. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the cube enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 10 (3d6) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns. When the cube moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 12 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the cube.

trait.name: Ooze Cube
entries: The cube fills its entire space and is transparent. Other creatures can enter that space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the cube's Engulf and has Disadvantage on the saving throw.
Creatures inside the cube have Cover, and the cube can hold one Large creature or up to four Medium or Small creatures inside itself at a time.
As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the cube can pull a creature or an object out of the cube by succeeding on a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check, and the puller takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage.

trait.name: Transparent
entries: Even when the cube is in plain sight, a creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice the cube if the creature hasn't witnessed the cube move or otherwise act.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: m 4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The cube moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack. The cube can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures if it has room inside itself to contain them (see the Ooze Cube [Area of Effect] trait). Salvación de Destreza (Dexterity): DC 12, each creature whose space the cube enters for the first time during this move. Fallo: 10 (3d6) Acid damage, and the target is engulfed. An engulfed target is suffocating, can't cast spells with a Verbal component, has the Restrained condition, and takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns. When the cube moves, the engulfed target moves with it. An engulfed target can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space. Éxito: Half damage, and the target moves to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the cube. If there is no unoccupied space, the target fails the save instead.

entries: The gem jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the jelly remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a natural crystal formation.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gem jelly makes two Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod (True Form Only)
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Crystalline Shatter (Crystalline Form Only)
entries: The jelly shatters their hardened outer layer, returning to their true form and sending crystal shrapnel in all directions. Each creature within 10 feet of the gem jelly must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Gem jellies are immune to this damage.

reaction.name: Reactive Shatter (Crystalline Form Only)
entries: When the jelly takes thunder damage, they use Crystalline Shatter.

bonus.name: Harden
entries: The gem jelly transforms into a psionically hardened crystalline form or back into their true form. While in crystalline form, the jelly's AC increases to 20, their speed becomes 0, they can't make Pseudopod attacks, they have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, and they gain vulnerability to thunder damage.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the jelly remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a natural crystal formation.

trait.name: Flowing Jelly
entries: The jelly can occupy their caregiver's space and vice versa, and it doesn't count as difficult terrain for them.
While occupying the same space as the jelly, the caregiver can take the Hide action to hide from creatures outside the jelly.

action.name: Signature Attack (Pseudopod)
entries: mw 3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 plus PB piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Stretch Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The jelly makes a signature attack with a reach of 10 feet. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 0d1 + PB|PB damage, and the jelly can pull the target 5 feet toward them.

action.name: 3rd Level: Crystallize (5 Ferocity)
entries: The jelly grows sharp crystals from the ground in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the jelly. Until the start of the jelly's next turn, that area becomes difficult terrain for their enemies, and when an enemy moves into or within that area, the enemy takes 2 × PB piercing damage for every 5 feet they travel.

action.name: 5th Level: Shatter (8 Ferocity)
entries: The jelly ejects jagged crystals from their body toward each enemy within 10 feet of them.
Each target must make a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw, taking PBd6 piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Deadly Leap
entries: If the gendrome jumps at least 15 feet as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 13 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or be knocked prone and take 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed 5 feet out of the gendrome's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is with in range, the creature instead falls prone in the gendrome's space.

action.name: Alpha Call (1/day)
entries: The gendrome calls out for help and 2 (1d4) genprey appear to assist it.

Her statistics are replaced by those of the Werewolf stat block, but she retains her alignment; personality; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; proficiencies; and languages known. She then immediately revives in her hybrid form with all her Hit Points.
