trait.name: Strangling
entries: When a hawktoad hits a target with its tongue, the monster wraps its tongue around the victim's neck. It then quickly maneuvers itself behind the target, landing on the target's back. The hawktoad digs in its claws and tries to strangle the victim with its tongue. If the targeted creature makes a successful DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, it gets an arm, a hand, or some other limb or object under the hawktoad's tongue and avoids any further danger from this specific tongue attack; the hawktoad can try again on coming turns. If the Dexterity saving throw fails, the creature is being strangled by the hawktoad; it runs out of breath and begins suffocating. As long as the hawktoad continues strangling it, the unconscious creature can't stabilize by making successful death saving throws. If the hawktoad is killed or its stranglehold is broken, the victim can recover normally. A creature has tactical disadvantage on attacks against a hawktoad that has grappled it and is clinging to its back. A hawktoad uses its Dex in contests to maintain its grapple, instead of Str.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: A hawktoad attacks once with claws and once with its tongue.

action.name: Claws
entries: m +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Tongue
entries: m +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: the target is grappled and strangled (see above).

name: Hawkwood the Deserter
sourceGroup: Dark Souls III: Lord Seeker's Compendium

trait.name: Agile Combatant
entries: If Hawkwood makes an attack on his turn, he doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity for the rest of his turn.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when Hawkwood hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Hawkwood fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Mighty Wielder
entries: Hawkwood can wield a two-handed melee weapon in one hand and make attacks with it one-handed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Hawkwood makes two attacks with his greatsword.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: mw 15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) slashing damage.

action.name: Knife
entries: mw 15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d4 + 8) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Hawkwood adds 7 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Hawkwood must see the attacker and be wielding his knife.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Hawkwood moves up to half his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Hawkwood makes one attack with his greatsword.

legendary.name: Knife Flourish (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Hawkwood makes three knife attacks against one target.

trait.name: Mutant Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the hulk to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the hulk drops to 1 Hit Points instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hulk makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: m 8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Trample (Recarga 5)
entries: The hulk moves its speed. During this movement, it can move through the spaces of Medium and smaller creatures, as well as structures made of wood or stone that are less than 1 foot thick. When the hulk enters another creature's space for the first time during this movement, it can make one Slam attack against that creature. If the target is a creature, it is subject to the following effect. Salvación de Fuerza (Strength): DC 16. Fallo: The targeted creature has the Prone condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The haze hulk makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

name: Haze Husk
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

action.name: Slam
entries: m 3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Death Burst
entries: Disparador: The haze husk is reduced to 0 Hit Points by damage that isn't Radiant or from a Critical Hit. Salvación (con): CD 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the haze husk. Fallo: 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target gains one Contamination level.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: If damage reduces the haze husk to 0 hit points, the delerium fragments in its body explode in a burst of contaminated energy, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. Creatures who fail this saving throw by 5 or more gain one level of contamination.

trait.name: Haze Aura
entries: A creature starting its turn within 30 feet of Lenore is subjected to the following effect: Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 19. Fallo: The target gains a Contamination level. Fallo o Éxito: 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Tendrils
entries: Lenore's long hair can latch onto surfaces to pull her in any direction. She has a Flying Speed of 40 feet (included in Speed) but cannot move more than 30 feet from a solid surface, including walls and ceilings.

action.name: Lenore always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On her turn, she can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Lenore takes one of the following Epic Action at the end of each player character's turn.

action.name: Tentacle Hair
entries: m 9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) Piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Contaminated Eye Blast
entries: r 9, range 120 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Force damage, plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature it is subjected to the following effect. Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 19. Fallo: The target gains one level of Contamination.

action.name: Grim Reveal (1/Round)
entries: Lenore removes her mask, revealing her horrific form. Salvación de Sabiduría (Wisdom): DC 19, creatures within 60 feet of her who can see her. Fallo: The target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

action.name: Octarine Wall (1/Day)
entries: Lenore summons a shimmering wall within 120 feet of her. The wall can be up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick. Alternatively, she can shape the wall into a sphere up to 30 feet in diameter centered on a point she can see within range. The wall has three octarine layers. When a creature attempts to reach into or pass through the wall, it does so one layer at a time through all the wall's layers. Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 19. Failure:

Layer 1: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage and the target gains one level of Contamination and has the Dazed condition; Layer 2: 17 (5d6) Necrotic damage, and the target gains two levels of Contamination and has the Defenseless condition; Layer 3: 35 (10d6) Necrotic damage, and the target gains three levels of Contamination and the Helpless condition. Éxito: Half damage only. The wall can be destroyed by taking at least 100 Radiant or Force damage.

action.name: Radiant Gaze (1/Round)
entries: Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. Fallo: 44 (8d10) Radiant damage and the target gains one level of Contamination. Éxito: Half damage only. If Lenore sees her reflection within the Cone [Area of Effect], she gains the Blinded and Incapacitated conditions for 1d6 hours and can't take the Epic Resistance Epic Action for the duration.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: Lenore chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls 1d20. On an 11 or higher, the effect ends on her. Lenore can use this Epic Action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

name: Haze Wight
languages: The languages it knew in life

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The haze wight makes two Contaminated Blast attacks.

action.name: Contaminated Blast
entries: m,r 5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Necrotic damage. The first time the target is hit by a Contaminated Blast each turn, it is subjected to the following effect. Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 13. Fallo: The target gains one Contamination level.

bonus.name: Animate Haze Husk
entries: The haze wight reanimates the corpse of a haze husk it can see within 60 feet. The haze husk is revived with 5 Hit Points and immediately stands.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The vampire is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The vampire may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The vampire has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the vampire's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes two attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Contaminated Bite.

action.name: Claws
entries: m 5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

action.name: Contaminated Bite
entries: Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 13, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Fallo: 17 (4d6 + 3) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. Éxito: Half damage only.

action.name: Delerium Healing
entries: The vampire touches a delerium shard and regains 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the vampire has used a delerium shard in this way, it can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

bonus.name: Aggressive
entries: The vampire moves up to its Speed toward a Hostile [Attitude] creature it can see.

action.name: Talons
entries: m 6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

action.name: Crone Songs
entries: The harpy sings a magical melody in a 60-foot Emanation [Area of Effect], choosing one of the following effects. Allies of the Crone are unaffected.

action.name: Breakneck Hymn
entries: Each creature in the Emanation [Area of Effect] that can hear the harpy has Vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage from falling until the start of the harpy's next turn.

action.name: Disarming Tune
entries: Salvación de Carisma (Charisma): DC 15, each creature in the Emanation [Area of Effect] that can hear the harpy. Fallo: The target has the Weakened condition until the start of the harpy's next turn.

action.name: Mesmerizing Melody
entries: Salvación de Sabiduría (Wisdom): DC 15, each creature in the Emanation [Area of Effect] that can hear the harpy. Fallo: 7 (2d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the start of the harpy's next turn.

action.name: Piercing Notes
entries: Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 15, each creature in the Emanation [Area of Effect] that can hear the harpy. Fallo: 21 (6d6) Thunder damage. Éxito: Half damage.

bonus.name: Aerial Maneuver
entries: The harpy takes the Dash or Disengage action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The harpy makes two attacks.

action.name: Talons
entries: m 5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: r 5, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

reaction.name: Chorus
entries: Disparador: The harpy is within the area of another harpy's song. Respuesta: The harpy joins in on the song, choosing a creature within 30 feet. The target has Disadvantage on its next saving throw against the song.

bonus.name: Aerial Maneuver
entries: The harpy takes the Dash or Disengage action.

trait.name: Pluck
entries: The harpy doesn't need to spend extra movement to drag a Medium or smaller creature Grappled by it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The harpy makes three attacks.

action.name: Grasping Talons
entries: m 6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the harpy can't use its Grasping Talons on another target.

action.name: Barbed Javelin
entries: m,r 7, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Lightning damage.

reaction.name: Chorus
entries: Disparador: The harpy is within the area of another harpy's song. Respuesta: The harpy joins in on the song, choosing a creature within 30 feet. The target has Disadvantage on its next saving throw against the song.

bonus.name: Aerial Maneuver
entries: The harpy takes the Dash or Disengage action.

action.name: Proboscis
entries: m 8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) Psychic damage. If the target has the Incapacitated condition, its Intelligence score is reduced by 1d4 until it finishes a Short Rest or Long Rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its Intelligence score to 0.

action.name: Delerium Dust (Recarga 5)
entries: Salvación de Sabiduría (Wisdom): DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the hazewing moth. Fallo: 14 (4d6) Radiant damage, and the target has the Addled condition (save ends).

bonus.name: Hypnotic Flutter
entries: Salvación (int): CD 13, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] of the hazewing moth that can see it (hazewing moths automatically succeed). Fallo: The target has the Slowed condition (save ends). If the target is already Slowed, it instead has the Immobilized condition (save ends). If the target is already Immobilized, it also has the Incapacitated condition (save ends both).

action.name: Bite
entries: m 3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Anchored
entries: The chrysalis is firmly anchored in place. It can't be forced to move or teleport unless it chooses to be.

trait.name: Haze Aura
entries: The chrysalis conjures Deep Haze in a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect], which renders its area Lightly Obscured. A creature that starts its turn in the area is subjected to the following effect. Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 10. Fallo: The target gains one Contamination level. Fallo o Éxito: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Harden
entries: The chrysalis regains 7 (2d6) Hit Points, gaining any excess healing as Temporary Hit Points.

reaction.name: Sudden Emergence
entries: Disparador: The chrysalis is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Respuesta: Roll 1d6. On a 6, a Hazewing Moth Adult emerges from the chrysalis, sharing its Initiative count. On a 1-5, vile goo spills out of the chrysalis, and each creature within 5 feet of it is subjected to the following effect. Salvación (con): CD 15. Fallo: The target gains one Contamination level. Fallo o Éxito: 10 (3d6) Acid damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

name: Hazlik
languages: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Giant, Infernal, Undercommon

trait.name: Darklord Restoration
entries: If Hazlik dies, he revives with all his Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Hazlan.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Domain)
entries: If Hazlik fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Hazlik has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Hazlik makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

action.name: Arcane Burst
entries: m,r 10, reach 5 ft. or range 150 ft. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) Force damage.

legendary.name: Arcane Strike
entries: Hazlik makes one Arcane Burst attack.

legendary.name: Arcane Teleport
entries: Hazlik teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see, and each creature within 10 feet of the space he left takes 11 (2d10) Force damage. Hazlik can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Hazlik casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

spellcasting.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
headerEntries: Hazlik casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

bonus.name: Wild Magic Surge
entries: Hazlik manifests one of the following magic surges, targeting a creature he can see within 120 feet. While Bloodied, Hazlik manifests two surges (roll 1d4; reroll if Hazlik has already used that surge during this turn):
1: Misty Movement: Hazlik can teleport the target up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see on a surface or liquid large enough to support the target.
2: Eye Blight: Salvación (con): CD 18. Fallo: The target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.
3: Mind Flare: Salvación (int): CD 18. Fallo: 13 (2d12) Psychic damage, and the target can't take the Magic action until the end of its next turn.
4: Implode: Salvación (dex): CD 18. Fallo: The target takes 10 (3d6) Force damage. Fallo o Éxito: Each creature within 5 feet of the target takes 10 (3d6) Force damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hazvongel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hazvongel makes three Talon attacks.

action.name: Talon
entries: mw 10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Blood Barrage (Recarga 5)
entries: The hazvongel launches a spray of blood in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: He Who Laughs Last is immune to any effect that would sense his emotions or read his thoughts, as well as any divination spell that he refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the demon lord's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

trait.name: Mortal Coil
entries: He Who Laughs Last projects a 150-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] of death and decay. A creature that ends its turn in the Emanation [Area of Effect] suffers an Exhaustion level and ages 10 (3d6) years. The creature removes an Exhaustion level gained in this way at the end of its turn, but only if it ends its turn outside the Emanation [Area of Effect]. A creature's original age can be restored with Greater Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: He Who Laughs Last always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On his turn, He Who Laughs Last can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, He Who Laughs Last takes one of the following Epic Action at the end of each player character's turn:

entries.name: Scornful Whip
entries: m 16, reach 120 ft. Hit: 30 (5d8 + 8) Force damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pulled 30 feet toward He Who Laughs Last.

entries.name: Walking Shadow (1/Round)
entries: He Who Laughs Last moves up to half his Speed.

action.name: Sleep No More (1/Round)
entries: He Who Laughs Last casts Power Word Kill.

action.name: Out Brief Candle (1/Round)
entries: He Who Laughs Last casts Finger of Death (save DC 24).

action.name: Dusty Death (1/Round)
entries: He Who Laughs Last casts Disintegrate (save DC 24).

action.name: Cage of Sorrows (1/Round)
entries: He Who Laughs Last creates a wall of bone on a solid surface it can see within 120 feet of himself. The wall appears as a flat surface made up of one 10-foot-square panel. The wall is 1 foot thick and lasts for 1 minute or until the wall is destroyed (AC 15, 20 Hit Points, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage, Vulnerability to Bludgeoning and Thunder damage).

If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (GM's choice) and subjected to the following effect. Salvación de Destreza (Dexterity): DC 16. Fallo: 10 (3d6) Piercing damage.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: He Who Laughs Last chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He Who Laughs Last can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (1/Round)
headerEntries: He Who Laughs Last casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 26):

trait.name: Brave
entries: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The knight makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: Ataque con arma a distancia: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Impacto: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

action.name: Leadership (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, the knight can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 feet of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a d4 to its roll provided it can hear and understand the knight. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if the knight is incapacitated.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The knight adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the knight must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

name: Headless Gargoyle
sourceGroup: Dark Souls III: Lord Seeker's Compendium
languages: understands Common and Giant but can't speak

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The gargoyle is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The gargoyle's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Varied Weaponry
entries: The gargoyle has different action options based on which weapon it wields: a fire lance or a great torch.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gargoyle makes two attacks.

action.name: Fire Lance
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

action.name: Great Torch
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

name: Headless Iron Golem
sourceGroup: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden

trait.name: Headless
entries: The golem is blinded and deafened, giving it disadvantage on all its attack rolls, and it can't use its Poison Breath.

trait.name: Fire Absorption
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Sword
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Impacto: 23 (3d10 + 7) slashing damage.

name: Headless Skeleton
sourceGroup: Dark Souls III: Lord Seeker's Compendium
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The skeleton's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skeleton makes two attacks.

action.name: Falchion
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The skeleton adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the skeleton must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

action.name: Blood Drain
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Impacto: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the stirge's turns, the target loses 5 (1d4 + 3) hit points due to blood loss.

The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after it drains 10 hit points of blood from the target or the target dies. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the stirge.

trait.name: Cavalry Charge
entries: If the dragonborn moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature while mounted and then hits with a lance attack on the same turn, it can make a trample attack against that creature as a bonus action.

trait.name: Locked Saddle
entries: The dragonborn can't be knocked prone, dismounted, or moved against its will while mounted.

trait.name: Mounted Warrior
entries: The dragonborn is rarely seen without its giant lizard mount. The lizard wears custom scale mail that raises its Armor Class to 15. While the dragonborn is mounted, the giant lizard can't be charmed or frightened.

action.name: Lance
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d12 + 2) piercing damage. Heavy Crossbow. Ranged Weapon Attack: 3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

action.name: Trample (Mounted Only)
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The dragonborn breathes fire in a 15-foot cone. All creatures in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Keen Smell.
entries: The hebi-doku has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Serpentine Mind.
entries: The hebi-doku can magically command any snake within 120 feet of it, using a limited form of telepathy.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hebi-doku can use its Transfixing Rattle. It then makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its disabling sting, or two with its toxic spittle.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

action.name: Disabling Sting
entries: mw +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d4 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be unable to use bonus actions and reactions until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Toxic Spittle
entries: rw +8 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) poison damage, and the target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target is paralyzed for 1 minute. On a success, the target is poisoned for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Transfixing Rattle
entries: The hebi-doku rattles its tail at one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated and have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Dagger
entries: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hedge mage is a 4th-level spellcaster that uses Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12; 4 to hit with spell attacks). The hedge mage has the following wizard spells prepared:

name: Hedron
languages: understands all languages but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.

trait.name: Aura of Pure Order
entries: The hedron exudes a 30-foot sphere of pure order, which influences randomness and makes the area conform to a rigid ideal. The aura penetrates objects and barriers, but a barrier more than 2 feet thick blocks it, as does any barrier of force. Objects harmlessly become perfectly geometric if they remain in the aura for 1 minute. Difficult terrain in the area becomes normal terrain until subjected to something that makes it difficult terrain again. Objects removed from the aura before they transform revert to normal.

A creature other than a hedron that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 5 (2d4) force damage. While in the aura, a creature can't change shape or have advantage or disadvantage.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The hedron is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hedron uses telekinesis twice.

action.name: Telekinesis
entries: ms 6 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) force damage, although the hedron can choose to deal half or no damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, if the hedron wishes, the target is restrained. The hedron can move a grappled creature or held object up to 30 feet in any direction, provided the target remains within the hedron's reach. If the hedron tries to move an object another creature wears or carries, that creature can prevent the movement with a successful DC 14 Strength saving throw. The hedron can hold (grapple) up to two creatures or objects at a time. It can also exert fine control while choosing to deal no damage, such as manipulating a tool or opening a door.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the wight has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wight attacks twice with Grave Bolt.

action.name: Grave Bolt
entries: Ataque de conjuro a distancia: +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Impacto: 7 (1d8 + 3) necrotic damage.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Impacto: 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a CD 13 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

A humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a zombie under the wight's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The wight can have no more than twelve |zombies under its control at one time.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The wight's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save CD 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no verbal or material components:

trait.name: Cat Sneak
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the heggarna has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide. It can use this trait only while it is disguised as a cat.

trait.name: Dream Eating
entries: As a bonus action, the heggarna can attach its lamprey-like maw to a sleeping creature. The target's Charisma score is reduced by 1d4 when the heggarna first attaches to it. The target's Charisma score is then reduced by 1 for each hour the heggarna stays attached. The target dies if this reduces its Charisma to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest at least 24 hours after the heggarna reduced its Charisma.

While attached, the heggarna fills the target's dreams with nightmares. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or it doesn't gain any benefit from its current rest. If the target succeeds on the saving throw by 5 or more, it immediately awakens.
The heggarna can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after it reduces the target's Charisma by 8 or if the target dies.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Dream Rift (Recarga 5)
entries: The heggarna unleashes a barrage of psychic energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn as it is bombarded with nightmarish images. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Illusory Apperance
entries: The heggarna covers itself with a magical illusion that makes it look like a Tiny cat. The illusion ends if the heggarna takes a bonus action to end it or if the heggarna dies. The illusion ends immediately if the heggarna attacks or takes damage, but it doesn't end when the heggarna uses Dream Eating.

The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the heggarna could appear to have fur, but someone touching it would feel its slippery flesh. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern the heggarna is disguised.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The helashruu uses Trap Life if it can. It then makes four shard whip attacks.

action.name: Shard Whip
entries: mw +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Reflect Energy (Recarga 5)
entries: The helashruu releases stored energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) damage of the most recent type dealt to the helashruu on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the helashruu hasn't taken damage within the past 1 minute, the damage type is force.

action.name: Trap Life (Recarga 6)
entries: One creature of the helashruu's choice that is within 30 feet of the helashruu and that can see it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be trapped inside the helashruu's mirror. While trapped, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the helashruu, and it takes 21 (6d6) force damage at the start of each of the helashruu's turns. The helashruu can have only one creature trapped at a time. A fragmented caricature of the trapped creature appears on the helashruu's surface while a creature is trapped inside it.

If the helashruu takes 30 or more bludgeoning or thunder damage on a single turn, the helashruu must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or release the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the helashruu. If the helashruu dies, a trapped creature is immediately released into a space within 10 feet of the helashruu.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The helashruu magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

action.name: Dimensional Hop (3/Day)
entries: The helashruu can transport itself to a different plane of existence. This works like the plane shift spell, except the helashruu can affect only itself and can't use this action to banish an unwilling creature to another plane.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting (1/Day)
headerEntries: The helashruu can innately cast gate, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has the following flaws:

entries.name: Forbiddance
entries: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

entries.name: Harmed by Running Water
entries: The vampire takes 20 acid damage when it ends its turn in running water.

entries.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: The vampire is destroyed if a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into its heart while it is incapacitated in its resting place.

entries.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The vampire takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the vampire, incapacitated, or restrained. Impacto: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Claws
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Impacto: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape CD 13).

trait.name: Drone
entries: The rapid beating of the helix moth's wings creates an incessant droning sound that clouds the minds of creatures capable of hearing it. All such creatures within 30 feet of the moth must make a successful DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or suffer a penalty identical to being poisoned (this is not a poison effect, however, so poison resistance and immunity don't apply). The effect lasts for 1 minute (10 rounds); at the end of that time, if the droning can still be heard, the saving throw can be repeated. A successful save renders a creature immune to the droning of helix moths for 12 hours.

trait.name: Helix Moth Poison
entries: If a player character drops to 0 hit points from a helix moth sting that caused poison damage (the character failed the saving throw), the character stabilizes automatically but remains unconscious for 2d6 hours. The character must attempt the saving throw even if the sting's piercing damage alone was enough to drop the character to 0 hit points. Healing the character above 0 hit points won't awaken the character before the 2d6 hours have elapsed. The character can awaken early only if the poison is neutralized by lesser restoration or similar magic.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: An adult helix moth bites once and stings once.

action.name: Bite
entries: m +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage and the target is grappled. If the helix moth has a target grappled at the start of the moth's turn, it can do 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage to that target automatically if it does not try to bite another target.

action.name: Sting
entries: m +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage and the target must make a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) poison damage (see Helix Moth Poison above).

action.name: Bite
entries: m +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage.

name: Hell Hound
languages: understands Infernal but can't speak it

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The hound has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The hound has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: The hound exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The hound has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hound makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Ataque cuerpo a cuerpo: +5, reach 5 ft. Impacto: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: Salvación de Destreza (Dexterity): CD 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. Fallo: 17 (5d6) Fire damage. Éxito: Half damage.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The hound has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hound makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: m 5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: Salvación de Destreza (Dexterity): DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. Fallo: 17 (5d6) Fire damage. Éxito: Half damage.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the fallen archon's darkvision.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The fallen archon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The fallen archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fallen archon makes two attacks. one with its Bite and one with its Greatsword.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The fallen archon magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying and any creatures it has grappled, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: The fallen archon exhales fire in a 15foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: The fallen archon can use its action to polymorph into a humanoid or hell hound that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the fallen archon's choice).

In a new form, the fallen archon retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hell hound archon's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the hell's reach remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary mushroom.

trait.name: Fiery Body
entries: A creature that touches the hell's reach or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 1 fire damage.

action.name: Touch
entries: mw 0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) fire damage.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the fallen archon's darkvision.

trait.name: Hellfire Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the fallen archon, or touches it or hits it with a melee attack while within 10 feet of it and the Hellfire Aura is active takes 9 (2d8) fire damage.

A creature that takes damage from the Hellfire Aura becomes vulnerable to fire damage until the start of its next turn. The Hellfire Aura remains until the fallen archon dies or until it dismisses it as an action.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The fallen archon doesn't provoke opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The fallen archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Discorporating Dive (3/Day)
entries: If the fallen archon is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with an armblade attack, the fallen archon can force the target to make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 22 (5d8) necrotic damage and 22 (5d8) fire damage and the target is disintegrated if this damage leaves it with 0 hit points. A disintegrated creature and everything it is wearing and carrying, except magic items, are reduced to a pile of black ash. In addition, a disintegrated humanoid creature has its soul funneled into the River Styx, where it's reborn instantly as a lemure devil. Until its soul is released or a wish spell is used, the creature cannot be restored to life. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fallen archon makes two Armblade attacks.

action.name: Armblade
entries: mw +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) fire damage and 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The fallen archon magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying and any creatures it has grappled, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hellblade archon's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

bonus.name: Armblades
entries: The fallen archon can transform the flesh of its forearms, hardening and sharpening them into the form of divine, fiery swordblades, or vice versa. The fallen archon's armblade attacks are considered magical.

trait.name: Darkness Dweller
entries: Attacks made against a bezekira in bright or dim light have disadvantage.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the bezekira's darkvision.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bezekira makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a Bite attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. The bezekira deals an extra 28 (8d6) fire damage when it hits a target with an attack and has advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, grasping the target with its mouth. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 17). The bezekira can't make a Bite attack while a creature is grappled in this way.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two greataxe attacks.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Impacto: 25 (3d12 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ataque con arma a distancia: +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Impacto: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If Hellenrae is subjected to an effect that allows her to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, she instead takes no damage if she succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if she fails.

trait.name: Stunning Strike (Recarga 5)
entries: When Hellenrae hits a target with a melee weapon attack, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of Hellenrae's next turn.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While Hellenrae is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, her AC includes her Wisdom modifier.

trait.name: Unarmored Movement
entries: While Hellenrae is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, her speed increases by 20 feet (included in her speed).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Hellenrae makes three melee attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Parry and Counter
entries: Hellenrae adds 3 to her AC against one melee or ranged weapon attack that would hit her. To do so, she must be able to sense the attacker with her blindsight. If the attack misses, Hellenrae can make one melee attack against the attacker if it is within her reach.

trait.name: Spellshield
entries: The hellfire disciple has advantage on saving throws against spells. If it succeeds on such a saving throw, it gains temporary hit points equal to the spell's level.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hellfire disciple makes two Spear attacks or two Infernal Bolt attacks.

action.name: Spear
entries: mw,rw +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

action.name: Infernal Bolt
entries: rs +4 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of the hellfire disciple's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hellfire disciple casts one of the following spells using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The hellfire engine is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hellfire engine has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The hellfire engine doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Flesh-Crushing Stride
entries: The hellfire engine moves up to its speed in a straight line. During this move, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. A creature whose space the hellfire engine enters must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is pushed to the nearest space out of the hellfire engine's path. On a failed save, the creature falls prone and takes 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage.

If the hellfire engine remains in the prone creature's space, the creature is also restrained until it's no longer in the same space as the hellfire engine. While restrained in this way, the creature, or another creature within 5 feet of it, can make a DC 18 Strength check. On a success, the creature is shunted to an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet of the hellfire engine and is no longer restrained.

action.name: Hellfire Weapons
entries: The hellfire engine uses one of the following options (choose one or roll a d6):

entries.name: 1–2: Bonemelt Sprayer
entries: The hellfire engine spews acidic flame in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) fire damage plus 18 (4d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures that fail the saving throw are drenched in burning acid and take 5 (1d10) fire damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage at the end of their turns. An affected creature or another creature within 5 feet of it can take an action to scrape off the burning fuel.

entries.name: 3–4: Lightning Flail
entries: mw 10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 22 (5d8) lightning damage. Up to three other creatures of the hellfire engine's choice that it can see within 30 feet of the target must each make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: 5–6: Thunder Cannon
entries: The hellfire engine targets a point within 120 feet of it that it can see. Each creature within 30 feet of that point must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (5d10) bludgeoning damage plus 19 (3d12) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

If the chosen option kills a creature, the creature's soul rises from the River Styx as a lemure in Avernus in 1d4 hours. If the creature isn't revived before then, only a wish spell or killing the lemure and casting true resurrection on the creature's original body can restore it to life. Constructs and devils are immune to this effect.
