trait.name: Death Malison
entries: When the hellfire giant dies, the runes on its body flash a bright green then turn to mundane malachite. Each creature within 20 feet of the giant must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be cursed for 7 days or until it is lifted by a remove curse spell or similar magic. While cursed, the creature has disadvantage on saving throws and on the first attack roll it makes on each of its turns. Fiends have disadvantage on the saving throw.

trait.name: Rune-Powered Weapons
entries: The hellfire giant's weapon attacks are magical. When the giant hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d8 fire damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two Greatclub or Runic Blast attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: mw 10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage.

action.name: Runic Blast
entries: rs 7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 3) force damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or its speed is halved until the end of its next turn. Fiends have disadvantage on the saving throw.

action.name: Invisibility Rune
entries: The hellfire giant magically turns invisible until it attacks, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the giant wears or carries is invisible with it.

reaction.name: Runic Shield
entries: The hellfire giant adds 4 to its AC against one attack that would hit it as green runes encircle the giant. To do so, the giant must see the attacker and can't be invisible.

trait.name: Spellshield
entries: The hellfire magistrate has advantage on saving throws against spells. If it succeeds on such a saving throw, it gains temporary hit points equal to the spell's level.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hellfire magistrate makes two Hellfire Spear attacks or two Infernal Bolt attacks.

action.name: Hellfire Spear
entries: mw,rw +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 10 (3d6) fire damage. Any humanoid killed by Hellfire Spear has its soul funneled into the River Styx, where it's reborn instantly as a lemure devil. The creature can be restored to life only by means of a wish spell followed by a true resurrection spell.

reaction.name: Absorb Spell (2/Day)
entries: The hellfire magistrate tries to interrupt a spell it sees a creature casting within 60 feet of it. If the spell is 3rd level or lower, the spell fails and has no effect, and the hellfire magistrate regains hit points equal to the spell's level. If the spell is 4th level or higher, the hellfire magistrate makes a Charisma check against a DC of 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the spell fails and has no effect.

reaction.name: Protective Shield (2/Day)
entries: When the hellfire magistrate is hit by an attack roll, the hellfire magistrate gains a +5 bonus to his AC until the start of the his next turn, which can cause the triggering attack roll to miss.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hellfire magistrate casts one of the following spells using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

trait.name: Spellshield
entries: The hellfire steward has advantage on saving throws against spells. If it succeeds on such a saving throw, it gains temporary hit points equal to the spell's level.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hellfire steward makes two Spear attacks or two Infernal Bolt attacks.

action.name: Spear
entries: mw,rw +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Infernal Bolt
entries: rs +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of the hellfire disciple's next turn.

reaction.name: Negate Spell (1/Day)
entries: The hellfire steward tries to interrupt a spell it sees a creature casting within 60 feet of it. If the spell is 3rd level or lower, the spell fails and has no effect. If the spell is 4th level or higher, the hellfire steward makes a Charisma check against a DC of 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the spell fails and has no effect.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hellfire steward casts one of the following spells using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

action.name: Hellfire Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: The dragon exhales hellfire in a 15foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On failed save, a creature takes 22 (4d10) fire damage and becomes vulnerable to fire damage until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effects.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: The dragon magically polymorphs into a tiefling or any Medium-sized devil. It can revert to its true form as a bonus action. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14, 6 to hit with spell attacks):

bonus.name: Heated Body
entries: The dragon emits fire from its body. A creature that touches the dragon or hits it with a melee attack while within 10 feet of it and the Heated Body is active takes 3 (1d6) fire damage. The Heated Body remains until the dragon dies or until it dismisses it as an action.

trait.name: Insanity
entries: The hellforged has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

trait.name: Hellfire Weapons
entries: The hellforged's weapon attacks are magical. When the hellforged hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d6 fire damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the hellforged has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hellforged makes three Battleaxe or Hurl Hellfire attacks.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Hurl Hellfire
entries: rs 5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Voice of Authority (Recarga 5)
entries: When a creature hits the hellforged with an attack, the hellforged shrieks a one-word command. The attacker must succeed on a CD 15 Wisdom saving throw or carry out this command on its next turn. This reaction works like the command spell, except the attacker doesn't have to understand the hellforged's language. The hellforged must see the attacker and be able to speak to use this reaction.

name: Hellhound
languages: understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

trait.name: Hardened by Flame
entries: When the hound is subjected to fire damage, they take no damage. Instead, their skin darkens and hardens, and their AC increases to 18 until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Stealthy Hunter
entries: The hound has advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track other creatures and on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide from creatures who are unaware of their presence.

action.name: Hellish Bite
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) fire damage.

action.name: Hellfire Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: The hound exhales flame in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (3d6 + 4) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature who isn't a hellhound who fails the saving throw is lit on fire for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), or until the target or another creature who can reach them uses an action to extinguish the flames. A creature who is on fire at the start of their turn takes 7 (2d6) fire damage. If a creature who is already on fire is set on fire again on a subsequent turn, the damage isn't cumulative, but the duration of the fire resets to 1 minute.

reaction.name: Tug of War
entries: When an enemy within 5 feet of the hound hits the hound with a melee attack, the hound can make a Hellish Bite attack against that enemy. If the hound's attack hits, the enemy is also grappled (escape CD 12), and if the triggering attack was a weapon attack, the weapon used in the triggering attack can't be used to make any more attacks while the target is grappled. The grapple ends if the hound attacks a different target with Hellish Bite.

trait.name: Consult Hell (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: The hound's caregiver can talk to the hound about a specific course of action that the caregiver plans to take within the next 30 minutes, tapping into divinatory power through the hound's connection to the infernal realm. After 1 minute, the hound then gives a response based on its own objective prophetic sense of the outcome: one bark for good results, two barks for bad results, three barks for both good and bad results, and no barks for results that aren't especially good or bad.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The hound has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

action.name: Bite (Signature Attack)
entries: mw 3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 plus PB piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Lava Spittle (2 Ferocity)
entries: The hound makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 0d1 + PB|PB damage, and the hound can choose another creature within 5 feet of the target, dealing PB fire damage to that creature.

action.name: 3rd Level: Brutal Charge (5 Ferocity)
entries: The hound can move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. During or at the end of this move, they can make a signature attack against one target within reach.

action.name: 5th Level: Fire Breath (8 Ferocity)
entries: The hound exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw, taking PBd6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Hellhound Cur
languages: understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

trait.name: Crossfire
entries: If a creature starts their turn within 10 feet of two or more curs, that creature takes 4 fire damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the cur takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the cur takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Hellish Bite (Group Attack)
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 fire damage, and if the target isn't a hellhound and the attack was made by more than one cur, the target must make a Dexterity saving throw with a DC equal to 10 plus the number of curs who joined the attack. On a failed save, the target is lit on fire for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), or until the target or another creature who can reach them uses an action to extinguish the flames. A creature who is on fire at the start of their turn takes fire damage equal to the number of curs who joined the attack. If a creature who is already on fire is set on fire again on a subsequent turn, the damage isn't cumulative, but the duration of the fire resets to 1 minute.

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that touches the remorhaz or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Impacto: 40 (6d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape CD 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the remorhaz can't bite another target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The remorhaz makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the remorhaz, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the remorhaz's turns.

If the remorhaz takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the remorhaz must succeed on a CD 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the remorhaz. If the remorhaz dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that touches the remorhaz or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Impacto: 40 (6d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape CD 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the remorhaz can't bite another target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The remorhaz makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the remorhaz, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the remorhaz's turns.

If the remorhaz takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the remorhaz must succeed on a CD 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the remorhaz. If the remorhaz dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that touches the remorhaz or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

name: Hellwasp
languages: Infernal, telepathy 300 ft. (with other hellwasps only)

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The hellwasp's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hellwasp makes two attacks: one with its sting and one with its sword talons.

action.name: Sting
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the target is also paralyzed. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Sword Talons
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Impacto: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a CD 11 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

name: Helmed Horror
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The helmed horror has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spell Immunity
entries: The helmed horror is immune to three spells chosen by its creator. Typical immunities include fireball, heat metal, and lightning bolt.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The helmed horror makes two longsword attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

name: Helmed Horror
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The helmed horror has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spell Immunity
entries: The helmed horror is immune to three spells chosen by its creator. Typical choices include Heat Metal, Lightning Bolt, and Magic Missile.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The helmed horror makes two Arcane Sword attacks.

action.name: Arcane Sword
entries: m 6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) Force damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The helmed horror has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spell Immunity
entries: The helmed horror is immune to three spells chosen by its creator. Typical immunities include fireball, heat metal, and lightning bolt.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The helmed horror makes two longsword attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Detention Orb
entries: The drone launches a tiny orb of magical force at a creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The creature must succeed on a CD 15 Constitution saving throw or be encased in the orb, which expands to a size just large enough to contain the creature. While encased, the creature doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, and it doesn't age. Nothing can pass through the orb, nor can any creature teleport or use planar travel to enter or exit the orb. As a bonus action, the drone can move the orb and its contents up to 30 feet in any direction. A successful casting of the Dispel Magic spell on the orb (CD 15) destroys it. The orb otherwise remains intact until the drone spends an action to end the effect or the drone is destroyed. A drone can have only one detention orb active at a time; if the drone creates a detention orb when it already has one active, the first orb disappears, freeing the creature inside.

name: Helpful Hand
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The hand can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Finger Jab
entries: m 5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Bludgeoning damage. Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 10. Fallo: The target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Latch
entries: m 5, reach 5 ft. Hit: The hand attaches itself to the target. While latched, the hand cannot attack. Instead, at the start of each of the hand's turns, the latched creature takes 2 (1d4) Necrotic damage. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the hand with a successful DC 13 Strength check. The hand can also detach itself at any time during its turn (no action required).

bonus.name: Helper
entries: The hand takes the Help action.

name: Hemlock Whipweed
languages: understands Sylvan and Terran but can't speak

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the whipweed is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the whipweed move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the whipweed is animate.

trait.name: Kodama Infused
entries: The connection between the whipweed and the kodama that infuses it can be interrupted by psychic assaults. If the whipweed takes psychic damage then, until the end of its next turn, its speed is halved, it can't take reactions, and it can take only an action or bonus action, not both.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The whipweed makes two Knotted Whip attacks.

action.name: Knotted Whip
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. A creature poisoned in this way has its speed halved. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

bonus.name: Knot
entries: Immediately after the whipweed hits a creature with a Knotted Whip attack on its turn, it forces the creature to make a CD 13 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the knotted whip wraps around the target, restraining it, before detaching from the whipweed, which regrows a new knotted whip. A creature can use its action to make a CD 13 Strength check, freeing itself or a creature within its reach on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Hendrik makes two Slam attacks and uses Numbing Needle.

action.name: Slam
entries: m 6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Numbing Needle
entries: Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 14, one creature within 5 feet. Fallo: 7 (2d6) Poison damage. Until the end of the target's next turn, the target's Speed is halved; the target can't take Reactions; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. Éxito: Half damage only.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Disparador: Hendrik is hit by a melee attack roll. Respuesta: Hendrik adds 2 to his AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

name: Hengar Aesnvaard
sourceGroup: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden

trait.name: Brave
entries: The gladiator has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the gladiator hits with it (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gladiator makes three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Spear
entries: Ataque (mw,rw): +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. and range 20/60 ft., one target. Impacto: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Impacto: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a CD 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The gladiator adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the gladiator must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

action.name: Club
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Blood Armor
entries: Each time a creature with blood hits the herald with a melee attack while within 10 feet of the herald, the creature takes 4 (1d8) necrotic damage, and the herald's AC increases by 1 until the end of its next turn. The herald's AC can't be increased to more than 20 from this trait.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The herald makes three Herald's Staff or Blood Bolt attacks, or it makes two Herald's Staff attacks and one Grasping Slam attack.

action.name: Herald's Staff
entries: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Grasping Slam
entries: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns, and the herald can't use its Grasping Slam on another target.

action.name: Blood Bolt
entries: rs 7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (5d8 + 3) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature with blood, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Call Blood (Recarga 5)
entries: Each creature with blood within 10 feet of the herald must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The herald then gains temporary hp equal to the single highest amount of necrotic damage dealt. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more also suffers one level of exhaustion.

bonus.name: Grant Blood Rage
entries: The herald of blood infuses reckless rage in one creature it can see within 60 feet of it that isn't a Construct or Undead. The target must succeed on a CD 17 Constitution saving throw or be enraged for a number of rounds equal to the target's Constitution modifier. While enraged, the target has advantage on all melee attack rolls, and attack rolls against it have advantage. When the rage ends, the target takes 13 (3d8) necrotic damage and suffers one level of exhaustion. A creature with any levels of exhaustion automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

trait.name: Made of Shadows (Shadow Form Only)
entries: The herald of darkness has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, it can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Shadow's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the herald's darkvision.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The herald of darkness makes two Embrace Darkness or Shadow Sword attacks.

action.name: Embrace Darkness (Shadow Form Only)
entries: ms 7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the herald's space. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Shadow Sword (Fiend Form Only)
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Majesty of the Abyss (Recarga 5)
entries: The herald of darkness emits a sinister burst of infernal power. Each creature within 15 feet of the herald and that can see it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 27 (6d8) necrotic damage and is blinded for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is also paralyzed until the end of its next turn. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Shadow Shape
entries: The herald magically transforms into a Large shadow or back into its true form, which is a Fiend. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The herald of fire has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hp.

trait.name: Hidden Herald
entries: The herald of fire can use its action to polymorph into a Medium dragonborn, Medium human, Small kobold, or back into its true draconic humanoid form. In each form, its eyes glow with magical fire and it wears a silver sword, revealing its identity as a herald. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying, other than the silver sword, transforms with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the herald fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The herald's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Scales of Justice
entries: At the start of each of the herald's turns, each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or speak only the truth until the start of the herald's next turn while within 30 feet of the herald.

trait.name: Treasure Sense
entries: The herald can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious metals and stones, such as coins and gems, within 60 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The herald of fire makes two fire claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, the target ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Fire Claw
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Fiery Lance (Recarga 5)
entries: The herald magically shoots fire in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 42 (12d6) fire damage and, if it is Huge or smaller, is pushed up to 15 feet away from the herald. On a success, a target takes half the damage and isn't pushed.

legendary.name: Fiery Claw
entries: The herald makes one fiery claw attack.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The herald makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary.name: Immolate Foe (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The herald of fire calls down searing, crimson fire in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point the herald can see within 120 feet of it. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it is engulfed in flames and must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried ignite. The pillar of fire lasts until the herald uses this legendary action again or until the herald dies.

trait.name: Corrupting Aura
entries: The calm emotions spell instantly fails when cast within 60 feet of the herald. In addition, any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the herald must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or grow hostile. On its turn, a hostile creature must move to and make one attack against the nearest creature other than the herald. If no other creature is near enough to move to and attack, the hostile creature stalks off in a random direction, seeking a target for its hostility. At the start of each of the herald's turn, it chooses whether this aura is active.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The herald's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The herald can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The herald of slaughter makes three attacks: one with its gore and two with its cleaver. Alternatively, it can use Enkindle Hate twice. If it hits one target with Enkindle Hate twice using this action, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or use its reaction to immediately move up to half its speed and make one melee attack against a random target within range.

action.name: Enkindle Hate
entries: rs +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Gore
entries: mw +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Cleaver
entries: mw +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The herald's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

name: Herald of the Great Wyrm
languages: Common, Elvish, Giant, Abyssal, Celestial, Draconic, Infernal

trait.name: Aura of Immobility
entries: The herald of the great wyrm emits an area of antimagic within 60 feet of itself. This trait works like the antimagic field spell, except it only affects magical travel. At the start of each of its turns, the herald chooses whether this aura is active. The aura prevents the herald's own magical traveling.

trait.name: Hidden Herald
entries: The herald of the great wyrm can use its action to polymorph into a Medium dragonborn, Medium human, Small kobold, or back into its true draconic humanoid form. In each form, its eyes glow with a magical light that shifts in color and it wears a silver key, revealing its identity as a herald. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying, other than the silver key, transforms with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the herald of the great wyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Portal Mastery
entries: As a bonus action, the herald of the great wyrm can open any object that contains a mundane or magical means that prevents access. This trait works like the knock spell, except it dispels rather than suppresses arcane lock and it doesn't create an audible knock when used. Alternatively, the herald can use a bonus action to open or close any magical portal, road, gateway, or path.

trait.name: Portal Movement
entries: As a bonus action, the herald of the great wyrm can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see toward or away from a hostile creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The herald of the great wyrm makes two claw of fate attacks or two spectral barrier attacks. If both claw of fate attacks hit the same target, the target is restrained. While restrained, the target takes 13 (2d12) radiant damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature, including the target, can take an action to make a DC 17 Strength check, ending the restrained condition on a success. The herald can restrain only two creatures at a time in this way.

action.name: Claw of Fate
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Spectral Barrier
entries: Ranged Magical Attack. 9 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) radiant damage. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be restrained by magical bands of force for 1 minute. A creature, including the target, can take its action to burst the bands of force by succeeding on a DC 17 Strength check.

legendary.name: Claw of Fate
entries: The herald makes one claw of fate attack.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The herald makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary.name: Black Well of Unmaking (Cost 2 Actions)
entries: The herald of the great wyrm creates a 5-foot-sphere of void matter on a point it can see within 120 feet of it. At the start of each of the herald's turns, each creature other than the herald within 30 feet of the well of unmaking must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the well. Each creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the well must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 27 (6d8) necrotic damage and is stunned. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't stunned. The well of unmaking lasts until the herald uses this legendary action again or until the herald dies.

trait.name: Annihilating Form.
entries: Any object that touches or hits the herald of the Void vaporizes. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw to prevent the object from being vaporized. If the object is magical, the creature has advantage on the saving throw. The herald can choose to not vaporize an object.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the herald fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Zero-Dimensional
entries: The herald can move through any space without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The herald makes two void claw attacks. Alternatively, it can use its Void Ray twice.

action.name: Void Claw
entries: mw +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) cold damage plus 4 (1d8) force damage.

action.name: Void Ray
entries: rs +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) cold damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

action.name: The Final Song (Recarga 5)
entries: The herald utters a melody of cosmic doom in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This melody doesn't affect creatures that understand Void Speech.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The herald flies up to half its flying speed without provoking opportunity attack.

legendary.name: Void Claw (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The herald makes one void claw attack.

legendary.name: Discorporate (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The herald chooses up to two creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or become intangible until the end of its next turn. While intangible, the creature is incapacitated, drops whatever it's holding, and is unable to interact with physical objects. The creature is still visible and able to speak.

legendary.name: Song of Mighty Doom (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The herald emits a cacophonous dirge praising the Void. Each creature other than the herald within 30 feet of the herald and that understands Void Speech gains 10 temporary hp.

trait.name: Creeping Death
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the herald must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The herald's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The herald has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The herald of undeath makes two reaping scythe attacks or uses its Ray of Annihilation twice. If both reaping scythe attacks hit the same target, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or it is reduced to 0 hp.

action.name: Reaping Scythe
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Ray of Annihilation
entries: rs 7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be blinded for 1 round.

trait.name: Incorruptible Vessel
entries: The exorcist can't be possessed by Celestials, Fiends, or Undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exorcist makes two Grave Burst attacks.

action.name: Grave Burst
entries: ms,rs 6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) necrotic or radiant damage (exorcist's choice).

action.name: Admit Entity (Recarga 5)
entries: The exorcist thins the veil of death for a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself, exposing the target to malevolent entities. The target must make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 36 (8d8) psychic damage and has the incapacitated condition for 1 minute, during which time it retches and babbles incoherently in a voice that is not its own. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only. An incapacitated target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The exorcist casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14, 6 to hit with spell attacks):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The remnant makes two Necrotic Surge attacks.

action.name: Necrotic Surge
entries: ms,rs 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) necrotic damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The remnant casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

bonus.name: Phase (2/Day)
entries: The remnant becomes partially incorporeal for as long as it maintains concentration on the effect (as if concentration on a spell). While partially incorporeal, the remnant has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

trait.name: Herd-Hidden (Herd Animal Form Only)
entries: The herd skulker has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) and Charisma (Deception) checks to blend into the herd or convince those observing the herd that it is part of the herd.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The herd skulker has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: One of the Herd
entries: A domesticated herd animal, such as a cow, horse, sheep, or chicken, that can see the herd skulker treats it as a member of the herd, regardless of the form the skulker takes. When such an animal sees a herd skulker attack or feed, it becomes immune to the herd skulker's One of the Herd for the next 24 hours, acting as it normally would when confronting a predator. Creatures immune to the charmed condition are immune to this trait.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The herd skulker transforms into a Large or smaller domesticated herd animal it can see, such as a cow, horse, sheep, or chicken, or back into its true, canine form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

bonus.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The herd skulker takes the Disengage or Hide action.

name: Hermit Skull
languages: understands languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The hermit skull has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has Surprise.

action.name: Ectoplasmic Tendril
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The hermitaur can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Scuttle
entries: As a bonus action, the hermitaur can moves up to its half speed in a straight line.

action.name: Claws
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Water Beam
entries: rw 4 to hit, reach 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) cold damage. On a hit, the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned with waterblight.

reaction.name: Retreat
entries: After being hit by an attack, the hermitaur can take the dodge action until the start of its next turn by retreating into its shell and using its shield-like claws to protect its head.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If the hertilod fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hertilod has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Shock Susceptibility
entries: If the hertilod takes lightning damage, its speed is halved until the end of its next turn, and it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or immediately regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which lands in a space within 10 feet of the hertilod and has the prone condition.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The hertilod can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hertilod makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) poison damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be swallowed by the hertilod. A swallowed creature has the blinded and restrained conditions, and it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the hertilod. At the start of each of the hertilod's turns, each swallowed creature takes 13 (2d12) poison damage from the poisonous secretion in the hertilod's gullet.

The hertilod's gullet can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the hertilod takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a swallowed creature, the hertilod must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which lands in a space within 10 feet of the hertilod and has the prone condition. If the hertilod dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.

legendary.name: Sprint
entries: The hertilod moves up to its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Feed (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The hertilod drains life from the creatures in its gullet to bolster itself. Each creature in the hertilod's gullet takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the hertilod regains a number of hit points equal to the damage.

action.name: Club
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The acolyte is a 1st-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save CD 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The acolyte has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: Hew has resistance to poison damage and advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of his turn, Hew can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the hex knight fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Eldritch War Magic
entries: When the hex knight uses its action to cast a spell or cantrip, it can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

trait.name: Hexblade's Curse (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the hex knight targets a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target is cursed for 1 minute. The curse ends early if the target dies, the hex knight dies, or it is incapacitated. Until the curse ends, the hex knight gains the following benefits:
It deals an extra 5 damage on damage rolls against the cursed target.
Any attack roll it makes against the cursed target is a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.
If the cursed target dies, the hex knight regains 20 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hex knight makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and the target gains disadvantage to its attack rolls and saving throws until the end of the Hex Knight's next turn.

reaction.name: Armor of Hexes
entries: When hit by an attack roll by a creature cursed by the hex knight's Hexblade's Curse, roll a d6. On a roll of 4 or higher, the attack instead misses the hex knight, regardless of its roll.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The hex knight makes a weapon attack.

legendary.name: Cantrip
entries: The hex knight casts a cantrip.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The hex knight moves up to half its speed.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The hex knight casts a spell from its list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as normal.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hex knight is a 17th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18, 10 to hit with spell attacks). It regains its expended spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest. It knows the following warlock spells:

name: Hexahedrooze

trait.name: Reactive Mutations
entries: Immediately after the ooze takes damage, it gains resistance to that damage type. The ooze can have up to two resistances from this trait. If the ooze has its maximum number of resistances, the oldest resistance is lost when a new one is gained.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks. It can replace one attack with Engulf.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Small or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the ooze enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 7 (2d6) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 13 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: mw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) acid damage and the target suffers one of the following random effects (roll a d6):
1. The target takes 3 (1d6) force damage.
2. The target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.
3. The target takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage.
4. The target takes 3 (1d6) slashing damage.
5. The target takes 3 (1d6) cold damage.
6. The target takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The ooze makes one Pseudopod attack

legendaryHeader: The ooze can take 1 legendary action, choosing the option below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The ooze regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

trait.name: Hexblade's Curse (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the hexblade targets a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target is cursed for 1 minute. The curse ends early if the target dies, the hexblade dies, or it is incapacitated. Until the curse ends, the hexblade gains the following benefits:
It deals an extra 3 damage on damage rolls against the cursed target.
Any attack roll it makes against the cursed target is a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.
If the cursed target dies, the hex knight regains 14 hit points.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Armor of Hexes
entries: When hit by an attack roll by a creature cursed by the hexblade's Hexblade's Curse, roll a d6. On a roll of 4 or higher, the attack instead misses the hexblade, regardless of its roll.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hexblade is an 11th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, 6 to hit with spell attacks). It regains its expended spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest. It knows the following warlock spells:

trait.name: Axiomatic Mind
entries: The hexton can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its instructions.

trait.name: Combat Ready
entries: The hexton has advantage on initiative rolls.

trait.name: Disintegration
entries: If the hexton dies, its body disintegrates into dust, leaving behind anything it was carrying.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If the hexton fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hexton makes one Pincer attack and two Tentacle attacks.

action.name: Pincer
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) force damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the hexton can't use this tentacle against other targets. The hexton has six tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

reaction.name: Counter Magic
entries: The hexton attempts to interrupt a creature it can see that is casting a spell. If the spell is 3rd level or lower, it fails and has no effect. If the spell is 4th level or higher, the hexton makes an Intelligence check (CD 10 + the spell's level). On a success, the spell fails and has no effect.

reaction.name: Lightning Rebuke
entries: When a creature within 120 feet of the hexton damages it, the hexton magically retaliates with an arc of lightning. The creature must make a CD 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hezrou makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

trait.name: Demonic Restoration
entries: If the hezrou dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hezrou has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 16, any creature that starts its turn in a 10-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the hezrou. Fallo: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack

entries: m 7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Leap

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The demon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Sickening Stench
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the hezrou must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. Until this poison ends, the target is stunned. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the hezrou's sickening stench for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hezrou makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Ruthless Command (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, the hezrou can issue a telepathic command whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 feet of it makes an attack roll. The creature takes 1d8 psychic damage and can add a d8 to its roll provided it can understand the hezrou. A creature can beneft from only one ruthless command die at a time. This effect ends if the hezrou is incapacitated.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The hezrou magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: The hezrou makes a claw attack.

legendary.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The hezrou magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The hezrou casts a spell from its list of innate spells, using a spell slot as normal.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hezrou's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14). The hezrou can innately cast the following spells, without providing material components:

trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the sphinx is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 9 (2d8) damage to the target.

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the sphinx's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The sphinx has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The sphinx's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sphinx makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws. If both claw attacks hit the same creature, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) slashing damage.

action.name: Beak
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) percing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Stunning Screech (Recarga 5)
entries: As a bonus action, the sphinx emits a shrill, earsplitting screech. Each creature within 60 feet of the sphinx and able to hear the screech succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Swallow
entries: A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained. It takes 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage automatically at the start of each of the hieroglyphicroc's turns. Only one Medium creature or two Small creatures can be inside the hieroglyphicroc at one time. A swallowed creature is unaffected by anything happening outside the hieroglyphicroc or by attacks from outside it. A swallowed creature can get out of the hieroglyphicroc by using 5 feet of movement, but only after the hieroglyphicroc is destroyed. A humanoid that dies inside a hieroglyphicroc reanimates as a zombie 1d4 rounds later, and is regurgitated by the hieroglyphicroc.

trait.name: Unholy Fortitude
entries: Hieroglyphicrocs are highly resistant to turning. They have tactical advantage on saving throws against being turned.

action.name: Bite
entries: m +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage. If the attack causes 16 or more damage to a Medium or smaller creature, the target must make a successful DC 13 Strength saving throw or be swallowed by the hieroglyphicroc (see above).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Levitate
entries: As a bonus action, a hierophant lich can rise or descend vertically up to 20 feet and can remain suspended there. This trait works like the levitate spell, except there is no duration, and the lich doesn't need to concentrate to continue levitating each round.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If it has a sacred vessel, a destroyed hierophant lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hp and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the vessel.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The hierophant lich has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Unholy Smite
