trait.name: Magma Form
entries: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the elemental or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or the weapon becomes stuck in the elemental. If the weapon's wielder can't or won't let go of the weapon, the wielder is grappled while the weapon is stuck. While stuck, the weapon can't be used. Until the grapple ends, the wielder takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. To end the grapple, the wielder can release the weapon or pull it free by taking an action to make a DC 16 Strength check and succeeding.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The incinis makes two magma fist attacks.

action.name: Magma Fist
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and 9 (2d8) fire damage.

action.name: Wave of Magma (Recarga 5)
entries: The incinis transforms into a wave of magma, moving up to its speed in a straight line. Each creature in the path where the incinis moves must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 21 (6d6) fire damage and, if it is a Large or smaller creature, it is pushed ahead of the incinis and knocked prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of where the incinis ends its movement. On a success, a target takes half the damage and is neither pushed nor knocked prone.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The inciter demon can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Aura of Distrust
entries: The inciter demon radiates a psychic aura that causes creatures to doubt the intentions of their friends. Each creature within 30 feet of the inciter that isn't a Fiend has disadvantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks. When a creature enters the aura's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, any spell cast by the creature can't affect allies or friendly creatures, including spells already in effect, such as bless, while it remains in the aura. In addition, the creature can't use the Help action or accept assistance from a friendly creature, including assistance from spells, such as bless or cure wounds, while it remains in the aura.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The inciter demon makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Inspire Violence (Recarga 5)
entries: The inciter demon whispers to a creature within 5 feet of it that can hear it, stoking paranoia and hatred. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or it uses its next action to make one attack against a creature that both the target and the inciter demon can see. A creature immune to being charmed isn't affected by the inciter demon's Inspire Violence.

bonus.name: Invisibility
entries: The inciter demon magically turns invisible until it attacks, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the inciter wears or carries is invisible with it.

name: Incomplete Dragon Skeleton
sourceGroup: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

action.name: Bite
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Impacto: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

name: Incorporeal Cauchemange
languages: the languages of its host, telepathy 60 ft.

trait.name: Happiness Susceptibility
entries: If a creature within 30 feet of the incorporeal cauchemange uses an action to make a DC 14 Charisma (Performance) check and succeeds, creating a presentation that inspires happiness or hope, the cauchemange has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of the performing creature's next turn.

trait.name: Implant Larva
entries: If a humanoid dies due to damage the incorporeal cauchemange deals, a cauchemange larva emerges from the corpse 8 hours later.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The cauchemange can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Nightmare Aura
entries: Each creature of the incorporeal cauchemange's choice that starts its turn within 60 feet of the cauchemange must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or sense the cauchemange as something to be feared, becoming frightened until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the Nightmare Aura of all cauchemanges for 1 hour.

trait.name: Psychic Teleport (Recarga 4)
entries: As its movement, the cauchemange can teleport to an unoccupied space within 40 ft. of it, provided that the space is within 10 ft. of a creature with an Intelligence score of 3 or higher. The cauchemange doesn't need to see the destination.

trait.name: Thought Location
entries: The incorporeal cauchemange can detect creatures within 60 feet that have an Intelligence of 2 or higher, provided they aren't constructs or undead.

Effects that prevent divination from working on a creature thwart this sense. This sense penetrates barriers, but 2 ft. of rock, 2 inches of any metal other than lead, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it. The cauchemange can't be Surprise by a creature it can sense.

action.name: Touch
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) psychic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Killing Nightmare (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The incorporeal cauchemange releases a telepathic wave of amplified horror. Each frightened creature of the cauchemange's choice within 30 feet of the cauchemange must make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw. On a failure by 5 or more, a creature drops to 0 hit points. If the save fails, the creature takes 25 (4d10 + 3) psychic damage.

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: The fiend ignores the range restriction on its telepathy when communicating with a creature it has charmed. The two don't even need to be on the same plane of existence.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The fiend can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Without wings, the fiend loses its flying speed. Other than its size and speed, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

action.name: Claw (Fiend Form Only)
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Charm
entries: One humanoid the fiend can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed for 1 day. The charmed target obeys the fiend's verbal or telepathic commands. If the target suffers any harm or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect on it ends, the target is immune to this fiend's Charm for the next 24 hours.
The fiend can have only one target charmed at a time. If it charms another, the effect on the previous target ends.

action.name: Draining Kiss
entries: The fiend kisses a creature charmed by it or a willing creature. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 32 (5d10 + 5) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The fiend magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

trait.name: Succubus Form
entries: When the incubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into a Succubus, using that stat block instead of this one. Any equipment it's wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The incubus makes two Restless Touch attacks.

action.name: Restless Touch
entries: m 7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target is cursed for 24 hours or until the incubus dies. Until the curse ends, the target gains no benefit from finishing Short Rests.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The incubus casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

bonus.name: Nightmare (Recarga 6)
entries: Salvación (wis): CD 15, one creature the incubus can see within 60 feet. Fallo: If the target has 20 Hit Points or fewer, it has the Unconscious condition for 1 hour, until it takes damage, or until a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it. Otherwise, the target takes 18 (4d8) Psychic damage.

trait.name: Angelic Weapons
entries: The deva's weapon attacks are magical. When the deva hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The deva has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deva makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Mace
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
entries: The deva touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 (4d8 + 2) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: The deva magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the deva's choice).

In a new form, the deva retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The deva's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save CD 17). The deva can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

name: Indentured Spirit
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

name: Indifferent Angel

trait.name: Weapons of the Damned
entries: The indifferent angel's
weapon attacks are magical. When the indifferent angel
hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra
1d8 psychic damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The indifferent angel has advantage
on saving throws against spells and other magical
effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The indifferent angel makes two mace
attacks.

action.name: Mace
entries: mw +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4 + 1d8) bludgeoning damage and psychic.

action.name: Inhibiting Presence (Recarga 6)
entries: Each creature within
60 feet of the indifferent angel must succeed on a
DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the indifferent
angel. The charmed target's speed becomes
0, and it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed. A
charmed target can repeat the saving throw at the end
of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a
success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the
effect ends for it, the target is immune to the indifferent
angel's Inhibiting Presence for the next 24 hours

legendary.name: Movement
entries: The indifferent angel moves up to its
speed.

legendary.name: Mace
entries: The indifferent angel makes a mace attack.

legendary.name: Healing (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The indifferent angel magically
regains 13 (3d8) hit points and is freed from any
curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The indifferent angel's spellcasting
ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately
cast the following spells, requiring only verbal
components:

legendaryHeader: The indifferent angel can take 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The indifferent angel regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The noble adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the noble must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

name: Infamous Bloodletter
sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the infamous bloodletter hits with it.

trait.name: Pistoliero
entries: When using a pistol, the Bloodletter has no disadvantage on ranged attacks when a hostile creature is within 5 feet of them.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Bloodletter makes 2 weapon attacks.

action.name: Cat O' Nine Tails.
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (3d4 + 4) slashing damage. If this attack hits a creature a second time in a turn, the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or becomes frightened until the end of the Bloodletter's next turn.

action.name: Flintlock Pistol
entries: rw 6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. This attack deals 7 (2d6) additional damage if the target is within 5 feet of the Bloodletter.

action.name: Punishment (Recarga 4)
entries: The Bloodletter unleashes a barrage of wild whip lashes. Each creature of the Bloodletter's choice in a 15-foot cube originating from the Bloodletter must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 15 (6d4) slashing damage and can't take reactions until the beginning of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and can still use reactions.

name: Infamous Cutthroat
sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark

trait.name: Surprise Opening
entries: In the first round of combat, the Cutthroats attacks against any surprised creature are made with advantage.

trait.name: Sneak Attack
entries: Once per turn, the infamous cutthroat deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the infamous cutthroat that isn't incapacitated and the infamous cutthroat doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Cutthroat makes 2 weapon attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: mw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: mw,rw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Infamous Fusilier
sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: The infamous fusilier can take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Fusilier makes 2 weapon attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: mw,rw +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Musket.
entries: rw 6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Blanket Fire.
entries: The Fusilier fires a buckshot in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save a creature takes 10 (4d4) piercing damage, cannot use bonus actions and reactions, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the Fusilier's next turn. A creature that fails its saving throw by 5 or more has its speed reduced to 0 instead. On a successful save a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effects.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 1 poison damage.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The hook horror can't use its blindsight while deafened.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The hook horror has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

name: Infected Corpse
sourceGroup: Dark Souls III: Lord Seeker's Compendium

trait.name: Fear of Fire
entries: If the grub takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature other than a construct or undead, they are also covered in leeches. While these leeches cover them, a creature loses 4 (1d8) hit points due to blood loss. A creature can scrape the leeches off as an action. The leeches also fall off if the creature takes fire damage or holds a lit torch.

action.name: Puke Leeches (Recarga 5)
entries: The corpse vomits leeches at a creature within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be covered in leeches. While these leeches cover them, a creature loses 9 (2d8) hit points at the start of each of its turns due to blood loss. A creature can scrape the leeches off as an action. The leeches also fall off if the creature takes fire damage or holds a lit torch. Constructs and undead are immune to these leeches.

name: Infected Elder Brain
sourceGroup: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk
languages: telepathy 1 mile; understands Common, Deep Speech, and Undercommon but can't speak

trait.name: Creature Sense
entries: The elder brain is aware of creatures within 1 mile of itself that have an Intelligence score of 4 or higher. It knows the distance and direction to each creature, as well as each one's Intelligence score, but can't sense anything else about it. A creature protected by a mind blank spell, a nondetection spell, or similar magic can't be perceived in this manner.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The elder brain has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Telepathic Hub
entries: The elder brain can use its telepathy to initiate and maintain telepathic conversations with up to ten creatures at a time. The elder brain can let those creatures telepathically hear each other while connected in this way.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elder brain makes two Tentacle attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 14) and takes 9 (1d8 + 5) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns until the grapple ends. The elder brain can have up to four targets grappled at a time.

action.name: Mind Blast (Recarga 5)
entries: Creatures of the elder brain's choice within 60 feet of itself must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or take 32 (5d10 + 5) psychic damage and have the stunned condition for 1 minute. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The elder brain casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

bonus.name: Psychic Link
entries: The elder brain targets one creature with the incapacitated condition that the elder brain senses with its Creature Sense trait and establishes a psychic link with the target. Until the link ends, the elder brain can perceive everything the target senses. The target becomes aware that something is linked to its mind once it no longer has the incapacitated condition, and the elder brain can terminate the link at any time (no action required). The target can use an action on its turn to attempt to break the link, doing so with a successful CD 17 Charisma check. If the target breaks the link this way, the target takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage. The link also ends if the target and the elder brain are more than 1 mile apart. The elder brain can form psychic links with up to ten creatures at a time.

name: Infected Townsperson
sourceGroup: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the berserker can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage.

trait.name: Cruelty
entries: If the infernal centaur scores a critical hit with a melee attack, it can make a second attack against the same target as a bonus action. It has advantage on this attack roll.

trait.name: Hell Hound Affinity
entries: hell hound view infernal centaurs as leaders of their packs. A hell hound refuses to attack an infernal centaur unless the centaur attacks it first. If magically coerced, the hell hound has disadvantage on attack rolls against the centaur. The centaur has advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks against hell hound.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The centaur has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the centaur's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The infernal centaur makes two dagger attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: mw,rw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Fiery Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: The infernal centaur exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the infernal centaur moves at least 30 feet
straight toward a target and then hits it with a pike
at-tack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10
(3d6) piercing damage.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The infernal centaur has advantage on
an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the
cen-taur's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and
the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The centaur makes two attacks: one
with its pike and one with its hooves or two with its
longbow.

action.name: Pike
entries: mw +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: rw +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Infernal Chancellor Lazivos

trait.name: Security for Speed (3/Day)
entries: When Lazivos fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead. When he does, his speed is halved and he can't take bonus actions or reactions until the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Lazivos has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

trait.name: True Name
entries: If a creature Lazivos can hear within 60 feet of him speaks his true name aloud, Lazivos loses his damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours. Lazivos's true name is Minto Abi.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lazivos makes three attacks using Infernal Rapier, Chancellor's Decree, or both.

action.name: Infernal Rapier
entries: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage, and the target is marked with an infernal sigil until the end of their next turn. While marked, a creature can't hide or benefit from being invisible, and attack rolls against them have advantage.

action.name: Chancellor's Decree
entries: rs 12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) psychic damage, and the target must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is charmed by Lazivos until the end of his next turn or until Lazivos or one of his allies harms the target.

action.name: Diabolic Deposition (Recarga 5)
entries: Lazivos commands the attention of each enemy within 30 feet of him who can hear him. Each target must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature must choose to either take 27 (6d8) fire damage plus 27 (6d8) psychic damage or be dazed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature must either choose to take half as much damage or be dazed until the end of their next turn. Succeed or fail, if a creature is already dazed, they must choose the damage

reaction.name: Devilish Charm
entries: When Lazivos is targeted by an attack, power, spell, or other supernatural effect by a creature he can see within 60 feet of him, the creature must make a CD 20 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is charmed by Lazivos until the start of the creature's next turn, and Lazivos chooses a new target he can see for the triggering effect. The new target must be within the triggering effect's range.

legendary.name: Action 1: Welcome, Friends
entries: Lazivos invokes an infernal word of power. Up to three enemies within 60 feet of him who can hear him must make a DC 20 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a target is charmed by Lazivos for 1 hour (save ends at end of turn) or until Lazivos or one of his allies harms the target. On a successful save, a target takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage.

legendary.name: Action 2: Heed My Commands!
entries: Lazivos and each ally within 60 feet of him moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each creature charmed by Lazivos moves up to half their speed in a direction he chooses (no action required).

legendary.name: Action 3: Deceptive Stratagem
entries: Lazivos switches places with a willing creature of his choice within 120 feet of him. Immediately afterward, up to five creatures of Lazivos's choice within 120 feet of him can make a melee attack (no action required).

bonus.name: As I Say
entries: Lazivos commands a creature charmed by him to use their reaction, if available, to make a weapon attack against a target of his choice.

legendaryHeader: Lazivos has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

trait.name: Infernal Brand (Recarga 6)
entries: As a bonus action, the infernal contractor chooses one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or become cursed for 1 minute.

A creature that has signed a contract with the contractor has disadvantage on this save. When the cursed creature makes an ability check, attack roll, or a saving throw, the target must roll a d6 and subtract the number rolled from the result. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The effect also ends if the contractor uses this trait again or the target enters hallowed ground.

action.name: Rapier
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage and 4 (1d8) fire damage.

action.name: Locate Signee
entries: The infernal contractor can sense the direction to any creature that has signed one of its contracts, provided that creature is on the same plane of existence. If the creature is moving, the contractor knows the direction of its movement. Effects that protect the target from divination work against this action.

reaction.name: Infernal Luck
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of the infernal contractor makes an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw against the contractor, the contractor can force that creature to reroll. The target must use the lower of the two rolls. A creature affected by this reaction is immune to the Infernal Luck of this infernal contractor for 24 hours.

trait.name: Fiendish Audacity
entries: The handler's AC includes its Charisma modifier.

trait.name: Fiendish Fury
entries: The handler deals an extra 16 (3d10) damage when it hits with a melee weapon attack (included in the attacks).

trait.name: Fiendish Vigour
entries: The handler gains 15 temporary hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the handler takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the handler's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The handler makes four attacks with its Morningstar or Tommybow.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: mw +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Brittlebone Splinterspray Tommybow
entries: rw 11 to hit, range 30/120 ft., two creatures within 5 feet of each other. Hit: 15 (4d4 + 5) piercing damage. Reload (5).

reaction.name: Guardian
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the handler is the target of an attack, the handler can choose to become the target of the attack instead of the original target.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The infernal harpy has advantage on
melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't
have all its hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The infernal harpy makes two melee attacks:
one with its bite and one with its talons.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Caustic Fluids
entries: The infernal harpy exudes a flow of
caustic fluids in a line that is 30 feet long and 4 feet
wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 13
Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) acid damage
on a failed save.
Giorgio Fratepietro

trait.name: Faultless Tracker
entries: If the infernal knight is given a quarry by its lord, the knight knows the direction and distance to its quarry as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The infernal knight has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The infernal knight's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The infernal knight regains 10 hp at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The infernal knight makes two melee attacks or uses its Hellfire Bolt twice. It can replace one attack with Reave Soul.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 17 (5d6) necrotic damage. A creature hit by the sword must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks based on Strength or Dexterity until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Hellfire Bolt
entries: rs 10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage plus 17 (5d6) necrotic damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

action.name: Reave Soul (Recarga 5)
entries: The infernal knight targets a creature with 0 hp that it can see within 60 feet of it. If the creature is alive, it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or die and have its soul drawn into the infernal knight's greatsword. If the creature is dead and has been dead for less than 1 minute, its soul is automatically captured. When the infernal knight captures a soul, it regains 30 hp, and Reave Soul recharges at the start of its next turn. While a creature's soul is trapped, that creature can't be returned to life by any means short of a wish spell.

A banishment spell targeted at the greatsword forces the infernal knight to make a Charisma saving throw against the spell. On a failed save, any souls trapped in the blade are released instead of the spell's normal effect. Trapped souls are also released when the infernal knight dies.

action.name: Planar Rift (1/Day)
entries: The infernal knight magically tears a rift in the fabric of the multiverse. The rift is a portal to a plane of the infernal knight's choice. The portal remains open for 1 hour, during which time any creature can pass through it, moving from one plane to the other. A dispel magic spell targeting the rift can destroy it if the caster succeeds on a DC 18 spellcasting ability check.

name: Infernal Medusa

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: Medusa fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magical Attacks
entries: Medusa's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Petrifying Gaze
entries: When a creature that can see Medusa's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of Medusa, Medusa can force it to make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw if Medusa isn't incapacitated and can see the crea-ture. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure (in this case, the Traveler is destroyed) or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see Medusa until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at Medusa in the meantime, it must immediately make the save. If Medusa sees itself reflected on a polished surface within 30 feet of it and in an area of bright light, Medusa is, due to her curse, affected by her own gaze.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Medusa makes three attacks: two with her snake hair and one with her constrict.

action.name: Snake Hair
entries: mw 122 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage, plus 21 (6d6) poison damage.

action.name: Constrict.
entries: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled. ntil this grapple ends, the target is restrained, it takes 9 (2d8) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns, and Medusa can't constrict another target.

legendary.name: Movement
entries: Medusa moves up to her speed without provoking attacks of opportunity

legendary.name: Snake Hair
entries: Medusa makes an attack with her snake hair.

legendary.name: Irresistible (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Medusa can force a grappled creature to stare into her eyes and suffer the effects of her petrifying gaze.

legendaryHeader: Medusa can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Medusa regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

name: Infernal Minotaur

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the infernal minotaur fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the infernal minotaur can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the infernal minotaur moves at least 15 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with its tusks on the same turn, the target takes an extra 27 (5d10) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Labyrinthine Recall
entries: The infernal minotaur can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The infernal minotaur deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Vulnerable Horns
entries: If a foe scores a critical hit against the Minotaur, they can decide to hit one of its horns, instead of dealing damage. In this case, one of its two horns will break and become an Infernal Artefact
available for the Travelers (see Horn of the Minotaur, page 175). If both horns are removed in this way, the minotaur can no longer use its gore.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Minotaur makes three attacks: two with its fists and one with its hooves.

action.name: First
entries: mw 14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: mw 14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage,If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Gore
entries: mw 14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (5d10 + 8) piercing damage.

action.name: Maze of the Minotaur (Recarga 6)
entries: The Minotaur banishes a creature it can see within 60 feet into a

labyrinthine demiplane. The target remains therefor 10 minutes or until it escapes the maze. The target can use its action to attempt to escape. When it does so, it makes a DC 15 Intelligence check. If it succeeds, it escapes, and the spell ends for it.

legendary.name: Movement
entries: The Minotaur moves up to his speed.

legendary.name: Fist
entries: The Minotaur makes a fist attack.

legendary.name: Cloud of Dust
entries: The Minotaur kicks the ground with its hooves, raising a whirling cloud of dust and stone shards. Any creature within 20 feet of the Minotaur must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, or be blinded until the end of the Minotaur's next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this effect until the end of the Minotaur's next turn.

legendary.name: Telluric Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Minotaur hits the ground, unleashing a small earthquake. All creature on the ground within 60 feet from the Minotaur must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw, or be knocked prone.

legendaryHeader: The Minotaur can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action op-tion can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Minotaur regains spent leg-endary actions at the start of its turn.

name: Infernal Swarm
languages: understands Infernal but can't speak, telepathy 60 ft.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the infernal swarm's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance.
entries: The infernal swarm has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Shaped Swarm
entries: As a bonus action, the swarm can shape itself into a Huge fiend or back into a shapeless mass. Its statistics are the same in each form, and it can't regain hp or gain temporary hp. If a creature is more than 10 feet away from the infernal swarm, it must take an action to visually inspect the fiend form and succeed on a DC 25 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern the Huge fiend is actually a swarm of Small insects. A creature within 10 feet of the swarm immediately discerns the truth.

While in fiend form, it can wield weapons and hold, grasp, push, pull, or interact with objects that might otherwise require a more humanoid form to accomplish. If the infernal swarm takes thunder damage while in its fiend form, it immediately changes to its shapeless form.
While in shapeless form, it can occupy another creature's space and vice versa and can move through any opening large enough for a Small fiend, but it can't grapple or be grappled.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: In fiend form, the infernal swarm makes three attacks: two with its scimitar and one with its slam, or three with its scimitar. In shapeless form, it makes three attacks with its bites.

action.name: Bites (Shapeless Form Only)
entries: mw +9 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 28 (8d6) piercing damage, or 14 (4d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half its hp or fewer.

action.name: Poisonous Barb
entries: rw +8 to hit, range 30/120, one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Scimitar (Fiend Form Only).
entries: mw +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Slam (Fiend Form Only)
entries: mw +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the infernal swarm can't slam another target. In addition, at the start of each of the target's turns, the target takes 14 (4d6) piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The infernal tormentor makes two greatsword attacks. It can use infernal leash in place of one attack.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Infernal Leash (Recarga 6)
entries: A flaming whip appears in the infernal tormentor's hand or from its greatsword and lashes at a creature the tormentor can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. A creature that has signed a fiendish contract has disadvantage on this save. On a failure, the creature takes 14 (4d6) fire damage, is pulled 10 feet closer to the tormentor, and is cursed for 1 minute or until the tormentor uses this action again. This curse also ends if the target enters hallowed ground.

While cursed, the target can't move more than 30 feet from the tormentor. Also while the curse lasts, the target takes 7 (2d6) extra fire damage from the tormentor's greatsword attacks. The tormentor can use a bonus action to move the target 10 feet to an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the tormentor. If this space is dangerous, the target receives a new saving throw before moving, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The infernal tormentor makes two greatsword attacks. It can use infernal leash in place of one attack.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Infernal Leash (Recarga 6)
entries: A flaming whip appears in the infernal tormentor's hand or from its greatsword and lashes at a creature the tormentor can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. A creature that has signed a fiendish contract has disadvantage on this save. On a failure, the creature takes 14 (4d6) fire damage, is pulled 10 feet closer to the tormentor, and is cursed for 1 minute or until the tormentor uses this action again. This curse also ends if the target enters hallowed ground.

While cursed, the target can't move more than 30 feet from the tormentor. Also while the curse lasts, the target takes 7 (2d6) extra fire damage from the tormentor's greatsword attacks. The tormentor can use a bonus action to move the target 10 feet to an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the tormentor. If this space is dangerous, the target receives a new saving throw before moving, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the infernal tutor's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The infernal tutor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Phrenic Weapons
entries: The infernal tutor's weapon attacks are magical. When the tutor hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d6 psychic damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Weaken Resolve
entries: The infernal tutor's speech is laced with subtle enchantments that make its words seem logical or profound, regardless of the actual words used. It has advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks against Humanoids.

In addition, if the infernal tutor spends at least 1 minute conversing with a Humanoid, that creature has disadvantage on saving throws against the infernal tutor's Fiendish Indoctrination and against enchantment spells the tutor casts.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The infernal tutor makes three Claw or Tutor's Baton attacks, or it makes one Claw attack and two Tutor's Baton attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Claw (True Form Only)
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Tutor's Baton
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage. Instead of dealing psychic damage, the infernal tutor can cause the target to become incapacitated until the end of the target's next turn.

action.name: Fiendish Indoctrination (Recarga 5)
entries: The infernal tutor speaks fiendish ideals couched in persuasive, scholarly language. Each creature within 30 feet of the tutor must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 (13d6) psychic damage and is charmed for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't charmed. A charmed creature isn't under the tutor's control, but it regards the tutor as a trusted friend, taking the tutor's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can. A charmed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is charmed for 1 day instead. Such a creature can repeat the saving throw only when it suffers harm or receives a suicidal command, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Strength of Character
entries: When the infernal tutor succeeds on a saving throw, the tutor responds with a scathing magical insult, if the source of the effect is a creature within 60 feet of the tutor. That creature must succeed on a CD 18 Wisdom saving throw or take 14 (4d6) psychic damage and have disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell cast by the infernal tutor.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The infernal tutor casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The infernal tutor magically transforms into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or back into its true, fiendish form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the infested duelist is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the duelist instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half the damage if it fails.

trait.name: Parasite Sense
entries: The infested duelist has advantage on attack rolls against poisoned creatures.

trait.name: Plant-Powered Mobility
entries: opportunity attack made against an infested duelist have disadvantage. If the duelist is prone at the start of its turn, it can immediately stand without costing movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The infested duelist makes one Slam attack and two Shortsword attacks, or it makes two Thorn Shot attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, the target takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. The poisoned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Thorn Shot
entries: mw 10 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

reaction.name: Spore Cloud
entries: When the duelist takes damage from a ranged attack, it emits a burst of thick, yellow spores. The spores surround the infested duelist and heavily obscure the area within 5 feet of it. The spores dissipate at the start of the duelist's next turn.

trait.name: Knowledge Charm
entries: The infiltrator carries a minor magical charm gifted to it by the organization. While wearing or carrying the charm, the infiltrator has proficiency in any two skills and is fluent in any one language (not included above). This proficiency and fluency last until the charm is lost or destroyed or until the infiltrator performs a 10-minute ritual to change the proficiency and fluency provided by the charm. If the infiltrator dies, the charm becomes nonmagical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The infiltrator makes two Shortsword attacks and one Dagger attack. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: rw 4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The infiltrator casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: The infiltrator takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Swift Escape
entries: When inigo takes the dash action, he can spend 5 stamina to add +4 to his armor class until the beginning of his next turn.

trait.name: Sneak Attack
entries: Inigo can add 4d6 damage to one weapon attack per turn when he has advantage on an attack or if an ally is within 5 feet of his enemy.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: mw +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: rw +10 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Quick Dodge
entries: Inigo can spend 4 stamina to halve the damage of a weapon attack that he can see which targets him.

reaction.name: Punisher
entries: When an enemy misses with an attack within 5 feet, he can use his reaction to make a shortblade attack, which has advantage and critically hits on a 19 or 20.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: Inigo can take the dash, disengage, or hide action as a bonus action.

name: Initiate of Fortifying Flames
sourceGroup: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms

trait.name: Reinforcement (1/Turn)
entries: When the initiate takes damage from an attack while it is wielding a shield, it can reduce the damage by 2.

action.name: Mace
entries: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Elemental Strike
entries: ms,rs 4 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) fire damage for a melee attack, or 4 (1d4 + 2) fire damage for a ranged attack.

spellcasting.name: Spells
headerEntries: The initiate is a 2nd-level spellcaster. It uses Wisdom as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, 4 to hit with spell attacks). The initiate has the following bender spells prepared from the fire elemental affinity spell list:

bonus.name: Elemental Combo
entries: After the initiate casts one of its limited-use spells or makes a Mace or Elemental Strike attack on its turn, it makes one Elemental Strike attack. This attack deals 4 (1d4 + 2) fire damage for a melee attack or 2 (1d4) fire damage for a ranged attack.

bonus.name: Primordial Shield
entries: The initiate creates a shield, granting it or a willing creature within 30 feet of it 1d6 temporary hit points. These temporary hit points are lost when the initiate uses this bonus action again.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The initiate has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The initiate makes two Comet Strike attacks.

action.name: Comet Strike
entries: ms,rs 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) force damage.

reaction.name: Moment of Foresight (1/Day)
entries: When hit by an attack roll, the initiate can force the attacker to reroll it and use the new roll, possibly causing the attack to miss.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The initiate casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

trait.name: Blessing of the Elder Elementals
entries: The initiate has advantage on saving throws against spells and abilities that deal acid, cold, fire, or lightning damage.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The initiate has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the initiate's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the initiate has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Versatility of the Elder Elementals
entries: As a bonus action, the initiate can change the damage of a spell it casts from acid, cold, fire, or lightning to another one of those elements.

action.name: Dagger
entries: mw,rw +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Gift of the Elder Elementals
entries: rs +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) acid, cold, fire, or lightning damage damage, and the target has disadvantage on its next saving throw against any of the initiate's spells that deal the chosen type of damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The initiate of the elder elementals is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13), 5 to hit with spell attacks). The initiate has the following wizard spells prepared:

name: Injector
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The injector makes four Syringe attacks. It can replace any number of attacks with uses of Booster Dose instead.

action.name: Syringe
entries: m 10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d4 + 6) Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to one of the following effects (roll 1d4; reroll if the injector has already used that effect during this turn):

entries.name: Lethal Injection
entries: The target takes 21 (6d6) Poison damage.

entries.name: Numbing Solution
entries: The target takes 9 (2d8) Cold damage and is subjected to the following effect: Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 16. Fallo: The target has the Frozen condition (DC 16).

entries.name: Mind Dampener
entries: The target takes 7 (2d6) Psychic damage and is subjected to the following effect: Salvación de Inteligencia (Intelligence): DC 16. Fallo: The target has the Bewildered condition (save ends).

entries.name: Induced Necrosis
entries: The target takes 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage and is subjected to the following effect: Salvación de Fuerza (Strength): DC 16. Fallo: The target has the Weakened condition (save ends).

action.name: Booster Dose
entries: The injector administers a tincture to a Friendly [Attitude] creature it can see within 5 feet that isn't a Construct, choosing from the effects below. Once a creature benefits from a tincture, it can't gain that benefit again until it finishes a Short Rest or Long Rest.

action.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries: The target can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action or make one weapon attack with Advantage.

action.name: Inoculation
entries: The injector chooses Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, or Poison damage. The target gains Resistance to the chosen damage type for 1 minute.

action.name: Restorative Fluid
entries: The target regains 35 10d6 Hit Points. If the target is already at its Hit Points Maximum, it gains these as Temporary Hit Points instead.

action.name: Focus
entries: The target has the Valor condition 1d4 for 1 minute.

reaction.name: Unstable Tank
entries: Disparador: The injector would take damage. Respuesta: The injector reduces that damage to 0, and one of its tanks violently explodes. The injector chooses one of the effects of its Syringe or Booster Dose. Each creature within 20 feet of it is affected as if the Injector hit it with its Syringe or used Booster Dose on it. The injector can't use that effect until it finishes a Long Rest.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the fallen archon's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The fallen archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fallen archon makes two Greatsword attacks, or makes one Greatsword attack and casts one spell that takes 1 action to cast.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The fallen archon magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying and any creatures it has grappled, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Castigating Strike
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the fallen archon deals damage to an ally, the fallen archon makes a melee weapon attack against that creature.

reaction.name: Injustice Strike (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, when the fallen archon hits a creature with a melee attack, the archon can deal extra damage depending on the target's alignment.
Any Good: 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.
Chaotic Neutral or Neutral: 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.
Chaotic Evil or Lawful Neutral: 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The injustice archon's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

name: Ink Devil
languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the ink devil's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ink devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Devil's Ink
entries: ms,rs 6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be marked with a small, fiendish tattoo for 24 hours. Devils have advantage on attack rolls against the marked target, and the target has disadvantage on saving throws against the spells and abilities of devils.

action.name: Corrupt Scroll
entries: The ink devil touches a scroll, corrupting it. A creature using the scroll must succeed a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw or the spell harms the caster (if an offensive spell), helps the nearest devil (if beneficial), or fails, consuming the scroll (if not offensive or if no devils are in range to benefit from the magic).

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The ink devil magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses Disrupt Concentration, or until its concentration ends (as if concentration on a spell). Any equipment the ink devil wears or carries is invisible with it.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The ink devil casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

bonus.name: Disrupt Concentration
entries: One spellcaster concentration on a spell within 30 feet of the ink devil that the devil can see must succeed on a CD 13 Wisdom saving throw or lose concentration on the spell.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ink guardian can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Bottled Rejuvenation
entries: When activated, the creature launches from its bottle, landing within 20 feet of the bottle. It starts as Tiny, and at the start of each of its turns, it increases in size by one step to a maximum of Large.

When the ink guardian is defeated, the bottle becomes inactive for 3d8 hours. After that time, the ink guardian regains all its hp and is active again. The bottle has AC of 20, 10 hp, and is immune to damage that isn't bludgeoning. If the bottle is destroyed, the ink guardian dies and can't rejuvenate.

trait.name: Selectively Caustic
entries: A creature that touches the ink guardian or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) acid damage. The ink guardian can eat through flesh quickly, but it doesn't harm metal, wood, or paper.

trait.name: Volatile
entries: When the ink guardian is subjected to thunder damage, it takes no damage and instead splashes onto creatures within 5 feet of it. Each creature in the area takes 4 (1d8) acid damage. When the ink guardian is reduced to 0 hp, it explodes. Each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: As a Medium or Large creature, the ink guardian makes two pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When an inkfester dies, it explodes in a burst of ink. Any creature within 5 feet of the inkfester must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The inkfester's normal form is a twodimensional pattern of runes on a flat surface. Until it takes an action or moves, the inkfester is indistinguishable from ink on that surface. As part of its action to attack, the inkfester can change form.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The inkfester can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Water Weakness
entries: If the inkfester is doused in water or ends its turn submerged in water, the inkfester takes 3 (1d6) acid damage. Maximize this damage if the water is soapy.

action.name: Fearful Glyphs
entries: The inkfester chooses up to two creatures within 30 ft. of and able to see it. Each target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or take 8 (2d6 + 1) psychic damage from disturbing symbolism and imagery.

action.name: Consuming Mist
entries: The inkfester takes on the form of a cloud of dark ink. In this form the inkfester has a fly speed of 20 feet and can hover, and it can occupy a hostile creature's space. In this form, the inkfester has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it's immune to nonmagical damage other than from acid or water.

Each creature that starts its turn in the inkfester's space must make a DC 12 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice). On a failure, a target takes 9 (2d6 + 2) acid damage. A Large or smaller creature is also grappled (escape DC 12). On a successful save, the target takes half the damage and isn't grappled. Any creature that remains in the inkfester's space can't breathe.

A creature within 5 feet of the inkfester can pull a creature or object out of it by taking an action and succeeding on a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check. However, the rescuer takes 3 (1d6) acid damage.

name: Inkling
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The inkling can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: A Thirst for Knowledge
entries: If an inkling spends 24 hours with a spellbook or a spell scroll, it can learn the magic of one 2ndlevel or lower spell, erasing and absorbing all the ink and magic used to inscribe the spell. The inkling can then cast the spell once per day.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The inkling has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Lash
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Redirect Spell
entries: If a spell attack hits the inkling, it can force the attacker to make a CD 12 Intelligence saving throw. If the attacker fails the saving throw, the spell is redirected to hit another creature of the inkling's choice within 30 feet.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The inkling's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12, 4 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring only somatic components:

name: Inkling Mascot
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The inkling can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Blot
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) psychic damage.

action.name: Ink Spray (1/Day)
entries: The inkling sprays viscous ink at one creature within 15 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the inkling's next turn.

bonus.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the inkling takes the Hide action.

name: Inkwalker
languages: can mimic sounds it has heard, and from prey it has eaten

trait.name: Adhesive (All Forms)
entries: The inkwalker adheres to anything that touches it. A Large or smaller creature adhered to the inkwalker is also grappled by it (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: In the first round of a combat, the inkwalker has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it Surprise.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The inkwalker has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The inkwalker can mimic sounds it has heard, including voices and animal noises. A creature that hears the sound it makes can tell they are imitations with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check opposed by the inkwalker's Charisma (Deception) check.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The inkwalker can use its action to polymorph into a CR 1/2 or lower beast or back into its true, amorphous shape. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Wall Walker
entries: The inkwalker can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.

trait.name: Normal Semblance
entries: The harvester has Advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Dexterity (Stealth) checks to pass itself off as an ordinary Small Humanoid such as a Human urchin or a Halfling.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The harvester makes two Surgical Claw attacks.

action.name: Surgical Claw
entries: m 5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4).

action.name: Syringe (1/Day)
entries: m 5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 11. Fallo: 28 (8d6) Poison damage. Éxito: Half damage. Fallo o Éxito: If this Poison damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it is stabilized but has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour, even if it regains Hit Points. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

action.name: Latch (Recarga 5)
entries: The harvester moves up to its Speed. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of a Medium or larger creature, it can make one Surgical Claw attack against that creature. Hit: The harvester attaches to the target. While attached, the harvester has Advantage on attack rolls against the target. The attached harvester moves with the target, using none of the harvester's movement. The harvester can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement on its turn. A creature within 5 feet, including the target, can take an action to detach the harvester with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: The harvester takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Aura of Judgement
entries: A creature hostile to the inquisitor that is within 10 feet of the inquisitor has disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened.

trait.name: Smite (1/Turn)
entries: As a bonus action, when the inquisitor hits a creature with a weapon attack, it can expend a 1st level spell slot to deal 2d8 necrotic or radiant damage to the target, and the target must succeed in a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened the end of its next turn. If the inquisitor expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 1st (maximum 5d8).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The inquisitor makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Flail
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: rw 1 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

trait.name: Inquisitor's Awareness
entries: The inquisitor hunter can expend a 1st-level ranger spell slot to sense for 1 minute whether arcane or innate spellcasters, aberrations, fey, and fiends are within 1 mile. This trait doesn't reveal the creatures' locations or numbers.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The inquisitor hunter makes two shortsword attacks, provided it has a shortsword in each hand.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage and 2 (1d4) psychic damage, or 5 (2d4) psychic damage if the target is concentration on a spell.

action.name: Longbow
entries: rw 4 to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage and 2 (1d4) psychic damage, or 5 (2d4) psychic damage if the target is concentration on a spell.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The inquisitor hunter is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom. The hunter knows the following ranger spells:

trait.name: Aura of Clarity
entries: While within 10 feet of a conscious inquisitior judge, creatures of the judge's choice can't be blinded or frightened, and creatures and objects can be invisible only if the judge allows it.

trait.name: Brand Heretic (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the inquisitior judge chooses one creature the judge can see within 30 feet of it. The judge marks the target as a heretic. For 1 minute, the judge's weapon attack rolls against the heretic score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. At the start of each of the heretic's turns, the judge can use a reaction to make one weapon attack against the heretic.

trait.name: Smite
entries: When the inquisitior judge hits with a melee weapon attack, it can expend one spell slot to deal extra radiant damage. The extra damage is 9 (2d8) for a 1stlevel spell slot, 13 (3d8) for a 2nd-level one, and 18 (4d8) for a 3rd level slot.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The judge makes two greatsword attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and 4 (1d8) radiant damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

trait.name: Brave
entries: The inquisitor knight has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

trait.name: Discerning
entries: The inquisitor knight has advantage on saving throws against illusions.

trait.name: Mark
entries: When the inquisitor knight hits a creature with a melee weapon attack, the knight marks that creature until the end of the knight's next turn. The mark ends early if the knight becomes incapacitated or dies, or someone else marks the same creature. While the marked creature is within the knight's reach, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than the knight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The inquisitor knight makes two attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, and Mark.

action.name: Javelin
entries: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage and, if used to make a melee attack, and Mark.

reaction.name: Marked Control
entries: If a creature subjected to the inquisitor knight's Mark moves while within 5 feet of the knight, the knight can make a melee attack against that creature. On a hit, the creature's speed drops to 0 until the end of their current turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The inquisitor makes three Silvered Longsword attacks or uses Mind Fire three times. It can replace one attack or one use of Mind Fire with a use of Spellcasting to cast Hold Monster if available.

action.name: Silvered Longsword
entries: m 8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the inquisitor's next turn. Critical Hit: If the target is a shape-shifted creature, it takes an additional 4 (1d8) Slashing damage.

action.name: Inquisitor's Command (Recarga 5)
entries: Salvación de Sabiduría (Wisdom): DC 16, each creature of the inquisitor's choice that it can see within 60 feet. Fallo: The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the inquisitor's next turn. On the Charmed target's turn, the inquisitor can telepathically control the target's move and make the target take the Attack action (the inquisitor chooses the target), the Dash action, or no action.

action.name: Mind Fire
entries: Salvación de Inteligencia (Intelligence): DC 16, one creature the inquisitor can see within 120 feet. Fallo: 9 (1d8 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of the inquisitor's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The inquisitor attacks twice with its Silver Longsword or uses Mind Fire twice.

entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) if used with two hands, plus 18 (4d8) force damage.

action.name: Mind Fire
entries: The inquisitor targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or take 17 (3d8 + 4) psychic damage and be stunned until the start of the inquisitor's next turn.

action.name: Inquisitor's Command (Recarga 5)
entries: Each creature of the inquisitor's choice that it can see within 60 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the start of the inquisitor's next turn. On the charmed target's turn, the inquisitor can telepathically control the target's move, action, or both. When controlled in this way, the target can take only the Attack (inquisitor chooses the target) or Dash action.

trait.name: Metabolic Control
entries: At the start of each of its turns, if the inquisitor has at least 1 Hit Points, it regains 10 Hit Points and can end one condition on itself.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Silvered Longsword

entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) if used with two hands, plus 18 (4d8) force damage.

entries: The inquisitor teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The inquisitor makes three Force Blade attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Otiluke's Resilient Sphere or Telekinesis if available.

action.name: Force Blade
entries: m,r 7, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) Force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is pushed up to 10 feet straight away from the inquisitor.

entries: Salvación (dex): CD 15, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere [Area of Effect] centered on a point the inquisitor can see within 120 feet. Fallo: 27 (6d8) Force damage, and the target has the Prone condition and is pulled up to 20 feet straight toward the Sphere [Area of Effect]'s center. Éxito: Half damage only.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The inquisitor attacks twice.

action.name: Force Bolt
entries: rs 7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) force damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, the inquisitor can push it up to 10 feet away.

action.name: Silver Longsword
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) if used with two hands, plus 18 (4d8) force damage.

action.name: Implode (Recarga 4)
entries: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the inquisitor can see within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 31 (6d8 + 4) force damage and be knocked prone and moved to the unoccupied space closest to the sphere's center. Large and smaller objects that aren't being worn or carried in the sphere automatically take the damage and are similarly moved.

reaction.name: Telekinetic Deflection
entries: In response to being hit by an attack roll, the inquisitor increases its AC by 4 against the attack. If this causes the attack to miss, the attacker is hit by the attack instead.

entries: If the inquisitor priest casts a spell that causes creatures to regain hit points, the priest can also end the effects of one spell affecting one creature that regained hit points. The ended effects must be from a spell of a level equal to or lower than the spell slot the priest used to cast the healing spell.

entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and 9 (2d8) force damage, or 13 (3d8) force damage if the target is concentration on a spell.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
