Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands, and the target is marked until the end of the lizardfolk's next turn. This effect ends early if the lizardfolk is incapacitated or it dies, or if someone else marks the target. While it is within 5 feet of the lizardfolk, a creature marked by the lizardfolk has disadvantage on any attack roll that doesn't target the lizardfolk.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The lizardfolk adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the lizardfolk must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

bonus.name: Punish the Marked
entries: The lizardfolk makes a melee weapon attack against a creature marked by it if the creature dealt damage to anyone other than the lizardfolk during the last turn. The lizardfolk's melee weapon attack has advantage on the attack roll, and if it hits, the attack's weapon deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage to the target.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The lizardfolk is a 7th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, 4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The zombie doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Heavy Club
entries: mw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Sudden Lunge
entries: If an enemy moves within 10 feet of the zombie, roll a d20. If the roll is 11 or higher, the zombie moves up to 5 feet toward the enemy. If the zombie ends within 5 feet of the target, the zombie can make one melee weapon attack against it.

trait.name: Artificial Form
entries: Llanna has advantages on saving throws against being poisoned and is immune to disease.
She does not need to eat, drink, sleep, or breathe.

trait.name: Faerie Glamour
entries: Llanna can cast the disguise self spell to appear as a flesh and blood half-elf child.

trait.name: Unchain the Beast
entries: Llanna can use a bonus action to transform into the clockwork horror for 1 minute. If Llanna's hit points are reduced to 0, she immediately transforms into the clockwork horror for 1 minute, falling unconscious at the end of that time. Once Llanna transforms into the clockwork horror, she can't do so again until she finishes a short or long rest.

action.name: Dagger
entries: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Deadly Sharpshooter
entries: Attacking at long range with a ranged weapon doesn't impose disadvantage on Llyvessa's attack rolls.

trait.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
entries: When a creature targets Llyvessa with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by her until the end of her next turn (no action required).

trait.name: Mind Link
entries: Llyvessa can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Llyvessa makes two Scimitar or Longbow attacks. Alternatively, she makes one Longbow attack and uses Psychic Shot, if available.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: rw 9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Psychic Shot (Recarga 5)
entries: Llyvessa makes a Longbow attack that ignores cover, and which can pass through mundane solid objects up to 5 feet thick that aren't being worn or carried.

reaction.name: *Control Projectiles (3/Day; 2nd-Order Power)
entries: When a creature Llyvessa can see within 60 feet of her makes a ranged weapon attack, she gives the creature advantage or disadvantage on the attack roll (her choice).

reaction.name: Shared Condition
entries: When Llyvessa is blinded, charmed, dazed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, or stunned, she chooses a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 feet of her who doesn't already have the condition or is immune to it. The chosen creature then gains the condition for the duration, and Llyvessa loses the condition. She can use this reaction even while incapacitated.

bonus.name: Jaunt (1/Day; 3rd-Order Power)
entries: Llyvessa or one willing creature within 5 feet of her teleports to an unoccupied space Llyvessa can see within 30 feet of her.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: The rig is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the rig must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

trait.name: Unstable
entries: If the rig takes damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated with a speed of 0 until a creature activates it with a successful DC 10 Intelligence (Arcana) check made as an action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The armor makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Digestive Enzymes
entries: The gag fly has Advantage on attack rolls against a Burning target.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The gag fly can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Proboscis
entries: m 5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

action.name: Acid Spray (Recarga 6)
entries: Salvación de Destreza (Dexterity): DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. Fallo: 5 (2d4) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (2d4 Acid). Éxito: Half damage only.

reaction.name: Bloat Burst
entries: Disparador: The gag fly is reduced to 0 Hit Points or takes damage from a Critical Hit. Salvación (dex): CD 12, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the gag fly. Fallo: 5 (2d4) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (2d4 Acid).

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The lob frog's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Poison Skin
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the lob frog hits it with a melee attack, that creature takes 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: m 4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage, and the target has the Distracted condition.

action.name: Throw Frogspawn
entries: r 4, range 30/60 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Acid damage. If the target is a creature, the egg sticks to the target's body, melding with its flesh. A creature within 5 feet of the egg can take an action to remove the egg, dealing 10 (3d6) Acid damage to the target in the process. If the egg is still attached to the target at the end of its next turn, the target is infected with a disease and has the Sickened condition until the disease ends. The disease can't be cured except by magic.

Every hour, the target is subjected to the following effect. Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 12. Fallo: The target gains one Contamination level. Contamination levels gained in this way can't be removed until the disease is cured. If the target suffers a Monstrous Transformation, it dies and its flesh falls away, birthing a Lob Frog.

trait.name: Danger From Above
entries: If the lobe lemur jumps at least 10 feet straight toward a creature from a higher position than the target, such as leaping down from a tree, it has advantage on the next attack roll it makes against that creature.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The lobe lemur's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Swamp Camouflage
entries: The lobe lemur has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lobe lemur makes three Claw Swipe attacks, or it makes one Face Clamp attack and two Claw Swipe attacks.

action.name: Claw Swipe
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Face Clamp
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage, and the lobe lemur attaches to the target's head. If the lobe lemur is already attached to the target when it hits with this attack, the attack doesn't deal damage.

Instead, the target is blinded until the end of its next turn. While attached to the target, the lobe lemur can attack no other creature except the target but has advantage on its attack rolls. The lemur's speed also becomes 0, it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed, and it moves with the target.

A creature, including the target, can take its action to detach the lemur by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength check. On its turn, the lemur can detach itself from the target by using 5 feet of movement.

trait.name: Leviathan Will
entries: The locathah has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned, or put to sleep.

trait.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries: The locathah can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The locathah makes two melee attacks with its spear.

action.name: Spear
entries: mw,rw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands.

trait.name: Leviathan Will
entries: The hunter has advantage on saving throws against spells and effects that control its actions.

trait.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries: The hunter can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hunter makes two attacks with its envenomed crossbow.

entries: rw 4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Club
entries: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Expert Lockpicker
entries: The locksmith can use any piece of its mechanical body to pick locks and disarm traps, as if its entire body was made up of several sets of thieves' tools. It is proficient in using pieces of itself in this way. In addition, the locksmith has advantage on ability checks to pick locks and disarm traps.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The locksmith makes two key blade attacks.

action.name: Key Blade
entries: mw +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Acid Wash (Recarga 5)
entries: The locksmith emits a cloud of rust in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The locksmith's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

name: Locust Preacher
sourceGroup: Dark Souls III: Lord Seeker's Compendium

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The locust preacher uses Feasting Branch five times.

action.name: Feasting Branch
entries: ms 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) force damage. On a critical hit, the preacher rolls for damage three times, instead of twice.

action.name: Wax Burst
entries: ms 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target has its speed reduced by 5 feet for 1 minute. Each time the target is hit by this attack, its speed is reduced by a further 5 feet, to a minimum of 0.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever Logger is subjected to lightning damage, they take no damage and instead regain a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Logger makes two Slam attacks. If they are in a fury (see Nature's Fury), they instead make three Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Entangling Vines
entries: Vines lash out from Logger's body.
Each enemy within 30 feet of them must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or take 9 (1d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and be grappled (escape DC 17) and pulled up to 30 feet directly toward Logger.

bonus.name: Nature's Fury (1/Day)
entries: Logger enters a fury for 1 minute.

While in a fury, Logger has advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and they can make an extra Slam attack when they use Multiattack. If Logger ends their turn without damaging another creature on that turn, the fury ends early.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The logger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The logger makes two handaxe attacks.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

name: Lohezet
sourceGroup: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

trait.name: Toxic Mastery
entries: Lohezet ignores a creature's resistance to poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lohezet makes three Withering Blast attacks and uses Miasma if it's available. He can replace one of the attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Withering Blast
entries: ms,rs 9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) necrotic damage.

action.name: Miasma (Recarga 4)
entries: Lohezet magically conjures a billowing cloud of purple fog in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of himself. The area within the sphere is Vision and Light, and when a creature starts its turn in the sphere or enters the sphere for the first time on a turn, it must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 39 (6d12) poison damage and is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned. The cloud lasts for 1 minute, until Lohezet ends it early (no action required), or until Lohezet uses this action again. A strong wind disperses the cloud.

reaction.name: Noxious Rebuke (3/Day)
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of Lohezet damages him, Lohezet magically retaliates with a spray of foul, purple mist. The creature must make a CD 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (2d10 + 5) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Lohezet casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

trait.name: Discorporation
entries: When Lolth drops to 0 hit points or dies, her body is destroyed but her essence travels back to her domain in the Abyss, and she is unable to take physical form for a time.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: Unless she wishes to be affected, Lolth is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. She has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: If Lolth has at least 1 hit point, she regains 30 hit points at the start of her turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Lolth can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Sense
entries: While in contact with a web, Lolth knows the exact location of any creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: Lolth ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lolth uses Web. She then makes one Bite attack, one Whip attack, and two Foreleg attacks or uses Insidious Bolt three times.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) force damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is reduced to 0 hit points, unless it is immune to poison damage. Otherwise, the target takes 22 (4d10) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute on a failed save.

action.name: Whip
entries: mw +15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) force damage plus 21 (6d6) poison damage, and the target has disadvantage to attack rolls and saving throws until the end of Lolth's next turn. In addition, the target must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward Lolth.

action.name: Foreleg
entries: mw +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) force damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). While grappled, the target is restrained, takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of Lolth's turns, and Lolth can't use one of her Foreleg attacks on another target.

action.name: Insidious Bolt
entries: rs +17 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) poison damage plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage, and the target is poisoned until the end of Lolth's next turn. While poisoned, the target can't use reactions and has disadvantage on saving throws.

action.name: Web
entries: rw +15 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one Huge or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained creature can make a DC 22 Strength check, escaping from the webbing on a success. The effect ends if the webbing is destroyed. The webbing has AC 15, 20 hit points, resistance to bludgeoning damage, and immunity to acid, poison, and psychic damage.

legendary.name: Insidious Poison
entries: Lolth chooses one creature within 30 feet that she has poisoned. The target must make a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target uses its reaction to move up to half its speed as Lolth directs and make one weapon attack against a visible creature of Lolth's choice.

legendary.name: Web
entries: Lolth uses Web.

legendary.name: Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Lolth makes a Whip or Foreleg attack.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Lolth uses Spellcasting.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

will: alter self (can become a Medium female Drow when changing her appearance)

trait.name: Psychic Leech
entries: At the start of each of the sorrowsworn's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

trait.name: Thrives on Company
entries: The sorrowsworn has advantage on attack rolls while it is within 30 feet of at least two other creatures. It otherwise has disadvantage on attack rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sorrowsworn makes one Harpoon Arm attack, and it uses Sorrowful Embrace.

action.name: Harpoon Arm
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Large or smaller creature. The sorrowsworn has two harpoon arms and can grapple up to two creatures at once.

action.name: Sorrowful Embrace
entries: Each creature grappled by the sorrowsworn must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In either case, the sorrowsworn pulls each of those creatures up to 30 feet straight toward it.

name: Lonelywood Banshee
sourceGroup: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden

trait.name: Detect Life
entries: The banshee can magically sense the presence of living creatures up to 5 miles away that aren't undead or constructs. She knows the general direction they're in but not their exact locations.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The banshee can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. She takes 5 (1d10) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object.

action.name: Corrupting Touch
entries: Ataque de conjuro cuerpo a cuerpo: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 12 (3d6 + 2) necrotic damage.

action.name: Horrifying Visage
entries: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the banshee that can see her must succeed on a CD 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the banshee is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the banshee's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Wail (1/Day)
entries: The banshee releases a mournful wail, provided that she isn't in sunlight. This wail has no effect on constructs and undead. All other creatures within 30 feet of her that can hear her must make a CD 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature drops to 0 hit points. On a success, a creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

trait.name: Intimidating Aura
entries: Elias projects a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] of imposing command. An ally that start its turn in the Emanation [Area of Effect] has Advantage on the first attack roll it makes before the start of its next turn. A Hostile [Attitude] creature that starts its turn in the Emenation takes 10 (3d6) Thunder damage and is subjected to the following effect. Salvación de Sabiduría (Wisdom): DC 16. Fallo: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Éxito: The target is immune to Elias's Intimidating Aura for 24 hours.

action.name: Elias always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On his turn, Elias can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Elias takes one of the following Epic Action at the end of each player character's turn:

entries.name: Lord Commander's Blade
entries: m 12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) Slashing damage, and Elias can apply one of the following martial masteries to the target:

entries.name: Wound
entries: The target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).

entries.name: Topple
entries: The target has the Prone condition.

entries.name: Sap
entries: The target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of start of Elias's next turn.

entries.name: Longbow
entries: r 12, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) Piercing damage, and Elias can apply one of the following martial masteries to the target:

entries.name: Push
entries: If the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 10 feet away from Elias.

entries.name: Slow
entries: The target has the Slowed condition (DC 15 Constitution save ends).

action.name: Command
entries: Elias chooses one ally he can see. If the ally can see and hear him, it can use its Reaction to make one weapon attack with Advantage. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage.

action.name: Flare (1/Round)
entries: Elias chooses a point he can see within 60 feet and fires at flare at it, signaling the Hooded Lantern's bombardment. Elias recharges his Artillery Strike. He can only use this Epic Action if it's the first Epic Action he has taken this round.

action.name: Artillery Strike (Recharge Special)
entries: Elias can only use this Epic Action if it's the last Epic Action he takes this round. Salvación de Destreza (Dexterity): DC 17, each creature in a 20-foot radius Sphere [Area of Effect] centered on the point Elias chose with his Flare Epic Action. Fallo: 18 (4d8) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Fire damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Éxito: Half damage only.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: Elias chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. Elias can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

trait.name: Survivor
entries: At the start of each of his turns, Elias Drexel regains 10 hit points if he has no more than half of his hit points left. He does not gain this benefit if he has 0 hit points.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when Elias Drexel hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Elias Drexel fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Elias Drexel wields a +3 Longsword, wears a +3 breastplate and the Lord Commander's Badge.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Elias Drexel uses Leadership. He then makes four attacks with either his longsword or his longbow.

action.name: Longsword
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: rw 7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Leadership (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, Elias Drexel can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that he can see within 120 feet of him makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a d4 to its roll provided it can hear and understand Elias Drexel. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if Elias Drexel is incapacitated.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Elias Drexel adds 5 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Elias Drexel must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Elias Drexel makes one weapon attack.

legendary.name: Command
entries: Elias Drexel chooses one ally he can see. If that ally can see and hear him, that ally can make one weapon attack as a reaction and gains advantage on the attack roll. The attack deals an extra 10 3d6 damage on a hit.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Elias Drexel is a 20th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16, 8 to hit with spell attacks). He knows the following ranger spells:

spells: tree stride (works on buildings instead of trees)

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Erasmus makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Master Tactician
entries: At the start of a combat encounter, Erasmus chooses when he acts in the initiative order after all other creatures have rolled initiative.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Erasmus makes two Greatsword attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of I'm Right Here.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, they have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than Erasmus until the end of their next turn.

action.name: I'm Right Here
entries: Erasmus taunts a creature he can see within 5 feet of him who can hear him. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to attack Erasmus. If the creature attacks, an ally within 30 feet of Erasmus who isn't incapacitated can make a weapon attack against the creature (no action required).

action.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
entries: If not in the Cyst, Erasmus teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, he teleports to a place he has visited.

bonus.name: Mark
entries: Erasmus chooses a creature he can see within 60 feet of him and marks them until the start of his next turn. The first time one of Erasmus's allies deals damage to a marked creature on each turn, the creature takes an extra 3 (1d6) damage.

bonus.name: Reposition
entries: Erasmus and each ally within 60 feet of him who can hear him moves up to 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Aura of Hunger
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Lord of the Feast takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Close-Quarters Hunter
entries: Being within 5 feet of a Hostile [Attitude] creature doesn't impose Disadvantage on the Lord of the Feast's ranged attack rolls.

trait.name: Hunter's Sense
entries: The Lord of the Feast has Advantage on attack rolls against a Bloodied creature.

trait.name: Predatory Senses
entries: The Lord of the Feast has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. He can pinpoint the position of any creature within 120 feet of him with the Invisible condition.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The Lord of the Feast regains 20 Hit Points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 Hit Points remaining.

action.name: The Lord of the Feast always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the Lord of the Feast can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Lord of the Feast takes one of the following Epic Action at the end of each player character's turn:

entries.name: Bite
entries: m 9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage. Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 17. Fallo: The target gains one Contamination level.

entries.name: Claws
entries: m 9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).

entries.name: Poison Arrow
entries: r 9, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) Poison damage. Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 17. Fallo: The target has the Poisoned condition (save ends).

entries.name: Ensnaring Arrow
entries: r 9, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Restrained condition (DC 17 Dexterity saving throw ends).

entries.name: Harpoon Arrow
entries: r 9, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and if the target is Huge or smaller, it is pulled up to 20 feet toward the Lord of the Feast.

action.name: Reposition
entries: The Lord of the Feast moves up to his Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

action.name: Call of the Hunt (1/Round)
entries: The Lord of the Feast releases a blood-curdling howl that can be heard all across Drakkenheim. All garmyr in the city heed this call and rush towards the Lord of the Feast's current position. Each garmyr within 60 feet who can see and hear the Lord of the Feast can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed and make one melee or ranged attack with Advantage.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Lord of the Feast chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. The Lord of the Feast can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Lord of the Feast fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The Lord of the Feast regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point remaining.

trait.name: Close-Quarters Hunter
entries: Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on the Lord of the Feast's ranged attack rolls.

trait.name: Predatory Senses
entries: The Lord of the Feast has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. He can pinpoint the position of any creature within 120 feet of him that is invisible.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Lord of the Feast makes three attacks: either one with each of its different arrow attacks, or one with his bite and two with his claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. A target hit by this attack must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of contamination.

action.name: Claws
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft, one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Contaminating Arrow
entries: rw 9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. A target hit by this attack must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of contamination.

action.name: Ensnaring Arrow
entries: rw 9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or become restrained in a magical snare for 1 minute. A restrained target can use its action to repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Harpoon Arrow
entries: rw 9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 20 feet directly toward the Lord of the Feast.

legendary.name: Dash
entries: The Lord of the Feast moves his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Arrow (Costs 2 actions)
entries: The Lord of the Feast makes one arrow attack of his choice.

legendary.name: Call of the Hunt (costs 3 actions)
entries: The Lord of the Feast releases a blood-curdling howl which can be heard all across Drakkenheim. Garmyr within 60 feet who can see and hear the Lord of the Feast can use their reaction to move up to half their speed and make one melee or ranged attack with advantage.

trait.name: Huntsman's Weapons
entries: The Lord of the Hunt's weapon attacks are magical. When he hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 14 (4d6) poison damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Lord of the Hunt fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Sure Seat
entries: While mounted and not incapacitated, the Lord of the Hunt can't be knocked prone, dismounted, or moved against his will.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Lord of the Hunt makes three Spear or Longbow attacks.

action.name: Spear
entries: mw,rw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, or 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage if used in two hands, plus 14 (4d6) poison damage. If the Lord of the Hunt throws the spear, the spear teleports up to 120 feet to the Lord of the Hunt's hand at the start of his next turn. If he has no hand free, the spear teleports to the ground at his feet.

action.name: Longbow
entries: rw 10 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

action.name: Hunter's Quarry
entries: The Lord of the Hunt magically calls 3d6 elk or boars, 1d4 giant boars or giant elk, or 1 elephant. The called Beasts arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the Lord and obeying its spoken commands. The Beasts remain for 1 hour, until the Lord dies, or until the Lord dismisses them as a bonus action. The Lord can have any number of Beasts under its control at one time provided the combined total CR of the Beasts is no higher than 8.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The Lord of the Hunt increases his AC by 6 against one attack that would hit him. To do so, he must see the attacker and must be wielding a melee weapon.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The Lord of the Hunt makes one Spear or Longbow attack.

legendary.name: Tenacious Stride
entries: The Lord of the Hunt moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If he is mounted, he can force the mount to move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks instead.

legendary.name: Call to the Hunt (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Lord of the Hunt blows his hunting horn and chooses one creature he can see within 60 feet. If the creature can hear the horn, it must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be charmed by the Lord of the Hunt for 8 hours. The charmed target obeys the Lord's verbal commands. If the target suffers any harm or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect on it ends, the target is immune to the Lord's Call to the Hunt for the next 24 hours. The Lord can have only one target charmed at a time. If he charms another, the effect on the previous target ends.

bonus.name: Fey Mount
entries: The Lord of the Hunt can summon or dismiss a magical Fey mount, mounting or dismounting it as part of this bonus action without spending movement. The mount uses the statistics of a warhorse, except it has 40 hp, is a Fey, has the same damage and condition resistances and immunities as the Lord of the Hunt, and uses the Lord's saving throw bonuses in place of its own. If the mount is slain, it disappears, leaving behind no physical form, and the Lord of the Hunt must wait 1 hour before summoning the mount again.

trait.name: Bird Passivism
entries: No bird or ravenfolk can willingly attack Sampati. They can be forced to do so through magical means.

trait.name: Danger Sense
entries: Sampati has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and can't be surprised.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Sampati fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Sampati has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Sampati's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: Sampati has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of his allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If he dies, Sampati's soul reforms on the Astral Plane. In 1d6 days, it inhabits the body of another bird of prey on the Material Plane which becomes the Lord of Vultures with all of the hp and abilities thereof. Only killing every bird of prey on the Material Plane will prevent this trait from functioning.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: Sampati can use his action to polymorph into a Huge giant vulture, a Medium dark-skinned man with black and gold hair, or back into his true Large, winged humanoid form. His statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form with the exception that only Sampati's true and vulture forms retain his flying speed. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying transforms with him.

trait.name: Speak with Birds
entries: Sampati can communicate with birds as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: In humanoid or his true form, Sampati makes three spear attacks. In vulture form, he makes three attacks. one with his beak and two with his talons.

action.name: Spear (Humanoid or True Form Only)
entries: mw,rw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) radiant damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) radiant damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack. If Sampati throws the spear, it magically reforms in his hand immediately after the attack.

action.name: Beak (Vulture Form Only)
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (3d4 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) radiant damage.

action.name: Talons (Vulture Form Only)
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) if it is a Huge or smaller creature and Sampati isn't already grappling a creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 10 (3d6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Sampati moves up to half his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Wing Buffet (Costs 2 Actions; True or Vulture Form Only)
entries: Sampati beats his wings. Each creature within 10 feet of Sampati must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

legendary.name: Dive Bomb (Costs 2 Actions; True or Vulture Form Only)
entries: Sampati flies up to his speed and makes a spear or talon attack against one creature. If the attack hits, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing or slashing damage. Sampati must fly at least 30 feet straight towards the target to use this action. Sampati can't use this action if he is grappling a creature.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The lord of vultures's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

3e: conjure animals (birds only, cast as a 9th-level spell)

name: Lord Soth
sourceGroup: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Soth fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Soth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Marshal Undead
entries: Unless Soth is incapacitated, he and Undead creatures of his choice within 60 feet of him are immune to features that turn Undead.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: Soth doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Soth makes three Forsaken Brand attacks.

action.name: Forsaken Brand
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of Soth's next turn.

action.name: Cataclysmic Fire (1/Day)
entries: Soth hurls a magical ball of fire that explodes at a point he can see within 120 feet of himself. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 35 (10d6) fire damage and 35 (10d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Additionally, any Medium or smaller Humanoid killed by this damage, as well as every corpse of such a creature within the sphere, becomes a skeleton (see the Monster Manual) under Soth's control. The skeleton acts on Soth's initiative but immediately after his turn. Absent any other command, the skeleton tries to kill any non-Undead creature it encounters.

action.name: Word of Death (1/Day)
entries: Soth points at a creature he can see within 60 feet of himself and magically commands it to die. The target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 100 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target dies.

legendary.name: Implacable Maneuver
entries: Soth moves up to his speed or commands a mount he is riding to move up to its speed. The movement from this action doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. If he or his mount moves within 5 feet of a creature during this movement, he can force the creature to make a DC 20 Strength saving throw. The creature is knocked prone unless it succeeds on the saving throw.

legendary.name: Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Soth makes one Forsaken Brand attack.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Soth uses Spellcasting.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Soth casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):

trait.name: Darklord Restoration
entries: If Lord Soth dies, he revives with all his Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Sithicus.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Domain)
entries: If Lord Soth fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Lord Soth has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Marshal Undead
entries: Undead creatures of Lord Soth's choice (excluding himself) in a 60-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from him have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. Lord Soth can't use this trait if he has the Incapacitated condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lord Soth makes three Forsaken Brand attacks.

action.name: Forsaken Brand
entries: m 12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Cataclysmic Fire (Recarga 5)
entries: Salvación de Destreza (Dexterity): DC 19, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere [Area of Effect] centered on a point Lord Soth can see within 120 feet. Fallo: 24 (7d6) Fire damage plus 24 (7d6) Necrotic damage. Éxito: Half damage.

action.name: Face of Death (1/Day)
entries: Salvación de Carisma (Charisma): DC 19, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from Lord Soth. Fallo: 22 (4d10) Psychic damage, and the creature has the Frightened condition. Éxito: Half damage only. Fallo o Éxito: If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target dies.

legendary.name: Punish
entries: Lord Soth moves up to half his Speed, and he makes one Forsaken Brand attack.

legendary.name: Soth's Command
entries: Lord Soth casts Command (level 3 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Commanding Magic. Lord Soth can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

spellcasting.name: Commanding Magic (3/Day)
headerEntries: Lord Soth casts Dispel Magic, Hold Person, or Banishment (level 5 version), using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19).

name: Lord Syuul

trait.name: Draw In
entries: If Lord Syuul fails a saving throw while grappling at least one enemy, he can choose to release all grappled creatures and succeed on the saving throw instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lord Syuul makes two Tentacle or two Psionic Repeater attacks then manifests a power or uses Memory Transfer.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: mw 11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) psychic damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 19).

action.name: Psionic Repeater
entries: rw 11 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) force damage.

action.name: Brain Overload (1/Day; 6th-Order Power)
entries: Lord Syuul creates a sudden surge of energy in the mind of a creature he can see within 120 feet of him. The target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 77 (14d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target has a brain and is reduced to 0 hit points, their brain explodes, and if they can't survive without their brain, they die.

action.name: Flay (6th-Order Power)
entries: Lord Syuul shoots a 15-foot cone of psionic energy from his eyes. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Memory Transfer
entries: Lord Syuul psionically plunders the mind of each creature he is grappling. Each target must succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw or take 44 (8d10) psychic damage. If a target fails their saving throw and doesn't escape the grapple by the end of their next turn, they must choose one of these effects:

The target's proficiency bonus drops to 0, they can't form new thoughts or speak, and they have disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. Only the cure ailment power, a lesser restoration spell, or a similar supernatural effect can end this effect. Additionally, until Lord Syuul finishes a long rest, he gains a cumulative +5 bonus to damage rolls.

The target is charmed by Lord Syuul for 1 hour. While the target is charmed, Lord Syuul can issue the target telepathic commands (no action required), which the target does their best to obey. Each time the target takes damage, they can make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Guise (3rd-Order Power)
entries: Lord Syuul projects a psionic image over his body, transforming his appearance for 1 hour into that of a Medium creature he has seen. When he manifests this power, he can also change the appearance of any equipment he carries.

The changes wrought by this power fail to hold up to physical inspection. A creature can use an action to inspect Lord Syuul's appearance and make a DC 19 Intelligence (Investigation) check, noticing the image is a projection on a success.

reaction.name: Brain Drain
entries: When a creature grappled by Lord Syuul makes a saving throw against Memory Transfer, Lord Syuul momentarily weakens the creature and the creature has disadvantage on the saving throw.

legendary.name: Action 1: Mindblind
entries: Each enemy Lord Syuul can see within 60 feet of him must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can't see creatures other than Lord Syuul for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

legendary.name: Action 2: Was I Ever Here?
entries: Lord Syuul becomes invisible, teleports 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see, and can take the Hide action. At the same time, an illusory psionic image of Lord Syuul appears in the space he left, gesturing, speaking, and behaving as he chooses (no action required). A creature who touches the image for the first time on a turn or makes a melee attack against it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 21 (6d6) psychic damage because things can pass through it. Lord Syuul's invisibility ends and his image disappears at the end of his next turn.

legendary.name: Action 3: Mindshatter
entries: Each enemy Lord Syuul can see within 60 feet of him must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 55 (10d10) psychic damage and is dazed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't dazed.

bonus.name: Grappling Jaunt
entries: Lord Syuul and each creature grappled by him teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

legendaryHeader: Lord Syuul has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

name: Lord Zombie
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the lord fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any non-undead creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the lord must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the lord's Stench for 24 hours.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the lord to 0 hp, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the lord drops to 1 hp instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lord zombie makes two slam attacks. It can use its Life Drain in place of one slam attack.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

A humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a zombie under the lord's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The lord can have no more than twenty zombies under its control at one time.

legendary.name: Shambling Hordes
entries: The lord telepathically commands all zombies it controls within 1 mile to immediately move up to half their speed. A zombie that moves out of an enemy's reach because of this movement doesn't provoke an opportunity attack.

legendary.name: Life Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The lord makes a life drain attack.

legendary.name: Arise (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The lord targets a humanoid corpse within 30 feet, which rises as a zombie under the lord's control.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: The guard has advantage on saving throws against poison.

action.name: Halberd
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage.

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: On each of its turns, the spy can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The spy deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the spy that isn't incapacitated and the spy doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spy makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: rw 4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Scroll Bash
entries: ms 4 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage.

action.name: Reduce to Memory (Recarga 6)
entries: Thundering golden energy erupts around a creature the apprentice can see within 90 feet of it. The creature must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 33 (6d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Construct has disadvantage on the saving throw.

reaction.name: Learn from the Past (2/Day)
entries: When another creature within 60 feet of the apprentice misses a target with an attack roll, the apprentice magically enables the attacker to reroll the attack roll. It must use the new roll.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The apprentice casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pledgemage makes two Scroll Bash attacks.

action.name: Scroll Bash
entries: ms 5 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage.

action.name: Reduce to Memory (Recarga 5)
entries: Thundering golden energy erupts around a creature the pledgemage can see within 90 feet of it. The creature must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Construct has disadvantage on the saving throw.

reaction.name: Learn from the Past (2/Day)
entries: When another creature within 60 feet of the pledgemage misses a target with an attack roll, the pledgemage magically enables the attacker to reroll the attack roll. It must use the new roll.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The pledgemage casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

bonus.name: Chronal Break (1/Day)
entries: The pledgemage chooses a point within 30 feet of itself, shunting the minds of nearby creatures out of this moment in time. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must succeed on a CD 13 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated until the end of the pledgemage's next turn.

trait.name: Voice from the Past (1/Day)
entries: The professor can cast the contact other plane spell to contact a long-dead spirit, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The professor makes two Spectral Scroll attacks. It can also use Weight of History, if available.

action.name: Spectral Scroll
entries: ms 7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) force damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Weight of History (Recarga 5)
entries: The professor magically compresses time around up to six creatures of its choice that it can see within 30 feet of itself. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be restrained for 1 minute, but the restrained target's speed is halved instead of being reduced to 0. At the start of each of its turns, the restrained target takes 4 (1d8) force damage. A restrained target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The professor casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:

trait.name: Voice from the Past (1/Day)
entries: The professor can cast the contact other plane spell to contact a long-dead spirit, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The professor makes two Repelling Burst attacks. It can also use Force Barrier, if available.

action.name: Repelling Burst
entries: ms 7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet directly away from the professor and become restrained until the start of professor's next turn.

action.name: Force Barrier (Recarga 5)
entries: The professor magically creates a wall of translucent, golden force within 90 feet of itself. The wall lasts for 1 minute or until the professor uses this action again. The barrier can be a vertical or horizontal plane up to 30 feet on a side or a 10-foot-radius hemispherical dome with a floor. The wall provides Cover. It has AC 17, 30 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

reaction.name: Arcane Stasis (2/Day)
entries: When a creature the professor can see within 60 feet of it casts a spell, the professor can magically lock the casting in the moment before completion. The spellcaster must succeed on a CD 15 saving throw using the spell's spellcasting ability, or the spell fails and is wasted.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The professor casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

trait.name: Alluring Presence
entries: When a Humanoid that can see the lorelei starts its turn within 30 feet of the lorelei, the lorelei can force it to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw if the lorelei isn't incapacitated and can see the Humanoid. On a failed save, the Humanoid is charmed until the start if its next turn. While charmed, the target is incapacitated and must move on its turn toward the lorelei by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the lorelei for a kiss from her. The Humanoid doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage, the Humanoid can repeat the saving throw. If the saving throw is successful, the effect ends for it, and it regains its senses for the remainder of its turn.

Unless surprised, a Humanoid can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the Humanoid does so, it can't see the lorelei until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the Humanoid looks at the lorelei in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The lorelei can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Free Water Spirit
entries: While in contact with water, the lorelei ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce her speed or cause her to be restrained. In addition, she can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lorelei can use her Stunning Glance. She then makes three Psychic Blast attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Corrupted Kiss.

action.name: Corrupted Kiss
entries: ms 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is incapacitated or restrained. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) necrotic damage, and the lorelei regains hp equal to that amount.

action.name: Psychic Blast
entries: ms,rs 8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) psychic damage.

action.name: Stunning Glance
entries: The lorelei sends a seductive glance at a creature she can see within 30 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature is immune to this lorelei's Stunning Glance for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: mw +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) force damage.

action.name: Elemental Bolt
entries: rs +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) acid damage, and the loremaster can choose between acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, radiant, or thunder damage.

reaction.name: Negate Spell (3/Day)
entries: The loremaster tries to interrupt a spell he sees a creature casting within 60 feet of him. If the spell is 3rd level or lower, the spell fails and has no effect. If the spell is 4th level or higher, the loremaster makes an Intelligence check against a DC of 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the spell fails and has no effect.

reaction.name: Protective Shield (3/Day)
entries: When the loremaster or a creature within 10 feet of it is hit by an attack roll, the loremaster gives the target a +5 bonus to its AC until the start of the loremaster's next turn, which can cause the triggering attack roll to miss.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The loremaster casts one of the following spells using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, 9 to hit with spell attacks):

bonus.name: Alter Energy Type (1/Turn)
entries: When the loremaster casts a spell and the spell deals acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, radiant, or thunder damage, it can substitute that damage with one other type from that list.

bonus.name: Alter Saving Throw (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When the loremaster casts a spell and the spell requires a saving throw, it can change the saving throw from one ability score to another of its choice.

bonus.name: Arcane Step (3/Day)
entries: The loremaster teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

name: Lorian, Elder Prince
sourceGroup: Dark Souls III: Lord Seeker's Compendium

trait.name: Brotherly Protection
entries: Lothric can ride on Lorian's back as if Lorian were one size larger. While riding Lorian, Lothric has three-quarters cover, automatically succeeds on saving throws, and attacks against Lothric have disadvantage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Lorian fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Mighty Wielder
entries: Lorian can wield a two-handed melee weapon in one hand and make attacks with it one-handed.

trait.name: Twin Soul
entries: While Lothric is still alive, Lorian can't die or be destroyed. Instead, if an attack or effect reduces Lorian to 0 hit points, or he is targeted by an effect that would instantly kill him, he is reduced to 0 hit points and is unconscious but stabilised. If Lothric dies, Lorian dies as well.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lorian makes two attacks with his greatsword.

action.name: Lorian's Greatsword
entries: mw 15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (6d6 + 8) magical slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.

action.name: Holy Flame Beam (Recarga 5)
entries: Lorian lifts his blade aloft, charging it with holy energy before slamming the sword down, releasing a radiant energy in a 100-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) radiant damage plus 22 (5d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: Lorian magically teleports up to 90 feet that he can see. If Lothric is on his back, Lorian brings him as well.

legendary.name: Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Lorian makes one melee weapon attack.

legendary.name: Flame Wave (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Lorian grasps his greatsword in two hands, swinging it forwards to create a 15-foot cone of fire. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Lorry Wanwillow
sourceGroup: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.

While in bat form, the vampire can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Misty Escape
entries: When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, the vampire transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has the following flaws:

entries.name: Forbiddance
entries: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

entries.name: Harmed by Running Water
entries: The vampire takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

entries.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire is incapacitated in its resting place, the vampire is paralyzed until the stake is removed.

entries.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The vampire takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
entries: The vampire makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Impacto: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape CD 18).

action.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the vampire, incapacitated, or restrained. Impacto: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.

action.name: Charm
entries: The vampire targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the vampire, the target must succeed on a CD 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by the vampire. The charmed target regards the vampire as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the vampire's control, it takes the vampire's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for the vampire's bite attack.

Each time the vampire or the vampire's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the vampire is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

action.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
entries: The vampire magically calls 2d4 swarms of |bats or |rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, the vampire can call 3d6 |wolves instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The vampire moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: The vampire makes one unarmed strike.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The vampire makes one bite attack.

trait.name: Antimagic Cone
entries: The beholder's central eye creates an area of antimagic, as in the antimagic field spell, in a 150-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the beholder decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active. The area works against the beholder's own eye rays.

action.name: Bite
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 14 (4d6) piercing damage.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The beholder shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three targets it can see within 120 feet of it:

entries.name: 1. Charm Ray
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a CD 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the beholder for 1 hour, or until the beholder harms the creature.

entries.name: 2. Paralyzing Ray
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a CD 16 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: 3. Fear Ray
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a CD 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: 4. Slowing Ray
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a CD 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target's speed is halved for 1 minute. In addition, the creature can't take reactions, and it can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: 5. Enervation Ray
entries: The targeted creature must make a CD 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: 6. Telekinetic Ray
entries: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a CD 16 Strength saving throw or the beholder moves it up to 30 feet in any direction. It is restrained by the ray's telekinetic grip until the start of the beholder's next turn or until the beholder is incapacitated.

If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The beholder can also exert fine control on objects with this ray, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

entries.name: 7. Sleep Ray
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a CD 16 Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep and remain unconscious for 1 minute. The target awakens if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to wake it. This ray has no effect on constructs and undead.

entries.name: 8. Petrification Ray
entries: The targeted creature must make a CD 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

entries.name: 9. Disintegration Ray
entries: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a CD 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 45 (10d8) force damage. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 hit points, its body becomes a pile of fine gray dust.

If the target is a Large or smaller nonmagical object or creation of magical force, it is disintegrated without a saving throw. If the target is a Huge or larger object or creation of magical force, this ray disintegrates a 10-foot cube of it.

entries.name: 10. Death Ray
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a CD 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 55 (10d10) necrotic damage. The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 hit points.

legendary.name: Eye Ray
entries: The beholder uses one random eye ray.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two attacks, using Stone Sword or Boulder in any combination.

action.name: Stone Sword
entries: m 8, reach 15 ft. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) Slashing damage.

action.name: Boulder
entries: r 8, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

bonus.name: Name Sleep (Recarga 5)
entries: The giant falls into a deep, restorative slumber. The giant gains 20 Temporary Hit Points and has the Unconscious condition until it takes damage or the end of its next turn. The giant has Advantage on ability checks and saving throws for 1 minute.

trait.name: Halfling Nimbleness
entries: <$title_short_name$> can move through a space of a Medium or larger creature.

trait.name: Brave
entries: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Ataque (mw,rw): +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Impacto: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mage is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save CD 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The mage has the following wizard spells prepared:

name: Lost Minotaur
languages: Understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the lost minotaur moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 13 (3d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The lost minotaur has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The lost minotaur has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Sense Life
entries: The lost minotaur can magically sense the presence of living creatures within 1 mile away. It knows each creature's general direction but not exact location.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The minotaur makes two twilight greataxe attacks.

action.name: Twilight Greataxe
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) slashing damage and 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Gore
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sorrowsworn makes two Arm Spike attacks.

action.name: Arm Spike
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Embrace (Recarga 4)
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the target is frightened, and it takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage at the end of each of its turns. The sorrowsworn can grapple only one creature at a time.

reaction.name: Tightening Embrace
entries: If the sorrowsworn takes damage, the creature grappled by Embrace takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: Lothar can mimic simple sounds he has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check.

action.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Lothar makes three Greataxe attacks.

action.name: Greataxe (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage, 14 (1d12 + 8) while in a rage.

action.name: Beak (Raven or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage in raven form, or 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage in hybrid form. If the target is Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with wereraven Player Characters as Lycanthropes.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: Lothar can use his action to polymorph into a raven-humanoid hybrid, or into a Small raven, or back into his true form, which is Humanoid. His statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. Lothar reverts to his true form if he dies.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Lothar casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, 4 to hit with spell attacks):

bonus.name: Rage
entries: Lothar rages for 1 minute. During his rage he has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. He gains a +4 bonus to damage while he is in a rage. He has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage while in a rage. Lothar can't cast spells while in a rage.

name: Lothric Knight
sourceGroup: Dark Souls III: Lord Seeker's Compendium

trait.name: Brave
entries: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

trait.name: Varied Weaponry
entries: The hollow has different action options based on which weapon it wields: a longsword or a spear.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The knight makes two attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

action.name: Lothric Spear
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Lothric Priest
