trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The mosasaurus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mosasaurus makes two attacks: one with its bite one with its tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 47 (6d12 + 8) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 18) . Until this grapple ends, the mosasarus can only bite the grappled creature and has advantage on attack rolls to do so.

action.name: Tail
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The mosasaurus makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the mosasaurus, and it takes 28 (8d6) acid damage at the start of each of the mosasaurus's turns. A mosasaurus can have only up to one Large, two Medium, or four Small creatures swallowed at a time.

If the mosasaurus takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the mosasaurus must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the mosasaurus. If the mosasaurus dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

trait.name: Forest Camouflage
entries: A moss lurker has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in forested terrain.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The moss lurker has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Poisoned Gifts
entries: A moss lurker can spend 1 minute stirring one of its red claws in a drink or cooked meal, contaminating the food or drink. A creature that eats or drinks the contaminated food or drink must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is also unconscious while poisoned in this way. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

action.name: Poisoned Claw
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Throw Stone
entries: rw 4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the target is at least 10 feet below the moss lurker, such as at the base of a cliff where the moss lurker stands, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or take 1d4 bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet the rock fell before hitting the target, to a maximum of 10d4.

name: Mossback Steward
languages: telepathy 120 ft, understands Goblin, Common, and Primordial but can't speak

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The tortoise can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Massive Frame
entries: The tortoise can carry up to 20,000 pounds of weight atop its shell, but moves at half speed if the weight exceeds 10,000 pounds. Medium or smaller creatures can move underneath the tortoise while it's not prone.
Any creature under the tortoise when it falls prone is grappled (escape CD 18). Until the grapple ends, the creature is prone and restrained.

action.name: Bite
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Impacto: 28 (3d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Shell Defense (Recarga 4)
entries: The tortoise withdraws into its shell, falls prone, and gains a +5 bonus to AC. While the tortoise is in its shell, its speed is 0 and can't increase. The tortoise can emerge from its shell as an action, whereupon it is no longer prone.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting

trait.name: Mushroom Hunter

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Lorinda can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Darklord Restoration
entries: If Lorinda dies, she revives with all her Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Tepest.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Domain)
entries: If Lorinda fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: Lorinda can mimic noises and animal sounds. A creature that hears the mimicry can tell it is an imitation only with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lorinda makes two Mother's Brand attacks.

action.name: Mother's Brand
entries: m 7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

legendary.name: Brand
entries: Lorinda teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet and can make one Mother's Brand attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Lorinda casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14, 6 to hit with spell attacks):
will: Invisibility (self only, and Lorinda leaves no tracks while Invisible)

spellcasting.name: Overwhelming Presence
headerEntries: Lorinda casts Slow, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Lorinda can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

bonus.name: Mother's Visage (1/Day)
entries: Lorinda shape-shifts into Mother, a deity revered by the people of Tepest, for 8 hours. Her game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.
While in the form of Mother, Lorinda can use Spellcasting to cast Charm Person as a Bonus Action.
Lorinda reverts to her true form if she drops to 50 Hit Points or fewer.

When Lorinda reverts to her true form, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from Lorinda is subjected to the following effect. Salvación (wis): CD 14 (the target succeeds automatically if it is a Construct or an Undead). Fallo: The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. While Frightened, the target has Disadvantage on saving throws.

name: Mother Moth
languages: Common, Druidic, Elven, Umbral, Sylvan, telepathy 120 ft.

trait.name: Cedar Weapons
entries: Mother Moth is vulnerable to weapons made from the wood of the cedar tree. When she is hit by a weapon made of cedarwood, Mother Moth takes damage as if the weapon was magical.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Mother Moth fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Mother Moth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Rejuvenating Chrysalis
entries: If killed while within a forest on the Plane of Shadow, a chrysalis appears within the confines of the forest, and Mother Moth emerges from it after 48 hours, regaining all her hp and becoming active again. Only the complete destruction of her chrysalis (AC 10, hp 30) prevents this trait from functioning.

trait.name: Shimmering Defense
entries: Mother Moth's wings emit a sparkling dust, giving her a slightly blurred appearance. Her AC includes her Wisdom modifier.

trait.name: Silk Sovereignty
entries: Mother Moth can communicate with all silk‑producing beasts as if they shared a language. Silk‑producing beasts cannot willingly attack Mother Moth, though they can be forced to do so through magical means. In addition, Mother Moth ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing and can't be restrained by webs or other silk-based material, such as a silk net.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mother Moth makes three Hornworm Scepter attacks or two Moon Bolt attacks. If she hits one creature with two Hornworm Scepter attacks, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or lose its lowest-level available spell slot. Mother Moth then regains hp equal to four times the level of the lost spell slot.

action.name: Hornworm Scepter
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) radiant damage.

action.name: Moon Bolt
entries: rs 9 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d10) radiant damage. If the target is a creature in a form other than its natural form, it takes an additional 5 (1d10) radiant damage and must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or revert to its natural form. When the moon bolt hits a target, moonlight glows in that space, shedding dim light until the start of Mother Moth's next turn.

action.name: Hundreds Dusting (Recarga 5)
entries: Mother Moth flaps her wings, creating a cloud of blinding powder around her. Each creature within 20 feet of her must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 (10d6) poison damage and is blinded for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: Cantrip
entries: Mother Moth casts a cantrip.

legendary.name: Moonlit Walk
entries: While in dim light, Mother Moth teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 100 feet of her. The space she chooses must be in dim light.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Mother Moth uses Spellcasting.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Mother Moth casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The mothfolk have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

trait.name: Disaster Sense
entries: The mothfolk have a natural understanding of when disaster may strike. The mothfolk get advantage on initiative rolls and Dexterity saving throws against effects that they can see and cannot be Surprise.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The mothfolk doesn't provoke opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mothfolk makes two kick attacks.

action.name: Kick
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Mothfolk Curse
entries: The mothfolk's red eyes glow with horrid magic. The mothfolk chooses one creature within 300 feet of it. That creature must succeed a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the target is immune to the Mothfolk Curse for 24 hours. A creature that is blinded is immune as well.

On a failure, the creature is under the effect of the Mothfolk Curse for 1 minute. When under the curse, the target's eyes turn red and it is charmed and frightened of any mothfolk it can see. The target gains the flaw "Get me away from those monsters hiding everywhere!" A remove curse, lesser restoration, or similar spell remove this curse. The target can attempt another Wisdom saving throw after 1 minute. On a success, the curse ends. On a failed save, the curse is permanent until removed.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The mountain dryad can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the dryad doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The mountain dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mountain's Aspect.
entries: Each day at sunrise, the mountain dryad chooses one of the following:

entries.name: Hardened Face.
entries: The mountain dryad chooses one of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage types. The mountain dryad has resistance to the chosen damage type until the next sunrise.

entries.name: Vaunted Peaks.
entries: The mountain dryad has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks until the next sunrise.

entries.name: Rockslider.
entries: As a bonus action once before the next sunrise, the mountain dryad can make the ground within 30 feet of it difficult terrain. This difficult terrain doesn't cost the dryad extra movement.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The mountain dryad deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mountain dryad makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: rw +13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Mountain's Awe (1/Day)
entries: The mountain dryad emits a magical aura that radiates out from it for 1 minute. Each creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the dryad must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. A charmed creature is incapacitated and, if it is more than 5 feet away from the mountain dryad, it must move on its turn toward the dryad by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet. It doesn't avoid opportunity attack, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the dryad, it can repeat the saving throw. While charmed within 5 feet of the dryad, a Medium or smaller creature must climb the dryad, no check required. After climbing 20 feet, the charmed creature throws itself off the mountain dryad, taking falling damage and landing prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the mountain dryad. A charmed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the mountain giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: A mountain giant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mountain Master
entries: The mountain giant can move and shape the terrain around it. This trait works like the move earth spell, except it has no duration, and the giant can manipulate any stone, natural or worked.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The mountain giant deals triple damage to objects and structures with its melee and ranged weapon attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mountain giant makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw 15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (2d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Boulder
entries: rw 15 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 40 (5d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Boulder Spray (Recarga 5)
entries: The mountain giant unleashes a barrage of boulders in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 58 (9d12) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone and restrained. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone or restrained. A target, including the restrained creature can take an action to make a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, freeing the restrained creature on a success.

legendary.name: Grasping Soil
entries: The mountain giant commands the earth itself to assist in the fight. The giant chooses three creatures it can see within 60 feet. Each target must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Roar (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The mountain giant emits a tremendous growl. Each creature within 20 feet of the giant must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (6d6) thunder damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

legendary.name: Spawn Elemental (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: rA piece of the mountain giant's body tears away in the form of an earth elemental. The earth elemental acts on the same initiative count as the mountain giant, obeying the mountain giant's commands and fighting until destroyed. The mountain giant can have no more than five earth elementals under its control at one time.

name: Mountain Goat
sourceGroup: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the goat moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The goat has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

action.name: Ram
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Hunter's Foresight
entries: The mountain nymph can see the immediate future of a creature affected by her hunter's mark spell. While hunter's mark is active on a creature, the mountain nymph has advantage on attack rolls against the creature and on saving throws against the creature's spells and special abilities.

trait.name: Mountain Walk
entries: The mountain nymph can move across and climb rocky surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of rocks or rocky debris doesn't cost her extra movement.

trait.name: Point Blank Hunter
entries: When the mountain nymph makes a ranged attack with a bow, she doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll from being within 5 feet of a hostile creature, though she may still have disadvantage from other sources.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mountain nymph makes three longbow attacks.

action.name: Longbow
entries: rw +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mountain nymph's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the mountain strider moves at least 15 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a headbutt attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the mountain strider and knocked prone.

trait.name: Sure-Footed.
entries: The mountain strider has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

action.name: Headbutt.
entries: mw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: mw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Thunderous Bleat (Recarga 6)
entries: The mountain strider releases a loud bleat in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Revenge for the Fallen.
entries: When an ally the mountain strider can see is reduced to 0 hp within 30 feet of the mountain strider, the strider can move up to half its speed and make a headbutt attack.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Overbearing
entries: As a bonus action, the troll can make a kick attack against a creature that is Medium or smaller.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its greatclub. It can use Cleaving Swing in place of one of its greatclub attacks, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) piercing damage.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the attack roll succeeds by 5 or more, the target must make a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 20 feet, knocked prone, and be stunned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Kick
entries: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Cleaving Swing (Recarga 5)
entries: The troll swings its greatclub, and every creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed saving throw, a creature takes 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

name: Mountain Troll
sourceGroup: Ultimate Bestiary: Revenge of the Horde

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The mountain troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The mountain troll regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. If the mountain troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the mountain troll's next turn. The mountain troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mountain troll makes two melee attacks, but can use its slam only once.

action.name: Kick
entries: mw +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be hurled up to 20 feet away.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., up to three targets no more than 5 ft. apart. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Stomp
entries: mw Each creature in a 10-foot-radius burst centered on the mountain troll must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Mounted Onryō
sourceGroup: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Appeasement
entries: At the start of the Onryō's turn, if it has 1 hit point and no non-Undead creature has attacked it since the start of its last turn, its soul calms. The Onryō dissipates into motes of emerald light and vanishes from this world, its rusted armour falling to the ground, empty.

trait.name: Spirit Weapons
entries: The Onryō can't be disarmed.

trait.name: Wrathful Undead
entries: If the Onryō takes damage that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead. This trait doesn't activate if the Onryō has taken radiant damage since the start of its last turn. In addition, while the Onryō has 1 hit point, its weapon attackes deal an extra 2 (1d4) necrotic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Onryō makes two attacks with any combination of Spirit Glaive and Spirit Bow.

action.name: Spirit Glaive
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) necrotic damage. If the target isn't an Undead, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw can't be frightened by this Onryō for 24 hours.

action.name: Spirit Bow
entries: rw 6 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) necrotic damage.

action.name: Soul Wrench (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The Onryō lets loose a hateful blast of necrotic magic, attempting to rend the soul of a weakened creature. One frightened creature the Onryō can see within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be reduced to 1 hit point.

bonus.name: Ghastly Charge
entries: The Onryō moves up to its speed in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. It can enter the spaces of other creatures while doing so, and each creature whose space it passes through in this way must succeed on a CD 14 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) cold damage.

trait.name: Danse Macabre (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action on each of its turns, the mourning minstrel can perform a magical requiem for 1 minute. Each undead of the minstrel's choice within 30 feet of and able to see or hear the minstrel rolls 1d4 with any ability check or saving throw, adding the number rolled to the result. A creature can be affected by only one effect of this type, including bless.

action.name: Rapier
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage and 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Death Note
entries: rs 5 to hit, range 30 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d8) psychic damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mourning minstrel is a 6th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, 5 to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following bard spells:

name: Mouruge
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the mouruge to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the mouruge drops to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mouruge attacks once with its bite and once with its slam.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage and 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The Mouse King has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Mouse King fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Mouse King has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The Mouse King's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If he dies, the Mouse King's soul reforms on the Astral Plane. In 1d6 days, it inhabits the body of another mouse or rat on the Material Plane which becomes the Mouse King with all of the hp and abilities thereof. Only killing every mouse and rat on the Material Plane will prevent this trait from functioning.

trait.name: Rodent Passivism
entries: No rodents, ratfolk, or wererats can willingly attack the Mouse King. They can be forced to do so through magical means.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The Mouse King can use his action to polymorph into a Medium black-haired human woman with dark skin and copper eyes or a Small white-haired halfling man with pale skin, dark eyes and a long moustache, a Medium mouse-humanoid hybrid, or back into his true Small mouse form. His statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form with the exception that only his hybrid and true forms retain his climbing speed. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying transforms with him.

trait.name: Speak with Rodents
entries: The Mouse King can communicate with rodents as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: The Mouse King wears a ring of spell turning.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: In mouse form, the Mouse King makes two bite attacks. In humanoid form, he makes three king's blade attacks. In hybrid form, he makes three attacks. two with his king's blade and one with his bite.

action.name: King's Blade (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite (Mouse or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 hour.

action.name: Summon Rodents (2/Day)
entries: The Mouse King magically calls 2d4 swarm of rats. In an urban environment, he can call 1d4 wererat instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the Mouse King and obeying his spoken commands. The creatures remain for 1 hour, until the Mouse King dies, or until the Mouse King dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary.name: King's Blade
entries: The Mouse King makes one king's blade attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Mouse King moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Quick Casting (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The Mouse King casts one innate spell.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mouse king's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Mouth of Chaos
entries: The giant is immune to the confusion spell.

On each of its turns, the giant uses all its movement to move toward the nearest creature or whatever else it might perceive as food. Roll a d10 at the start of each of the giant's turns to determine its action for that turn:

The giant makes three Fist attacks against one random creature within reach. If no creatures are within reach, the giant flies into a rage and gains advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
The giant makes one Fist attack against each creature within reach. If no creatures are within reach, the giant makes one Fist attack against itself.
The giant makes one Bite attack against one random creature within reach. If no other creatures are within reach, its eyes glaze over and it is stunned until the start of its next turn.

The giant makes one Bite attack and two Fist attacks against one random creature within reach. If no creatures are within reach, the giant flies into a rage and gains advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the giant magically regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

action.name: Fist
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Mouth of Madness
entries: The giant is immune to confusion spells and similar magic.

On each of its turns, the giant uses all its movement to move toward the nearest creature or whatever else it might perceive as food. Roll a d10 at the start of each of the giant's turns to determine its action for that turn:

1–3. The giant makes three attacks with its fists against one random target within its reach. If no other creatures are within its reach, the giant flies into a rage and gains advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
4–5. The giant makes one attack with its fist against every creature within its reach. If no other creatures are within its reach, the giant makes one fist attack against itself.

6–7. The giant makes one attack with its bite against one random target within its reach. If no other creatures are within its reach, its eyes glaze over and it becomes stunned until the start of its next turn.

8–10. The giant makes three attacks against one random target within its reach: one attack with its bite and two with its fists. If no other creatures are within its reach, the giant flies into a rage and gains advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the giant magically regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

action.name: Fist
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

name: Mr. Dory
languages: Abyssal, Common, Deep Speech, telepathy 60 ft.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Mr. Dory has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Water Dependency
entries: Mr. Dory takes 6 (1d12) acid damage at the end of every hour he goes without exposure to water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mr. Dory makes three attacks with his rapier.

action.name: Rapier
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Eye of Corruption (Recarga 5)
entries: Mr. Dory glares at a creature he can see within 30 feet of him. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 27 (5d10) necrotic damage and 27 (5d10) poison damage and then gains vulnerability to both necrotic and poison damage for 1 minute. On a successful save, it takes half damage and does not gain the vulnerabilities.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Mr. Dory's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (save DC 15, 7 to hit with spell attacks). Mr. Dory can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Brave
entries: Mr. Greystone has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when Mr. Greystone hits with it (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mr. Greystone makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Club
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: rw 5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The wererat can use its action to polymorph into a rat-humanoid hybrid or into a giant rat, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The wererat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: The wererat makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite.

action.name: Bite (Rat or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a CD 11 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with wererat Player Characters as Lycanthropes.

action.name: Shortsword (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Ataque con arma a distancia: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Impacto: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mu spore makes one bite attack or swallow attack, and up to two constrict attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (6d6 + 8) piercing damage and 21 (6d6) acid damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: mw 15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Huge or smaller creature. Hit: 41 (6d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 20) and restrained until this grapple ends.

action.name: Spore Cough (Recarga 4)
entries: A mu spore can release a cloud of burrowing spores in a 120-foot cone. The burrowing spores deal 110 (20d10) necrotic damage to all creatures and wooden structures in the area, or half damage to any creatures that succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. Plants and plant creatures are immune to this damage.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The mu spore makes one bite attack against a Huge or smaller target it is grapple. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the mu spore, and it takes 90 (20d8) acid damage at the start of each of the mu spore's turns. A mu spore can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the mu spore takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the mu spore must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the mu spore. If the mu spore dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

reaction.name: Grasping Tendrils
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the mu spore hits it with a melee attack, sticky tendrils reach to grab the attacker. The creature must succeed on a CD 20 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained (escape CD 20).

name: Mud Golem
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The mud golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mud golem makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Mud Ball
entries: rw 2 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Mud Golem
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The golem can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the golem remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal mudheap.

trait.name: Immutable Form

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Sticky Body
entries: When the golem is hit by a melee weapon attack, the attacker must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw, or the weapon becomes stuck to the golem's body. If the weapon's wielder can't or won't let go of the weapon, the wielder is grappled while the weapon is stuck. While stuck, the weapon can't be used. A creature can pull the weapon free by taking an action to make a DC 15 Strength check and succeeding.

trait.name: Unusual Nature

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two Slam attacks.

entries: mw +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target takes 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the golem's turns and the golem can't use one of its Slam attacks. While grappled in this way, the target is restrained, blinded, and at risk of suffocating. The golem can grapple up to one Large creature or two Medium or smaller creatures at a time.

name: Mud Hulk
sourceGroup: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The mud hulk can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

trait.name: Sticky Mud
entries: The ground within 15 feet of the mud hulk is difficult terrain for other creatures.

action.name: Enveloping Slam
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be pulled into the mud hulk's space and be engulfed by the mud hulk. While engulfed, the target can't breathe, has the restrained condition, and takes 6 (1d12) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. When the mud hulk moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The mud hulk can have only one target engulfed at a time. While a creature is engulfed, the mud hulk can't use its Amorphous trait.
An engulfed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, the target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space.

The affected area is difficult terrain until the start of the mud hulk's next turn.

trait.name: Central Stalk Weakness
entries: The mulcher's central stalk lies hidden within the mulcher's fungal mass. When exposed, the central stalk can be attacked and destroyed (AC 13; hp 50; vulnerability to acid, cold, and fire damage). If the central stalk is destroyed, the mulcher has disadvantage on attack rolls and can't use Expose Stalk until it regrows a new central stalk at the end of its next long rest.

trait.name: Disturbed Soil (Exposed Stalk Only)
entries: The ground within 20 feet of the mulcher is difficult terrain.

trait.name: Mulcher Pit
entries: If the mulcher burrows at least 20 feet straight toward a creature, it can dig a 10-foot diameter, 20-foot-deep pit beneath the creature. Each Large or smaller creature in the pit's area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall into the mycelium-lined pit and land prone, taking 14 (4d6) piercing damage from the spiked mycelium in addition to any falling damage. The mulcher can make one Mycelium Spike attack against a prone creature in the pit as a bonus action.

trait.name: Stalk Regeneration (Exposed Stalk Only)
entries: The mulcher gains 15 hp at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp.

action.name: Mycelium Spike
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 15) if the mulcher doesn't have two other creatures grappled.

action.name: Excavate
entries: While underground, the mulcher creates a 20-foot square cover on the ground over itself and lurks just below the surface. The cover is identical to the ground around it. When a creature enters the cover's space, the mulcher can make one Mycelium Spike attack against the creature as a reaction, destroying the cover. The target has disadvantage on the saving throw to avoid being grappled.

reaction.name: Emergent Stalk
entries: When the mulcher is reduced to below half its hp maximum or when a creature scores a critical hit against it, the mulcher immediately uses Expose Stalk.

bonus.name: Expose Stalk
entries: The mulcher exposes its central stalk above the ground until the end of its next turn or until it ends the effect as a bonus action. While the central stalk is exposed, the mulcher can't burrow.

bonus.name: Rapid Burrow
entries: The mulcher burrows up to 60 feet. Opportunity attack against it are made with disadvantage when the mulcher burrows out of an enemy's reach in this way. Creatures grappled by it are freed before it burrows.

entries: Blinding dust and sand swirls magically around the mummy lord. Each creature within 5 feet of the mummy lord must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendary.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The mummy lord utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the mummy lord that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the mummy lord's next turn.

legendary.name: Channel Negative Energy (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The mummy lord magically unleashes negative energy. Creatures within 60 feet of the mummy lord, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of the mummy lord's next turn.

legendary.name: Whirlwind of Sand (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The mummy lord magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand, moves up to 60 feet, and reverts to its normal form. While in whirlwind form, the mummy lord is immune to all damage, and it can't be grappled, petrified, knocked prone, restrained, or stunned. Equipment worn or carried by the mummy lord remain in its possession.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mummy lord is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, 9 to hit with spell attacks). The mummy lord has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
entries: If the mummy fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The mummy has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Undead Restoration
entries: If destroyed, the mummy gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the mummy's lair. The heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and Immunity to all damage except Fire.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack, and it uses Dreadful Glare.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: m 9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain Hit Points, it gains no benefit from finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Points maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.

action.name: Channel Negative Energy
entries: r 9, range 60 ft. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: Salvación de Sabiduría (Wisdom): DC 17, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. Fallo: 25 (6d6 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of the mummy's next turn.

reaction.name: Whirlwind of Sand
entries: Disparador: The mummy is hit by an attack roll. Respuesta: The mummy adds 2 to its AC against the attack, possibly causing the attack to miss, and the mummy teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Each creature of its choice that it can see within 5 feet of its destination space has the Blinded condition until the end of the mummy's next turn.

legendary.name: Glare
entries: The mummy uses Dreadful Glare. The mummy can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Necrotic Strike
entries: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mummy casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, 9 to hit with spell attacks):

spellcasting.name: Dread Command
headerEntries: The mummy casts Command (level 2 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The mummy can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Control Water (1/Day)
entries: A mummy of the deep can control water as the spell by using an action.

trait.name: Curse of the Deep
entries: When a mummy of the deep grapples a creature, it immediately uses a bonus action to press its mouth against the opponent's and spew sea water into the opponent's lungs. It then releases its grapple. The affected creature must make a successful DC 11 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns. An affected creature can act normally on a round when it makes a successful saving throw; if the saving throw fails, the creature takes 3 (1d6) necrotic damage and is stunned until the start of its next turn. The effect ends when the affected creature makes a third successful save. It can also be ended by a spell or other magical effect that neutralizes a curse.

trait.name: Despair
entries: At the sight of a mummy of the deep within 60 feet, the viewer must make a successful DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1d4 rounds. If the saving throw result is 5 or less, the creature is paralyzed instead. A successful saving throw renders the creature immune to any mummy of the deep's despair for 24 hours.

action.name: Fist
entries: m +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage and a target of Medium size or smaller must make a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled; see Curse of the Deep above.

name: Mummy Rotwrap
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the rotwrap takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the rotwrap takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Words of Ancient Doom (Group Attack)
entries: ms,rs 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 necrotic damage, and if three or more rotwraps joined the attack, the target can't speak or use telepathy until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The muraenid has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the muraenid's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Speak with Aquatic Creatures
entries: The muraenid can communicate with Beasts and Monstrosities that have a swimming speed as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The muraenid can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the muraenid can Bite only the grappled creature and has advantage on attack rolls to do so.

action.name: Telekinetic Grip
entries: One creature the muraenid can see within 60 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be moved up to 30 feet in a direction of the muraenid's choice and be restrained until the start of the muraenid's next turn.

If the muraenid targets an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, the object is moved up to 30 feet in a direction of the muraenid's choice. The muraenid can also use this action to exert fine control on objects, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

action.name: Lord of the Fishes (1/Day)
entries: One Beast with a swimming speed that the muraenid can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the muraenid for 1 day, or until the muraenid dies or is more than 1 mile from the target. The charmed target obeys the muraenid's verbal or telepathic commands, can't take reactions, and can telepathically communicate with the muraenid over any distance, provided the two are on the same plane of existence. If the target suffers any harm, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Explode
entries: When the comet drops to 0 hit points, it explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in the sphere must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The comet doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The comet sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The comet deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The comet doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The comet makes one Slam attack and one Spit Fire attack.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Spit Fire
entries: rw 5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) fire damage.

trait.name: Combat Mobility
entries: Opportunity attacks against a moving murder crow always have tactical disadvantage.

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: If a murder crow is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes into a swarm of ravens that continues to relentlessly attack all living creatures within sight. These ravens are undead, and they have tactical advantage on saving throws against being turned.

trait.name: Eye Rake
entries: If a murder crow hits the same target with its claws and beak in the same round, the target must make a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded for 1d4 rounds. If a creature is blinded more than once during an encounter, the condition lasts until the creature is healed of all damage or the blindness is removed magically.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: A murder crow attacks once with claws and once with its beak. If both attacks hit the same target, see Eye Rake above.

action.name: Claws
entries: m +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Beak
entries: m +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

trait.name: Enraged Cunning
entries: A murder of crows can hound its prey through most barriers. Simple latches, unsecured chimney flues, loosely shuttered windows, and similar obstacles rarely keep a murder of crows away. A murder of crows automatically bypasses many of these simple obstructions and can attempt a DC 15 Dexterity ability check to get through more complex obstructions (such as closed windows or simple barricades).

trait.name: Distracting Horde
entries: Creatures that share the swarm's space or are within 5 feet of it have disadvantage on attack rolls and Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration. The area of the swarm is considered difficult terrain.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The Swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny beast. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swarm can attack every creature in its space with swarming beaks.

action.name: Swarming Beaks
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or lower, and the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or become blinded until the end of the swarm's next turn.

name: Murder of Pitcrows
sourceGroup: L'Arsene's Ledger of Treasures and Trinkets

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The murder doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Multitudinous Mimicry
entries: The murder can simultaneously mimic one or more simple sounds it has heard, such as a person whispering, a crowd chattering, animals chittering, horses galloping, or an orchestra playing. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The murder has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the murder's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The murder can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny pitcrow. The murder can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The murder makes two Swarm of Beaks attacks. Alternatively, it uses Vicious Mockery six times, or three times if the swarm has half its hit points or fewer.

action.name: Swarm of Beaks
entries: mw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d8) piercing damage, or 13 (3d8) piercing damage if the murder has half its hit points or fewer.

action.name: Vicious Mockery
entries: The murder targets one creature that can hear it within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or take 7 (3d4) psychic damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Blood Aegis
entries: The AC of Murgaxor includes his Constitution modifier while he isn't wearing armor or wielding a shield.

trait.name: Oriq Mask
entries: Murgaxor wears an Oriq mask. While wearing the mask, Murgaxor can't be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors, and he adds double his proficiency bonus to Charisma (Deception) checks (included above).

trait.name: Sanguine Sense
entries: While Murgaxor isn't blinded, he can see any creature that isn't an Undead or a Construct within 60 feet of himself, even through Cover, Vision and Light areas, invisibility, or any other phenomena that would prevent sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Murgaxor makes two Blood Lash attacks.

action.name: Blood Lash
entries: ms 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of Murgaxor's next turn.

action.name: Blood Boil (Recarga 4)
entries: Murgaxor chooses a point within 150 feet of himself, and a 20-foot radius sphere centered on that point fills with a burst of searing, blood-red mist. Each creature of Murgaxor's choice that he can see in that area must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 38 (7d10) necrotic damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't incapacitated. A creature dies if reduced to 0 hit points by this necrotic damage.

name: Murgrik
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The murgrik has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hp.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The murgrik can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

trait.name: Keen Scent
entries: The murgrik has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Tentacle Flight
entries: The murgrik flies by spinning its tentacles. If it is grappling a creature with its tentacles, its flying speed is halved.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The murgrik makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its tentacles.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: mw +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18) if it is a Medium or smaller creature and the murgrik doesn't have two other creatures grappled. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained.

action.name: Stomach Maw
entries: The murgrik makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the murgrik, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the murgrik's turns. The murgrik can only have one creature swallowed at a time.

If the murgrik takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the murgrik must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 5 feet of the murgrik. If the murgrik dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Unsettling Ululations (Recarga 6).
entries: The stalk on the murgrik's head unleashes a dispiriting wail. Each creature within 30 feet of the murgrik that can hear it must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and is frightened for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't frightened. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Murkman
sourceGroup: Dark Souls III: Lord Seeker's Compendium

action.name: Wicked Sickle
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Great Soul Dreg
entries: The murkman transforms into a Large black shape and flies up to 90 feet in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. While moving in this way, it can move through other creatures' spaces without being slowed. Each creature whose space it moves through must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 44 (8d10) necrotic damage. At the end of this movement, the murkman dies.

action.name: Bury Alive (Recarga 6)
entries: The murkman attempts to drag a Medium or smaller creature into the ground. The target must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw, taking 52 (8d12) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it is dragged 4 feet below ground and is suffocating. While buried, the target has total cover, is heavily obscured, and must be unearthed to stop suffocating.

name: Murkman Summoner
sourceGroup: Dark Souls III: Lord Seeker's Compendium

action.name: Staff
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Deep Soul
entries: rs 6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Summon Murkman
entries: The murkman summoner magically summons 1d6 murkmen. These murkmen are allied with the summoner, roll their own initiative, and last until reduced to 0 hit points. While these murkmen last, the summoner can't use this action again.

name: Mush Marcher
languages: understands Common, plus one language known by its grower, but can't speak

trait.name: Partial Echolocation
entries: The mush marcher's blindsight is reduced to 10 feet while deafened.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mush marcher makes two Spore-Laced Claw attacks or one Mycelial Harpoon attack and one Spore-Laced Claw attack.

action.name: Mycelial Harpoon
entries: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 15/30 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the harpoon sticks in the target if it is a Medium or smaller creature. While the harpoon is stuck, the target takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns, the mush marcher can't make Mycelial Harpoon attacks against other targets, and the target and mush marcher can't move further than 30 feet away from each other. A creature, including the target, can take its action to detach the harpoon by succeeding on a DC 13 Strength check. Alternatively, the mycelial thread connecting the mush marcher to the harpoon can be attacked and destroyed (AC 12; hp 10; vulnerability to thunder damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage), dislodging the harpoon into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target and preventing the mush marcher from using Recall Harpoon.

action.name: Spore-Laced Claw
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

action.name: Slowing Spores (Recarga 5)
entries: The mush marcher releases spores from its cap. Each creature within 20 feet of the mush marcher must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 18 (4d8) poison damage and is poisoned. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. While poisoned in this way, a creature's speed is halved. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Recall Harpoon
entries: The mush marcher pulls on the mycelial threads connecting it to its harpoon, returning the harpoon to its empty hand. If the harpoon is stuck in a creature, that creature must succeed on a CD 13 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the mush marcher.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the mushamushi moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then immediately hits it with a Horn attack, the target takes an extra Hit: 5 (2d4) piercing damage.

trait.name: Small Fry
entries: The mushamushi has disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures of its size or smaller.

action.name: Horn
entries: mw 4 (Dex + PB) to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Kama
entries: mw 4 (Dex + PB) to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: The dwarf has advantage on saving throws against poison.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: Ataque (mw,rw): +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Impacto: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dwarf's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Musk (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The musk deer emits a pungent musk around itself for 1 minute. While the musk is active, a creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the deer must succeed on a CD 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

For 1 hour after a creature fails this saving throw, other creatures have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks to find or track the creature, unless the creature spends at least 10 minutes washing off the musk.

bonus.name: Sprinter
entries: The musk deer takes the Dash action.

trait.name: Blind
entries: A mustard jelly has no eyes, so it is immune to effects that depend on sight such as illusions or gaze attacks.

trait.name: Divide
entries: As an action, a mustard jelly with more than 10 hit points can split itself into two identical jellies, each with half of the original's current hit points (rounded down). For the first minute (10 rounds) after dividing, the newly divided jellies have speed 40 feet.

trait.name: Energy Absorption
entries: When a mustard jelly is targeted by a magic missile spell or when it would take lightning damage, it takes no damage but instead gains temporary hit points equal to the damage the attack should have caused.

trait.name: Poison Aura
entries: A mustard jelly exudes a poisonous vapor. Every creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of a mustard jelly must make a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be restrained for as long as it remains within 10 feet of any mustard jelly and for 1d4 rounds afterward. This is a poison effect, not physical restraint.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: A mustard jelly makes one slam attack, plus up to five constriction attacks against grappled creatures.

action.name: Slam
entries: m +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage and the target must make a successful DC 13 Strength saving throw or be grappled. A mustard jelly can have up to five creatures grappled at once and still make slam attacks; it can grapple a sixth creature, but it can't make slam attacks while it has six creatures grappled.

action.name: Constrict
entries: m automatic hit, one creature already grappled by the mustard jelly at the start of the jelly's turn. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) acid damage.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The musteval has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The musteval has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Speak With Beasts
entries: The musteval can communicate with beasts as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The musteval makes one Dagger attack and casts one spell that takes 1 action to cast.

action.name: Dagger
entries: mw,rw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage. The attack deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage if the musteval has advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Cunning Action
entries: On each of its turns, the musteval can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The musteval casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The musteval makes two Bone Blade attacks.

action.name: Bone Blade
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) radiant damage.

reaction.name: Skirmish Movement
entries: When a creature ends its turn within 5 feet of the musteval, the musteval can move up to half its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The musteval casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability:

trait.name: Noxious Blood
entries: When a creature hits the mutagenist with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the creature takes 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mutagenist makes two Scalpel attacks and uses Forced Mutation.

action.name: Scalpel
entries: m 7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d6).

action.name: Forced Mutation
entries: Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 15, one creature the mutagenist can see within 60 feet. Fallo: 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage, and the target gains a randomly determined mutation. The mutation lasts for 1 minute, and afterwards, any lost body parts are restored. Éxito: Half damage only.

action.name: Transmogrifying Elixir (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The mutagenist injects itself with a transmogrifying elixir. The mutagenist transforms, using the Grotesque Gargantuan stat block for their altered form. The mutagenist reverts to its normal form after 1 hour or if its transmogrified form is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

reaction.name: Desperate Transformation
entries: Disparador: The mutagenist is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Respuesta: The mutagenist uses Transmogrifying Elixir, if available.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mutagenist casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to spell attacks):

bonus.name: Anatomical Precision
entries: The mutagenist gains Advantage on Scalpel attacks until the start of its next turn, as long as it has not moved this turn. The mutagenist's Speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.

name: Mutated Drow
sourceGroup: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The giant has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two morningstar attacks.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Impacto: 21 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ataque con arma a distancia: +12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Impacto: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The drow's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). The drow can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

action.name: Dagger
entries: mw,rw 2 to hit. reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Mwaxanaré is a 2nd-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, 5 to hit with spell attacks). She regains her expended spell slots when she finishes a short or long rest. She knows the following warlock spells:

trait.name: Necrotic Absorption
entries: Whenever Mycete is subjected to necrotic damage, she takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

action.name: Parasitic Spores
entries: ms,rs 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, Mycete regains 3 (1d6) hit points.

action.name: Fungal Growth
entries: Mycete causes fungi to proliferate from a point she can see within 60 feet of her. Solid surfaces in a 10-foot square centered on that point become difficult terrain, and a creature who enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Animate Husks (1/Day)
entries: Mycete animates three rotting zombies, who appear in unoccupied spaces Mycete can see within 30 feet of her. The zombies act immediately after Mycete on the same initiative count and follow her verbal orders. If Mycete dies, the zombies are destroyed.

It remains for 1 minute, until it or its summoner dies, or until its summoner dismisses it as an action.

name: Nachzehrer
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Grave Pox
entries: A creature infected with grave pox becomes vulnerable to necrotic damage and gains one level of exhaustion that can't be removed until the disease is cured. Additionally, the creature cannot reduce its exhaustion by finishing a long rest. The infected creature is highly contagious. Each creature that touches it, or that is within 10 feet of it when it finishes a long rest, must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or also contract grave pox.

When an infected creature finishes a long rest, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion. As the disease progresses, the infected creature becomes weaker and develops painful green pustules all over its skin. A creature that succeeds on two saving throws against the disease recovers from it. The cured creature is no longer vulnerable to necrotic damage and can remove exhaustion levels as normal.

trait.name: Weakening Shadow
entries: A creature other than a construct or undead has disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks based on Strength while within 5 feet of the nachzehrer.

action.name: Multiattack

The target's hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the nachzehrer regains hp equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or become infected with the grave pox disease (see the Grave Pox trait).

action.name: Fist
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Radiant Beauty of Sune (Recarga 4)
entries: Naes dispels any magical darkness within 30 feet of him. Additionally, each hostile creature within 30 feet of Naes that does not have Cover must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 60 radiant damage on a failed saving throw, half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the saving throw has the blinded condition for 1 minute.

reaction.name: Hard to Kill (1/Day)
entries: If Naes would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, or is subjected to an effect that would kill him instantaneously without doing damage, Naes instead drops to 1 hit point.

entries: For 1 minute, the knight can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 feet of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a d4 to its roll provided it can hear and understand the knight. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if the knight is incapacitated.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The knight adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the knight must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Dimensionally Bound
entries: Nafas can't leave the Infinite Staircase or be trapped within a container (such as an Iron Flask). Attempts to transport Nafas to another plane are wasted.

trait.name: Last Wish
entries: When Nafas drops to 0 hit points, his body disintegrates into a whirl of multiversal dust that surrounds one creature responsible for his demise. That creature then hears Nafas's last wish: for the creature to take his place.

If the creature accepts, it is transformed into a noble djinni. The creature's game statistics are replaced by those of Nafas (including this trait), though it retains its name, alignment, and personality. The creature also inherits Nafas's palace and all it contains.
If the creature refuses, Nafas gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all his hit points and appearing in a random safe location on the Infinite Staircase.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Nafas fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Nafas has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Noble Genie
entries: Nafas doesn't suffer any of the penalties that normally follow casting the Wish spell to produce an effect other than duplicating another spell.

entries: Nafas makes three Storm Shamshir attacks and uses Create Vortex.

action.name: Storm Shamshir
entries: mw 13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) lightning or thunder damage (Nafas's choice).

action.name: Create Vortex
entries: A 10-foot-radius, 60-foot-tall cylinder of swirling cosmic dust forms on a point Nafas can see within 120 feet of him. The vortex lasts as long as Nafas maintains concentration (as if concentration on a spell). When the vortex appears, each creature other than Nafas in the vortex's area must make a DC 22 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) force damage and has the restrained condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only and moves to the nearest unoccupied space outside the vortex.

On subsequent turns, Nafas can use this action to move the vortex up to 60 feet. When the vortex enters a creature's space for the first time on a turn, the creature must make the same saving throw as when the vortex first appeared. Creatures restrained by the vortex move with it.

A creature restrained by the vortex, or another creature that can reach it, can use its action to make a DC 22 Strength check. On a successful check, the restrained creature is no longer restrained and moves to the nearest unoccupied space outside the vortex.

reaction.name: Blowback
entries: Immediately after a creature Nafas can see ends its turn, Nafas exhales forceful winds in a 30-foot cone. Large or smaller creatures in that area must succeed on a CD 22 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from him.

reaction.name: Zephyr Step
entries: In response to being hit by an attack roll, Nafas moves up to half his flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
