entries: The raven of ill omen attacks once with its beak and once with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

name: Raven Uth Vogler
sourceGroup: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scout makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: Ataque con arma a distancia: +4 to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. Impacto: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ravenala has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Woodland Stride
entries: Difficult terrain composed of magical or nonmagical plants doesn't cost the ravenala extra movement. In addition, it can pass through magical or nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ravenala makes two Bursting Pod or Slam attacks. If both Slam attacks hit a Medium or smaller creature, the target is grappled (escape DC 14), and the ravenala uses its Lamenting Engulfment on the target.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Bursting Pod
entries: rw 8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and each creature within 5 feet of the target, including the target, must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 5 (2d4) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Lamenting Engulfment
entries: The ravenala engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the ravenala, and it must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw at the start of each of the ravenala's turns or sing a lament of the mistakes and misdeeds it has performed in its lifetime. While singing, the engulfed creature can still act, but it can't otherwise speak, including casting spells with verbal components. If the ravenala moves, the engulfed creature moves with it. The ravenala can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

action.name: Healing Leaves (3/Day)
entries: The ravenala removes a leaf from its head and wraps the leaf around the wounds of one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target magically regains 10 3d6 hp and is freed from any disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

action.name: Encourage Growth (3/Day)
entries: The ravenala whispers magical words of growth to nonmagical plants on a point it can see within 30 feet of it. The plants burst with life and spread rapidly. The area within 20 feet of that point becomes difficult terrain for 24 hours.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The doom croaker has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The doom croaker can mimic animal sounds and Humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check.

trait.name: Rune-Powered Weapons
entries: The ravenfolk's weapon attacks are magical. When the ravenfolk hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The doom croaker makes one Peck attack and one Runestaff attack, or it makes two Rune Blast attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Ghost Wings or Prophetic Call, if available.

action.name: Peck
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Runestaff
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Rune Blast
entries: rs 7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) radiant damage.

action.name: Ghost Wings
entries: The doom croaker furiously "beats" a set of phantasmal wings. Each creature within 5 feet of the ravenfolk must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Prophetic Magic
entries: The ravenfolk doom croaker can cast the augury spell and thaumaturgy cantrip at will, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

action.name: Prophetic Caw (Recarga 6)
entries: The ravenfolk doom croaker caws a prophecy that sounds different to each listener. Each creature within 30 feet of the ravenfolk that can hear it must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. Ravenfolk have advantage on the saving throw. On a failure, a creature hears a prophecy of its doom and is frightened for 1 minute. On a success, a creature hears a prophecy of its greatness and has advantage on the first attack roll it makes on each of its turns for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The ravenfolk scout can mimic animal sounds and Humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check.

action.name: Peck
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Rapier
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: rw 4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Ghost Wings
entries: The ravenfolk scout furiously "beats" a set of phantasmal wings. Each creature within 5 feet of the ravenfolk must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The ravenfolk warrior can mimic animal sounds and Humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Insight) check.

trait.name: Rune-Powered Weapons
entries: The ravenfolk's weapon attacks are magical. When the ravenfolk hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ravenfolk warrior makes one Peck attack and one Runespear attack, or it makes two Longbow attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Ghost Wings.

action.name: Peck
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Runespear
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: rw 5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Ghost Wings
entries: The ravenfolk warrior furiously "beats" a set of phantasmal wings. Each creature within 5 feet of the ravenfolk must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the start of its next turn

reaction.name: Odin's Call (Recarga 6)
entries: When the ravenfolk warrior takes damage while below half its hp maximum, it moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the minotaur moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The minotaur has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Labyrinthine Recall
entries: The minotaur can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

trait.name: Ravening Hunger
entries: When a ravening minotaur reduces a creature to 0 hp with a melee attack on its turn, the minotaur can take a bonus action to consume the creature's heart. The minotaur's hp maximum increases by 5 for every ten hearts it consumes in this way.

trait.name: Ravening Madness
entries: The ravening minotaur has disadvantage on Intelligence checks and saving throws. It considers every creature hostile and doesn't gain any benefit from the Help action or similar spells or effects that involve helping or receiving help from friendly creatures. This trait doesn't prevent a spellcaster from restoring hp to the minotaur or curing the ravening with magic.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the minotaur can choose to have advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The minotaur makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the ravening minotaur gains temporary hp equal to the damage dealt. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or becoming infected with the ravening.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Gore
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

name: Ravenous Crystal Lizard
sourceGroup: Dark Souls III: Lord Seeker's Compendium

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the lizard remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal large pile of crystals.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The lizard has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lizard makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Roll
entries: The lizard moves up to 40 feet in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. While moving in this way, it can move through other creature's space and ignores difficult terrain. Creatures whose space it moves through must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Crystal Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: The lizard breathes out magical crystals in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 21 (6d6) force damage. Additionally, that area becomes difficult terrain until the start of the lizard's next turn.

reaction.name: Crystal Armor (3/Day)
entries: The lizard adds 3 to its AC against one attack that would hit it.

trait.name: Writhing Aura
entries: The ground within 30 feet of the ravenous flora is filled with plant roots and becomes Difficult Terrain. A creature that starts its turn in the aura takes 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

trait.name: Poison Ivy
entries: If the ravenous flora would take Poison damage, it instead takes no damage and regains Hit Points equal to the Poison damage it would have received.

action.name: The ravenous flora always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the ravenous flora can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the ravenous flora takes one of the following Epic Action at the end of each player character's turn:

entries.name: Bite
entries: m 7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition and the ravenous flora can't Bite another target.

entries.name: Spit Acid
entries: r 7, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (2d4 Acid). While Burning, the target has the Blinded condition.

entries.name: Swallow
entries: The ravenous flora makes one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it has Grappled. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed and the grapple ends. The swallowed target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Cover from attacks and effects outside the flora, and takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The flora can have up to four targets swallowed at a time.

If the flora takes 15 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land with the Prone condition in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of it. If the flora dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

action.name: Hypnotic Pollen (1/Round)
entries: Salvación de Sabiduría (Wisdom): DC 16, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the ravenous flora. Fallo: 9 (2d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (save ends). While Weakened, the target must spend all of its movement on each of its turns to move directly toward the ravenous flora. During this movement, the target ignores Difficult Terrain caused by the flora's Writhing Aura.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The ravenous flora chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The ravenous flora can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The ghoul has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the ghoul's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

action.name: Rancid Bite
entries: m 5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Aggressive
entries: The ghoul moves up to its Speed toward a Hostile [Attitude] creature it can see.

name: Raving Madman
sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark

trait.name: Doomsaying
entries: Any creature that ends its turn within 20 feet of the madman and can hear it, must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or has disadvantage on all Wisdom saving throws until the beginning it's next turn.

trait.name: Unpredicable
entries: Attacks of opportunity made against the madman are made with disadvantage.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Accusation
entries: A creature within 60 feet that can hear the Madman must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage and is frightened until the end of the madman's next turn. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the frightened target can't take reactions, actions, and bonus actions.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The madman's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). The madman can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Searing Armor
entries: The razerblast's armor is hot. Any creature grappling the razerblast or grappled by it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the end of that creature's turn.

trait.name: Shrapnel Explosion
entries: When the razerblast drops to 0 hit points, a flaming orb in its chest explodes, destroying the razerblast's body and scattering its armor as shrapnel. Creatures within 10 feet of the razerblast when it explodes must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The razerblast makes three melee attacks.

action.name: Spear
entries: mw,rw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

trait.name: Bladed Shell
entries: A creature that touches the crab or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) slashing damage.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the crab moves at least 15 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Shell Bash attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the crab can make one Claw attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crab makes one Claw attack and one Shell Bash attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). The crab has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Shell Bash
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning plus 3 (1d6) slashing damage.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The raptor has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the raptor's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the raptor moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the raptor can make one Bladed Feather attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The raptor makes one Bladed Feather attack and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bladed Feather
entries: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

trait.name: Dark Ground
entries: As an action, the razorleaf can dig its roots into the ground, securing itself in place and causing the area in a 20-foot radius around it to be shrouded in shadow. While rooted in this way, the razorleaf's speed becomes 0, it can't be knocked prone, and its attacks deal an extra 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. This area is difficult terrain and nonmagical sources of light are only half as effective while within it. Small and smaller beasts with Intelligence 3 or lower in the area lose their natural coloration and turn pale grey. These creatures are charmed by the razorleaf while within the area. Plants and trees inside the area turn an ashen color. The razorleaf can recall its roots and end this effect as a bonus action.

trait.name: Do Not Touch
entries: A creature that touches the razorleaf or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) slashing damage.

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While in bright light, the razorleaf has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The razorleaf makes two lacerating leaves attacks.

action.name: Lacerating Leaves
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Shower of Razors (Recarga 5)
entries: The razorleaf shakes loose a deadly shower of slicing leaves. Each creature within 10 feet of the razorleaf must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Razorvine Blight
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (can't see beyond this radius)

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the blight is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. If a creature hasn't observed the blight move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the blight is animate.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The blight can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blight makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 4 to hit (with advantage if the target is missing any of its hit points), reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Life-Draining Vines (Recarga 6)
entries: Snaking vines erupt from the blight. Each creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) slashing damage on failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If at least one of the creatures that failed this save isn't a Construct or an Undead, the blight regains 9 hit points.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The reality cyst is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Unhinged Reality
entries: The reality cyst emits a 120-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] of unhinged reality. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation [Area of Effect] is subjected to the following effect. Salvación de Sabiduría (Wisdom): DC 15. Fallo: The target has the Immobilized condition until it leaves the Emanation [Area of Effect]. While Immobilized, the target believes itself to be in an altered and confused environment of shifting forms, and can't see or hear anything else. The target does not perceive itself to be stationary, and instead believes it is walking through a bizarre landscape. It can take an action on its turn to repeat the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the creature succeeds on its save or the effect ends for it, it is immune to the reality cyst's Unhinged Reality for 24 hours.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The reality cyst doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Psychic Whip
entries: m,r 7, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target has the Dazed condition until the end of the reality cyst's next turn. The reality cyst can target a creature Immobilized by its Unhinged Reality with this attack even if the creature has Cover.

reaction.name: Fracture
entries: Disparador: The reality cyst takes damage. Salvación (int): CD 15, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the reality cyst. Fallo: The target has the Addled condition (save ends).

bonus.name: Feed
entries: Each creature Immobilized by Unhinged Reality takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. The reality cyst regains Hit Points equal to the total damage dealt, and its Hit Points Maximum increases by the same amount.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: The companion explodes when it dies. Salvación de Destreza (Dexterity): DC equals tu CD de salvación de conjuros, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the companion. Fallo: 2d4 Necrotic damage. Éxito: Half damage.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the companion is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

action.name: Dreadful Swipe
entries: m tu modificador de ataque de conjuro, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d4 plus your Intelligence modifier Necrotic damage, and the target can't take Opportunity Attack until the start of its next turn.

name: Reanimated corpse
sourceGroup: Dark Souls III: Lord Seeker's Compendium

trait.name: Fear of Fire
entries: If the corpse takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Slam
entries: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Aura of Murder
entries: As long as the reaper is not incapacitated, hostile creatures within 5 feet of it gain vulnerability to piercing damage unless they have resistance or immunity to such damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The reaper makes two dagger attacks and uses Shroud Self.

action.name: Dagger
entries: mw,rw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Shroud Self
entries: The reaper magically turns invisible until the start of its next turn. This invisibility ends if the reaper makes an attack roll, makes a damage roll, or casts a spell.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The reaper's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 1d10 force damage for every 5 feet shunted.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spirit makes a number of Reaping Scythe attacks equal to half the level of the spell (rounded down).

action.name: Reaping Scythe
entries: mw your spell attack modifier to hit (with advantage), reach 5 ft., the creature haunted by Haunt Creature. Hit: 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Haunt Creature
entries: The spirit targets a creature it can see within 10 feet of itself and begins haunting it. While the target is haunted, you and the spirit sense the direction and distance to the target if it is on the same plane of existence as you. Additionally, if the target starts its turn within 10 feet of the spirit, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the frightened condition until the start of the target's next turn. The target remains haunted until it dies, the spirit disappears, or the spirit uses this action again.

name: Reautomata
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: If damage reduces the reautomata to 0 Hit Points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken, unless the damage is from a Critical Hit. On a success, the reautomata drops to 1 Hit Points instead.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The reautomata's Long Jump is up to 50 feet and its High Jump is up to 30 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The reautomata makes two Arm Blade attacks and one Entrapping Rend attack.

action.name: Arm Blade
entries: m 9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 5 feet away from the reautomata and has the Prone condition.

action.name: Entrapping Rend
entries: m 9, reach 5 ft., one Prone target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and the reautomata can't make Entrapping Rend attacks against another target.

bonus.name: Aggressive
entries: The reautomata moves up to its Speed toward a Hostile [Attitude] creature it can see. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attack action.

name: Reautomata Wrecker
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The reautomata deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The reautomata makes one Drill attack and one Wrecking Ball attack.

action.name: Drill
entries: m 12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) Piercing damage.

action.name: Wrecking Ball
entries: m 12, reach 20 ft. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. Salvación de Fuerza (Strength): DC 20. Fallo: The target has the Dazed condition (save ends) and the Prone condition.

action.name: Destructive Rampage (Recarga 6)
entries: The reautomata moves up to its Speed in a straight line, moving through the space of any Medium or smaller creature on its path. The first time its enters each creature's space during this move, it can make a Drill or Wrecking Ball attack against that creature.

bonus.name: Overdrive Engine (1/Day; Bloodied Only)
entries: The reautomata's Destructive Rampage recharges, and it gains Immunity to all damage and conditions until the end of its next turn. For the duration, the reautomata automatically succeeds on all saving throws and Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution-based ability checks and has Advantage on attack rolls. It can't be forced to move or affected by spells of level 8 or lower unless it chooses to be. Features and effects that ignore Resistance and Immunity, such as a Vorpal Weapon, don't function against the reautomata unless those effects are caused by a level 9 spell or an artifact.

At the end of its next turn, the reautomata dies and explodes. Salvación (dex): CD 20, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the reautomata when it dies. Fallo: 20 (8d4) Acid damage plus 36 (8d8) Necrotic damage. Éxito: Half damage.

trait.name: Ascendant Transformation
entries: When Vladimir von Drakken drops to 0 Hit Points, his body explodes in a shower of gore and he reappears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet as Ascendant Vladimir von Drakken. His Initiative doesn't change.

trait.name: Aura of Dread
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Vladimir von Drakken takes 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Bloodthirsty
entries: Vladimir von Drakken has Advantage on attack rolls against a target with the Bloodied or Bleeding condition.

trait.name: Daywalker
entries: Vladimir von Drakken doesn't possess any Vampire Weaknesses from the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Vladimir von Drakken regains 30 Hit Points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 Hit Points remaining.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Vladimir von Drakken can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Vladimir von Drakken always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On his turn, Vladimir von Drakken can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Vladimir von Drakken takes one of the following Epic Action at the end of each player character's turn:

entries.name: Bloodmourne
entries: m 12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 27 (6d6 + 6) Force damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4). In addition, Vladimir von Drakken can apply one of the following martial maneuvers to the target:

entries.name: Advance
entries: Vladimir von Drakken pushes the target 15 feet, then moves up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

entries.name: Hamstring
entries: The target has the Immobilized condition until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Overpower
entries: The target has the Staggered condition until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Claws
entries: m 12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20).

action.name: Bite (1/Round)
entries: Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 20, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Fallo: 49 (14d6) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (DC 20 Constitution save ends). Vladimir von Drakken regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt. A Humanoid killed by this damage rises on its next turn as a Vampire Spawn under Vladimir von Drakken's control.

action.name: Dominate (1/Round)
entries: Salvación de Sabiduría (Wisdom): DC 20, one creature Vladimir von Drakken can see within 120 feet. Fallo: The target has the Charmed condition until the end of its next turn. While Charmed, the target obeys Vladimir von Drakken's commands and can't take Reactions. Failure by 5 or More: The Charmed condition lasts 24 hours or until Vladimir von Drakken is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Each time the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. Éxito: The target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll against Vladimir von Drakken.

action.name: Wing Blast (1/Round)
entries: Salvación de Fuerza (Strength): DC 20, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from Vladimir von Drakken. Fallo: 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from Vladimir von Drakken and has the Prone condition. Fallo o Éxito: Before or after using this Epic Action, Vladimir von Drakken can move up to half his Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

action.name: Shadow Step (2/Round)
entries: Vladimir von Drakken teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet that is in Dim Light or Darkness. He has Advantage on the next melee attack he makes before the end of this round.

action.name: Shape-Shift (1/Round)
entries: Vladimir von Drakken shape-shifts into a Tiny bat (Speed 5 ft., Fly Speed 30 ft.) or a Medium cloud of mist (Speed 5 ft., Fly Speed 20 ft. [hover]), or he returns to his vampire form. Anything he is wearing transforms with him.

While in bat or mist form, Vladimir von Drakken can't speak. His game statistics, other than his size and Speed, are unchanged, but he can't use Epic Action other than Shape-Shift and Epic Resistance. While in mist form, Vladimir von Drakken can't speak or manipulate objects, and loses his Aura of Dread. He is weightless and can enter an enemy's space and stop there. If air can pass through a space, the mist can do so, but it can't pass through liquid. He has Resistance to all damage.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: Vladimir von Drakken chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

reaction.name: Spell-Reflecting Strike
entries: Disparador: Vladimir von Drakken makes a successful saving throw against a spell, or a spell attack misses him. Respuesta: Vladimir von Drakken can choose another creature (including the spellcaster) he can see within 120 feet of him. The spell targets the chosen creature instead of Vladimir von Drakken. If the spell forces a saving throw, the chosen creature makes its own save. If the spell was an attack, the attack roll is rerolled against the chosen creature.

trait.name: First Strike
entries: The reckoner has advantage on initiative rolls.

action.name: Longsword
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

reaction.name: Lightning Backlash (Recarga 5)
entries: When a creature hits the reckoner with an attack, the attacker takes lightning damage equal to half the damage dealt by the attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The reckoner is a 5th-level Boros spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12, 4 to hit with spell attacks). The reckoner has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the abishai's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abishai makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack, and it can use Frightful Presence or Incite Fanaticism.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 38 (7d10) fire damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) force damage plus 11 (2d10) fire damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the abishai's choice that is within 120 feet and aware of the abishai must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of it for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the abishai's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Incite Fanaticism
entries: The abishai chooses up to four other creatures within 60 feet of it that can see it. Until the start of the abishai's next turn, each of those creatures makes attack rolls with advantage and can't be frightened.

action.name: Power of the Dragon Queen
entries: The abishai targets one Dragon it can see within 120 feet of it. The Dragon must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. A chromatic dragon makes this save with disadvantage. On a successful save, the target is immune to the abishai's Power of the Dragon Queen for 1 hour. On a failed save, the target is charmed by the abishai for 1 hour. While charmed in this way, the target regards the abishai as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. This effect ends if the abishai or its companions deal damage to the target.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the abishai's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The abishai's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abishai can use its Frightful Presence. It also makes three attacks: one with its morningstar, one with its claw, and one with its bite.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 38 (7d10) fire damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the abishai's choice that is within 120 feet and aware of it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the abishai's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Incite Fanaticism
entries: The abishai chooses up to four of its allies within 60 feet of it that can see it. For 1 minute, each of those allies makes attack rolls with advantage and can't be frightened.

action.name: Power of the Dragon Queen
entries: The abishai targets one dragon it can see within 120 feet of it. The dragon must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. A chromatic dragon makes this save with disadvantage. On a successful save, the target is immune to the abishai's Power of the Dragon Queen for 1 hour. On a failed save, the target is charmed by the abishai for 1 hour. While charmed in this way, the target regards the abishai as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. This effect ends if the abishai or its companions deal damage to the target.

trait.name: Breath Weapon
entries: A dracolisk can use its breath weapon as an attack. Its breath characteristics are determined by its draconic background, as summarized on the table. Regardless of the type of breath weapon involved, targets in the area of effect take half damage with a successful DC 16 Dex saving throw. Lines are 5 feet wide.

trait.name: Immunity to Energy
entries: Each type of dracolisk is immune to the energy type inherent in its own breath weapon, as summarized on the table.

trait.name: Petrifying Gaze
entries: As an attack, a dracolisk can target one living creature within 30 feet and line of sight with its petrifying gaze. If the targeted creature can see the dracolisk, then the targeted creature must make a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw or begin turning to stone; it immediately becomes restrained, and it must make another DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of its next turn. Success on the second saving throw ends this effect. Failure on the second saving throw means the creature is petrified permanently. A creature that is capable of taking actions can, at the start of its turn, look away to avoid the dracolisk's gaze for one complete round. If it targets the dracolisk while averting its gaze, it suffers all the usual penalties for attacking an unseen target. Creatures that are blind, unconscious, or unable to see the dracolisk for any other reason are immune to this attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: A dracolisk bites once and attacks once with claws, or it uses its breath weapon or its petrifying gaze.

action.name: Bite
entries: m +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: m +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Breath Weapon (Recarga 5)
entries: a automatic hit, range 30 ft. cone, creatures in range. Hit: 18 (4d8) fire damage, or half damage with a successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. See Breath Weapon, above, for variables.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: The dragon exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: m 6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: Salvación de Destreza (Dexterity): DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. Fallo: 24 (7d6) Fire damage. Éxito: Half damage.

name: Red Greatwyrm

trait.name: Chromatic Awakening (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 425 hit points, it recharges its Breath Weapon, and it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, the greatwyrm can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 105,000 XP (210,000 XP total) for defeating the greatwyrm after its Chromatic Awakening activates.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If the greatwyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The greatwyrm doesn't require food or drink.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The greatwyrm makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) force damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 20) and is restrained until this grapple ends. The greatwyrm can have only one creature grappled this way at a time.

action.name: Tail
entries: mw 18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Breath Weapon (Recarga 5)
entries: The greatwyrm exhales a blast of energy in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 78 (12d12) fire damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The greatwyrm makes one Claw or Tail attack.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm beats its wings. Each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The greatwyrm can then fly up to half its flying speed.

legendary.name: Arcane Spear (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm creates four spears of magical force. Each spear hits a creature of the greatwyrm's choice it can see within 120 feet of it, dealing 12 (1d8 + 8) force damage to its target, then disappears.

mythic.name: Bite
entries: The greatwyrm makes one Bite attack.

mythic.name: Chromatic Flare (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm flares with elemental energy. Each creature in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on the greatwyrm must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (5d8) fire damage.

mythicHeader: If the greatwyrm's Chromatic Awakening trait has activated in the last hour, it can use the options below as legendary actions.

name: Red Guard Drake
languages: understands Draconic but can't speak it

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake attacks twice, once with its bite and once with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The red hag can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Blood Sense
entries: The red hag can pinpoint the location of creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead within 60 feet of her and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of her.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The red hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts
entries: The red hag can communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two Claw attacks or three Blood Bolt attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Blood Bolt
entries: rs 8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature with blood, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Siphon Blood (Recarga 5)
entries: The red hag drains blood from nearby creatures. Each creature that isn't a Construct or Undead within 20 feet of the red hag must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If at least one creature fails the saving throw, the next spell the red hag casts is cast as if the spell used a spell slot two levels higher than the spell's lowest level.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The red hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

trait.name: Drain Vigor
entries: If the hag deals a creature psychic damage, the creature must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the psychic damage taken. The hag regains hit points equal to that amount, gaining any excess as temporary hit points that last 24 hours. This reduction to a creature's hit point maximum lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The hag can't reduce a creature's hit point maximum to 0, but if a creature with a hit point maximum of 1 due to this trait drops to 0 hit points, it becomes stable. When the humanoid recovers from this condition, they are permanently cursed to be unable to speak. A remove curse or similar magic restores a creature's voice.

trait.name: Immutable Seeming
entries: No effect can change the hag's form, and an illusion can disguise her only if the illusion makes her invisible.

trait.name: Stolen Voices
entries: The hag can perfectly mimic the voice of anyone cursed by her to lose their voice.

action.name: Claws
entries: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage and 2 (1d4) psychic damage.

action.name: Touch
entries: ms 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (2d4) psychic damage, and the target can't take reactions until the end of the hag's next turn.

action.name: Charming Banter (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: A creature under the hag's magical mental influence (such as charmed by her) and able to hear her must make a DC 12 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, when the hag's mental influence ends, the target forgets magic was used to influence it.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hag's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
will: vicious mockery (5th level, see Drain Vigor)

name: Red Housedrake
sourceGroup: L'Arsene's Ledger of Treasures and Trinkets

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The housedrake has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Flametongue (Recarga 6)
entries: The housedrake fills its mouth with fire. Until the end of its turn, its Bite attack deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire damage on a hit, and the housedrake can use its action to harmlessly heat a nonmagical object it touches.

trait.name: Fear Cackle (1/Day)
entries: As an action, a red jester can unleash a fear-inducing cackle. All creatures within 60 feet that hear the cackle must make a successful DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 2d4 rounds. A frightened creature has a 50% chance of immediately dropping everything it holds in its hands.

trait.name: Unassailable Mind
entries: The mind of a red jester is a twisted and dangerous place to peer into. If a living creature targets a red jester with an attack that normally causes psychic damage, or tries to use telepathy on a red jester, that creature must make a successful DC 13 Intelligence saving throw or be cursed, with an effect identical to a permanent confusion spell. The confusion effect can be ended only by magic that lifts the curse.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: A red jester attacks twice with fists, or once with its jesters deck, or twice with its mace.

action.name: Fist
entries: m +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Jester's Deck
entries: r +6 to hit, range 20 ft., one creature. Hit: the target creature is affected as if he or she drew a random card from the Deck of Many Things. In the hands of anyone but a red jester, the jesters deck acts as a normal, nonmagical deck of playing cards.

action.name: +2 Mace of Merriment
entries: m +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a successful DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed with Merriment for 1d3 rounds. In the hands of anyone but a red jester, the weapon acts as a +1 mace.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The terror bird has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the bird's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Passing Bite
entries: Terror birds who move at least 20 feet straight toward a target have advantage on the next attack roll against that target.

trait.name: Levitation
entries: Red queens have a limited form of levitation, which allows them to "run uphill" on empty air or to cross chasms. This movement must be completed between two portions of solid ground within two turns (with Dash actions, a red queen bird can move up to 200 feet over empty space).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The red queen makes two serrated beak attacks.

action.name: Serrated Beak
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) slashing damage at the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, the red quoxxarie can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

trait.name: Aura of Wrath
entries: Provided the red quoxxarie isn't incapacitated, any creature (including another red quoxxarie) that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more red quoxxaries can grant itself advantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn. Attack rolls against the creature also have advantage until then. If the creature is hostile to the quoxxarie and uses this aura, the creature also has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma checks until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the red quoxxarie moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The red quoxxarie has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Slippery
entries: The red quoxxarie has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The red quoxxarie makes one ram attack and one attack with its hooves.

action.name: Ram
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Get the Horns
entries: If the red quoxxarie takes 25 or more damage from one creature out of the quoxxarie's reach, the quoxxarie can take the Disengage action and move up to half its speed toward that creature. If the creature is then within reach, the quoxxarie can make a ram attack against it with advantage on the attack roll.

name: Red Ruin
sourceGroup: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

trait.name: Draconic Devotion
entries: While Red Ruin can see a Dragon that isn't hostile to her, she has advantage on attack rolls.

trait.name: Mounted Combat Master
entries: When Red Ruin is mounted and a creature targets her mount with an attack, Red Ruin can cause the attack to target her instead.

trait.name: Mounted Evasion
entries: When Red Ruin or her mount makes a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage from an effect, they take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Red Ruin makes three Ember Lance attacks.

action.name: Ember Lance
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

action.name: Explosive Hand Crossbow (Recarga 5)
entries: Red Ruin fires an explosive crossbow bolt at a point she can see within 120 feet of herself. When the bolt reaches that point, or if it hits an object early, it detonates in a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The slaad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The slaad regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slaad makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be infected with a disease—a minuscule slaad egg.

A humanoid host can carry only one slaad egg to term at a time. Over three months, the egg moves to the chest cavity, gestates, and forms a slaad tadpole. In the 24-hour period before giving birth, the host starts to feel unwell, its speed is halved, and it has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. At birth, the tadpole chews its way through vital organs and out of the host's chest in 1 round, killing the host in the process.
If the disease is cured before the tadpole's emergence, the unborn slaad is disintegrated.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The slaad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The slaad regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slaad makes three Injecting Claw attacks.

action.name: Injecting Claw
entries: m 6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid not cursed by a slaad, it is subjected to the following effect. Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 14. Fallo: The target is cursed unawares, and a minuscule slaad egg is implanted in it. Removing the curse destroys the egg.

Over 2d4 × 10 days, the egg gestates. In the final 24 hours, the cursed target feels unwell; its Speed is halved, and it has Disadvantage on D20 Test. At the end of this time, the egg turns into a Slaad Tadpole, which chews out of the host and kills it.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Ataque (mw,rw): +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Impacto: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mage is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save CD 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The mage has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Reactive Venom
entries: If the spider deals poison damage to a creature that is poisoned, the target takes an extra 2 (1d4) poison damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down and on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Swingline
entries: The spider throws a length of webbing at a point on a surface, such as the ground or wall, it can see within 30 feet of it, attaching one end of the webbing to that point. It then reels in the webbing, pulling itself to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that point. When the spider moves in this way, opportunity attacks against it have disadvantage. If the spider pulled itself at least 15 feet straight toward a creature, it has advantage on the next Bite attack it makes against that creature before the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ruffian makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

entries: The treant magically animates one or two trees it can see within 60 feet of it. These trees have the same statistics as a treant, except they have Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, they can't speak, and they have only the Slam action option. An animated tree acts as an ally of the treant. The tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies; until the treant dies or is more than 120 feet from the tree; or until the treant takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate tree. The tree then takes root if possible.

trait.name: Red Cap
entries: The redcap must soak its cap in the blood of a Humanoid that has been dead for no more than 1 hour at least once every 3 days. Every 24 hours past the third day that it goes without soaking its cap in blood in this way, it suffers one level of exhaustion. This exhaustion can be reduced only when the redcap finishes a long rest after soaking its cap in fresh Humanoid blood, which reduces its exhaustion level to 0. If the redcap dies as a result of this exhaustion, it crumbles to dust.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The redcap makes one Bleeding Bite attack and two Pike attacks.

action.name: Bleeding Bite
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than a Construct or Undead, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or lose 7 2d6 hp at the start of each of its turns due to a bleeding wound. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.

bonus.name: Solid Kick
entries: The redcap kicks a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a CD 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Divine Revulsion
entries: If a creature brandishes a holy symbol of any deity at the redcap (requiring an action by the brandishing creature each turn), the redcap becomes frightened. The redcap can make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns to overcome this effect. If it succeeds, it cannot be frightened again in this way for 1 hour.

trait.name: Deadly Cleave
entries: Whenever the redcap reduces an opponent to 0 hit points with a melee weapon attack, it can immediately make another melee weapon attack of the same kind against a different creature.

trait.name: Red Cap
entries: A redcap's hat is dyed with the blood of its victims. As long as the hat is worn, the redcap heals 5 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If its cap is removed, it loses this benefit, as well as its damage resistances, until the hat is restored. An adjacent creature can attempt to snatch a redcap's hat as an action by succeeding on a DC 20 Dexterity check. A redcap can make a replacement cap in 10 minutes, but the new cap does not grant these benefits until the redcap has used its blood soak ability on it at least once. A redcap's cap grants no benefits to anyone other than the redcap that made it.

action.name: Blood Soak
entries: The redcap dips its cap in the blood of a slain foe. The foe must have died within the last minute, and the redcap must have dealt at least 1 point of damage to it. For the next minute, all of the redcap's melee attacks deal an additional 5 damage.

action.name: Momentous Stomp

entries: The redcap targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of it and momentarily disrupts the flow of blood in its veins. The target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and is incapacitated for 1 minute. While incapacitated, a target coughs blood, bleeds from every orifice of its body, and takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Constructs, Elementals, and Undead are immune to this effect.

entries: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Mucous Cloud
entries: While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by transformative mucus. A creature that touches the aboleth or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must make a CD 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased for 1d4 hours. The diseased creature can breathe only underwater.

trait.name: Probing Telepathy
entries: If a creature communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires if the aboleth can see the creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aboleth makes three tentacle attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Impacto: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a CD 14 Constitution saving throw or become diseased. The disease has no effect for 1 minute and can be removed by any magic that cures disease. After 1 minute, the diseased creature's skin becomes translucent and slimy, the creature can't regain hit points unless it is underwater, and the disease can be removed only by heal or another disease-curing spell of 6th level or higher. When the creature is outside a body of water, it takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to the skin before 10 minutes have passed.

The target must succeed on a CD 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the aboleth until the aboleth dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the aboleth's control and can't take reactions, and the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance.

Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1 mile away from the aboleth.

trait.name: Petrifying Gaze
entries: If a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the basilisk and the two of them can see each other, the basilisk can force the creature to make a CD 12 Constitution saving throw if the basilisk isn't incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature magically begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

A creature that isn't surprised can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If it does so, it can't see the basilisk until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If it looks at the basilisk in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
If the basilisk sees its reflection within 30 feet of it in bright light, it mistakes itself for a rival and targets itself with its gaze.

trait.name: Antimagic Cone
entries: The beholder's central eye creates an area of antimagic, as in the antimagic field spell, in a 150-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the beholder decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active. The area works against the beholder's own eye rays.

action.name: Bite
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 14 (4d6) piercing damage.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The beholder shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three targets it can see within 120 feet of it:

entries.name: 1. Charm Ray
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a CD 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the beholder for 1 hour, or until the beholder harms the creature.

entries.name: 2. Paralyzing Ray
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a CD 16 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: 3. Fear Ray
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a CD 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: 4. Slowing Ray
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a CD 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target's speed is halved for 1 minute. In addition, the creature can't take reactions, and it can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: 5. Enervation Ray
entries: The targeted creature must make a CD 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: 6. Telekinetic Ray
entries: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a CD 16 Strength saving throw or the beholder moves it up to 30 feet in any direction. It is restrained by the ray's telekinetic grip until the start of the beholder's next turn or until the beholder is incapacitated.

If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The beholder can also exert fine control on objects with this ray, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

entries.name: 7. Sleep Ray
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a CD 16 Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep and remain unconscious for 1 minute. The target awakens if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to wake it. This ray has no effect on constructs and undead.

entries.name: 8. Petrification Ray
entries: The targeted creature must make a CD 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

entries.name: 9. Disintegration Ray
entries: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a CD 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 45 (10d8) force damage. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 hit points, its body becomes a pile of fine gray dust.

If the target is a Large or smaller nonmagical object or creation of magical force, it is disintegrated without a saving throw. If the target is a Huge or larger object or creation of magical force, this ray disintegrates a 10-foot cube of it.

entries.name: 10. Death Ray
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a CD 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 55 (10d10) necrotic damage. The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 hit points.

legendary.name: Eye Ray
entries: The beholder uses one random eye ray.

If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or wood that hits the pudding is destroyed after dealing damage. The pudding can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round.

If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points.

Each new pudding has hit points equal to half the original pudding's, rounded down. New puddings are one size smaller than the original pudding.
