action.name: Bone Harpoon
entries: mw,rw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. Impacto o Fallo: The harpoon returns to the hunter's hand.

action.name: Tusk
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage.

name: Tharashk Hunter
languages: Common, Orc plus one other language

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hunter makes three attacks, using Shortsword or Longbow in any combination.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: m 7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Longbow
entries: r 7, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: Disparador: The hunter is hit by an attack roll. Respuesta: The hunter halves the damage (round down) it takes from that attack.

bonus.name: Mark of Tharashk
entries: The hunter magically marks one creature it can see within 150 feet. The mark lasts for 1 hour, until the target dies, or until the hunter uses this Bonus Action again. While the target is marked in this way, the hunter has Advantage on attack rolls against the target, and the target gains no benefit from the Invisible condition against the hunter.

trait.name: Shadow of Guilt
entries: Thavius's shadow is that of a pudgy, horned devil with small wings.

action.name: Mace
entries: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Dagger

trait.name: Angelic Weapons

entries: The deva makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Mace
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
entries: The deva touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 (4d8 + 2) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: The deva magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the deva's choice).

In a new form, the deva retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks.

trait.name: Electronic Data Network
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the Algorithm takes 21 (6d6) Lightning damage.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The Algorithm is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Predictive Analytics
entries: At the end of each of the Algorithm's turns, it rolls 1d20 for each player character fighting it. The Algorithm can replace any D20 Test made by it or a creature it can see with one of these predictive rolls. It must choose to do so before the roll, and it can replace a roll in this way only once per turn.
Each predictive roll can be used only once. Any unused predictive rolls are lost at the start of the Algorithm's next turn.

action.name: The Algorithm always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the Algorithm can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Algorithm takes one of the following Epic Action at the end of each player character's turn:

entries.name: Wire
entries: Salvación de Destreza (Dexterity): DC 26, one creature the Algorithm can see within 60 feet. Fallo: 21 (2d10 + 10) Force damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20). The Algorithm can grapple up to six creatures at a time.

entries.name: Algorithmic Manipulation
entries: Salvación de Fuerza (Strength): DC 26, one Huge or smaller creature or object the Algorithm can see within 120 feet. Fallo: The Algorithm moves the target up to 30 feet in any direction, and the target has the Restrained condition. If the Algorithm lifts the target into the air, it is suspended there. The target remains held until the Algorithm releases it (no action required), uses this Epic Action again, or has the Incapacitated condition.

entries.name: Deatomization
entries: Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 26, one creature or object the Algorithm can see within 300 feet. Fallo: 65 (10d12) Necrotic damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it dies and its body is reduced to atoms. Fallo: Half damage.

action.name: Reprogram (1/Round)
entries: Salvación de Inteligencia (Intelligence): DC 26, one creature Grappled by the algorithm. Fallo: 55 (10d10) Piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it dies and its brain is replaced with mechanical components. The target reanimates at the start of its next turn as a Construct under the Algorithm's control. It resembles the original creature, but its eyes glow with synthetic green light, and its body is covered in protruding wires, metal scraps, and glowing tubes.

action.name: Assuming Direct Control (1/Round)
entries: The Algorithm targets a Construct within 120 feet and immediately enters and takes control of it. The Algorithm can still use its Epic Action as normal and replaces the Construct's game statistics with its own, except the Construct's Hit Points. When the Construct is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Algorithm reemerges in an unoccupied space within 15 feet of it.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Algorithm chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Algorithm can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (1/Round)
headerEntries: The Algorithm casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 27):

name: The Ancestor
sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark
languages: Common, Abyssal, Celestial, Deep Speech, Infernal, Sylvan, telepathy (120 ft.)

trait.name: Battle Cry: Reproduction
entries: When the Ancestor rolls initiative, he uses 3 legendary actions to use his Reproduction.

trait.name: Eldritch Protection
entries: The Ancestor adds his Charisma modifier to his armor class and hit points per hit dice.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the the ancestor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The the ancestor's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: One of a Whole
entries: The Ancestor is telepathically connected with his reflections. They can communicate with each other telepathically as long as they are on the same plane of existence and can see, feel, and hear what the other does.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Ancestor makes 2 reshape attacks.

action.name: Reshape
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and the target must succeed a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or is effected by one of the following (Ancestor's Choice):
• Closed Mouth. The creature's mouth temporarily grows shut and the creature can't talk or use spells with vocal components until the end of the Ancestor's next turn.

• Stump Hand. The creature's hand temporarily devolves into a useless appendage, causing the creature to drop whatever item it is holding in that hand and the creature can't use the hand until it reshapes at the end of the Ancestors next turn.
• Tentacle Leg. The creature's leg temporarily shrivels to a writhing tentacle, causing the creature's speed to be reduced by half until the end of the Ancestor's next turn

legendary.name: Reposition
entries: The Ancestor teleports up to half of his teleportation speed.

legendary.name: Futility (2 Actions)
entries: The Ancestor projects his past existential dread upon a creature he can see with in 120 ft. of himself. The creature must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or has disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, or saving throws until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendary.name: Time Heals All (2 Actions)
entries: The Ancestor creates a temporal annomaly that causes time to rapidly pass for each reflection within 120 ft. of him. Each reflection regains 22 (4d8 + 4) hit point and can move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Reproduction (3 Actions)
entries: The Ancestor spawns up to 3 reflections within 20 ft. of himself. The reflections remain for 1 hour before having to return to the Ancestor. The Ancestor can have a maximum of 3 reflections spawned at a time.

legendary.name: Unmake (3 Actions)
entries: The Ancestor sends out a flesh rippling wave in a 60 ft. cone. Each creature of the Ancestor's choice in the area must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) necrotic damage on a failed save and half as much on a successful one. Constructs, spectral undead such as ghosts and other creatures not made from flesh and blood are unaffected.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

trait.name: Rising Anger
entries: If another creature deals damage to the Angry, the Angry's attack rolls have advantage until the end of its next turn, and the first time it hits with a hook attack on its next turn, the attack's target takes an extra 19 (3d12) psychic damage.
On its turn, the Angry has disadvantage on attack rolls if no other creature has dealt damage to it since the end of its last turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Angry makes two hook attacks.

action.name: Hook
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The Bagman has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

trait.name: Amorphous

trait.name: Alien Mind

name: The Baron

trait.name: Spider Climb

action.name: Shared Sacrifice
entries: The bloodied chooses an allied creature within 30 feet of it. Until the end of the bloodied's next turn, the bloodied has resistance to all damage, and whenever the bloodied takes damage, the target creature takes damage equal to the damage dealt to the bloodied.

reaction.name: Ultimate End
entries: The bloodied targets a single creature within 60 ft. that just attacked it. The target must succeed a CD 16 Wisdom saving throw or immediately take force damage equal to the bloodied's current hit point total as the bloodied removes its chains. The bloodied dies instantly. On a success, the target takes half as much damage, and that damage cannot lower the target to less than 1 hp.

trait.name: Enormous Space
entries: The Churning has a space 60 feet on a side and takes up that entire space. Other creatures can enter this space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the Churning's Engulf.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Churning has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The Churning deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Unstoppable
entries: The Churning ignores difficult terrain, and nothing can reduce its speed or stop it from moving on its turn.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: mw 15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 23 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or be pulled within 5 feet of the Churning.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The Churning moves up to its speed and can enter creatures' spaces. The creature must make a DC 23 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice). On a successful save, the creature chooses to leave the Churning's path or it fails the save. On a failed save, the creature takes 40 (10d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is blinded, is restrained, and has cover from effects that originate outside the Churning. At the start of each of the Churning's turns, engulfed creatures take 42 (12d6) bludgeoning damage. When the Churning moves, engulfed creatures move with it.
An engulfed creature can escape (DC 23). On a success, the creature escapes and uses 15 feet of movement to enter a space of its choice within 5 feet of the Churning.

If the Churning dies, an engulfed creature is no longer restrained by it. If a creature dies inside the Churning, the creature's body breaks up. The Churning keeps inside it anything the dead creature wore or carried.

reaction.name: Reactive Grab
entries: A creature that moves while within the Churning's reach provokes an opportunity attack. The Churning can make four opportunity attack each round.

entries: The Countess starts in her base form and cannot transform into her bloodlust form during the first round of combat after rolling initiative (or otherwise agitated). Once the Countess transforms back into her base form, she cannot transform back into her bloodlust form until the end of her next turn.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The the countess has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Mood Swing (Recarga 5)
entries: At the beginning of her turn the Countess transforms into her bloodlust form. She has unique actions in this form and gains a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls (included in her attacks). At the beginning of her next turn, she transforms back into her base form.

entries: The Countess sways to magically charm her foes. Each creature within 40 ft. that can see her must succeed a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or be swayed for one minute. A swayed creature and begins to unvoluntarily move in the rythm of the Countess' swaying hips and has disadvantage on attack rolls againsth the Countess. At the beginning of a swayed creature's turn it takes 15 (6d4) psychic damage and moves up to their speed in a randomly determined direction (roll 1d8 to determined where). A swayed creature repeats the saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success. A creature that is immune to being charmed automatically succeeds the saving throw. Once a creature succeeds the saving throw or the effect ends on it, it becomes immune to the Countess' Hypnotic Sway for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack (Bloodlust Only)
entries: The Countess makes three attacks; two attacks with her claws and one bite attack.

action.name: Claws (Bloodlust)
entries: mw 14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite (Bloodlust)
entries: mw 14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) piercing damage and the Countess regains 13 (3d8) hit points.

action.name: Screams of Ecstasy (Bloodlust Only)
entries: The Countess screams at a creature within 60 ft. of herself that can hear her. The target creature and each creature within 5 ft. of it must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save the creature takes 7 (2d6) thunder damage is stunned until the end of the Countess' next turn. A stunned creature is deafened. On a successful save a creature takes half as much damage and is not stunned.

action.name: Lashing Tongue (Bloodlust Only)
entries: The Countess attacks with her lashing tongue. Each creature in a 30 ft. long and 5 ft. wide line originating from the Countess must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save a creature takes 45 (10d8) piercing damage and is wounded. On a successful save a creature takes half as much damage and is not wounded. A wounded creature takes 5 (2d4) necrotic damage at the beginning of its turn for each time it has been wounded, at the end of its turn it makes a DC 21 Constituton saving throw, ending the effect of all wounds on itself on a success. Alternatively a creature can use an action to make a DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check or spend one charge of a healer's kit to close all wounds on the creature and end the effect. A creature can have more than one wound.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Countess moves up to half of her speed without provoking opportunity attacks

legendary.name: Wink (Base Only)
entries: The Countess winks at a creature that can see her. The creature must succeed a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or has disadvantage on all attacks targeting the Countess until the end of her next turn or until the Countess transforms.

legendary.name: Disrobe
entries: The Countess attacks with her claws.

legendary.name: Screech (1/Round)
entries: The Countess uses her Scream of Ecstasy.

legendary.name: Kiss (2 Actions) (Base Only)
entries: The Countess makes an Infestation attack.

legendary.name: Bite (2 Actions) (Bloodthirst)
entries: The Countess makes a bite attack.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The Curator can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Aura of Torment
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the Curator feels the torment of the captured souls and takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Curator fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Curator has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The Curator's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Soul Regeneration
entries: The energies of the souls surrounding the Curator heal its wounds. The Curator regains 20 hp at the start of its turn. If it takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The Curator dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Curator makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its soul cage. It can use its tongue in place of its bite attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

action.name: Tongue
entries: mw +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage. If the creature is Large or smaller, it is pulled up to 10 feet toward the Curator.

action.name: Soul Cage
entries: mw +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage. The Curator has advantage on the attack roll if the soul cage contains the soul of at least one of the target's allies.

action.name: Unbind Soul (Recarga 5)
entries: A creature the Curator can see within 60 feet of it must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature falls unconscious as its soul is trapped in the Curator's soul cage. Otherwise, a creature that fails the saving throw is restrained as its soul struggles to stay in its body. A restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, falling unconscious with its soul trapped in the soul cage on a failure or ending the effect on a success. A successful dispel magic spell (DC 19) cast on the soul cage releases all souls trapped within it. A creature's body can survive unconscious for three days without a soul. After the third day, the body dies, and the creature can't be resurrected until its soul is freed.

legendary.name: Agile Leap
entries: The Curator leaps up to its speed without provoking opportunity attack. When it leaps, it ignores difficult terrain and obstacles in its way.

legendary.name: Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Curator makes one bite or tongue attack.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The Curator casts a spell from its list of innate spells, consuming a use of the spell as normal.

trait.name: Aura of the Deep
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the Duchess takes 14 (4d6) Psychic damage.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, a creature can touch one of the Duchess's Delerium shards to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once a Delerium shard restores Hit Points in this way, it can't do so again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The Dutchess is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The Dutchess may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Duchess has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Moisture Regeneration
entries: The Duchess regains 20 Hit Points at the start of each of her turns if she is submerged at least partially in water. She dies only if she starts her turn at 0 Hit Points and does not regenerate.

action.name: The Duchess always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On her turn, the Duchess can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Duchess takes one of the following Epic Action at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Bite
entries: m 12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) Piercing damage.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: m 12, reach 20 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20). The Duchess can have up to four creatures Grappled at a time.

At the start of each of its turns until the grapple ends, the target is subjected to the following effect. Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 17. Fallo: The target gains one Contamination level.

action.name: Fling
entries: One Large or smaller object held or creature Grappled by the Duchess is thrown up to 60 feet in a direction of the Duchess's choice and has the Prone condition. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and have the Prone condition.

action.name: Deep Domination (1/Round)
entries: Salvación de Sabiduría (Wisdom): DC 20, one creature The Duchess can see. Fallo: The target has the Charmed condition. The target is under the Duchess's control and can't take Reactions. The Duchess and the target can communicate telepathically over any distance.

Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a failure, it gains one Contamination level. Once every 24 hours, if the creature is at least 1 mile away from the Duchess, it can repeat the saving throw.
If the target undergoes a Monstrous Transformation, it becomes a Deep Dreg Warrior, a Deep Knight, or a Deep Siren, and is forever in thrall to the Duchess.

action.name: Call of the Deep (1/Round)
entries: The Duchess calls forth up to five Deep Dreg Warrior or one Deep Knight. The creatures appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the Duchess and remain until destroyed. The creatures act after the Duchess on the same Initiative count and are under her control.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Duchess chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. The Duchess can use this action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

reaction.name: Sacrificial Pawn
entries: Disparador: The Duchess takes damage from an attack. Respuesta: The Duchess chooses an ally or a creature Charmed by her to take the attack's damage instead.

If the enemy misses after the warrior parries, then the warrior can spend 2 stamina as part of the same reaction to make an attack roll with advantage against that enemy.

action.name: Breath of Tranquility (Recarga 5)
entries: The Gardener exhales soporific vapor in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by the psychic damage has the unconscious condition and is stable instead of dying.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Grim makes three Reaping Scythe attacks. It can use Bleak Visage in place of one of these attacks.

action.name: Reaping Scythe
entries: mw +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage plus 22 (4d10) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest.

action.name: Bleak Visage
entries: The Grim fixes its gaze on one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on DC 16 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or take 22 (4d10) psychic damage and be frightened for 1 minute. While frightened, the creature is incapacitated. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the Grim's Bleak Visage for the next 24 hours.

bonus.name: Whispers of Loss
entries: The Grim whispers and hisses constantly, which can be heard loudly in the minds of creatures within 60 feet of it that can understand it. It can choose one from the following three effects:

Future Sorrow.: The Grim fills creatures' thoughts of images of loved ones dying horrible deaths. Each creature within range must succeed on a CD 16 Wisdom saving throw or take 16 (3d10) psychic damage and drop whatever it is holding, and become frightened until the end of the Grim's next turn. While frightened in this way, a creature must take the Dash action and move away from the Grim by the safest available route on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to move, in which case it needn't take the Dash action. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage with no additional effects.

Great Emptiness.: The Grim makes creatures reflect on their most terrible actions that have wracked them with guilt. Each creature within range must succeed on a CD 16 Charisma saving throw or be take 22 (4d10) psychic damage and be confused until the end of its next turn. The creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn and rolls a d10 to determine what it does during that turn. On a 1 to 4, the creature does nothing. On a 5 to 7, the creature takes no action but uses all its movement to move in a random direction. On an 8 to 10, the creature makes one melee attack against a random creature, or it does nothing if no creature is within reach. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage with no additional effects.

Past Losses.: The Grim makes creatures recall painful, tragic events and lost love ones that have haunted them. Each creature within range must succeed on a CD 16 Intelligence saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage and become stunned until the end of the Grim's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage with no additional effects.

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: On each of his turns, the Hateful Hermit can use his bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Focus Hatred
entries: At the start of his turn as a bonus action, the Hateful Hermit unleashes a vexing stream of profanities and threats at a single foe he can see within 30 feet. The Hermit gains advantage on the first attack roll he makes against that target on this turn.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The Hateful Hermit deals an extra 17 (5d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the Hermit that isn't incapacitated and the Hermit doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Hateful Hermit makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Sickle
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Whip
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Blowgun
entries: rw 4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

name: The Heart of Darkness
sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark

trait.name: Aberrant Mind
entries: The Heart of Darkness has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

trait.name: Eldritch Ward
entries: The Heart of Darkness uses its Charisma modifier in place of its Dexterity to determine its armor class (AC).

trait.name: Dimension Locked
entries: The Heart of Darkness cannot be teleported, or transported to another plane of existence by any means.

trait.name: Heart of the World
entries: The Heart of Darkness' actual body encompasses the entirety of its Lair. In its Lair, its melee weapon attacks originate from the ground and walls, as it is able to manifest appendages from any part of its body. For the purpose of targets of game effects, the Heart itself (speaking this monster) is the only valid target as it is to be considered the Heart of Darkness' only weak spot. The Heart of Darkness can only make opportunity attacks against targets that move out of the reach of its weak spot (this monster).

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The the heart of darkness is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the the heart of darkness fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The the heart of darkness's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Realm Awareness
entries: The Heart of Darkness is aware of any creature in its Lair, as if it can see it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Heart of Darkness makes 2 puncture attacks.

action.name: Puncture
entries: mw 13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) piercing damage and the creature suffers a wound. A wounded creature suffers 10 (4d4) necrotic damage at the start of its turn for each wound and then makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, ending the effect of all wounds on a success. Alternatively a creature can use an action to make a DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check or spend one charge of a healer's kit to close all wounds on the creature and end the effect. A creature can have more than one wound.

action.name: Dissolution
entries: The Heart of Darkness spews acid at a creature it can see within 60 ft. of itself. The creature must succeed a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 48 (14d6) acid damage and is covered in acid. Until a creature takes an action to remove the acid, the target takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Revelation
entries: The Heart of Darkness reveals its cosmic truth to a creature to break its mind. The creature must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or take 40 (10d8) psychic damage and is incapacitated until the end of the Heart's next turn.

action.name: Return the Errant Flesh (1/day)
entries: The Heart of Darkness attempts to return a creature within 10 ft. of itself, the ground or walls of its lair back to its collective. The creature must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 90 (20d8) necrotic damage on a failed save and half as much on a successful one. If the creature fails the saving throw and the damage reduces the creature to 0 hit points, it dies and becomes part of the Heart of Darkness.

legendary.name: Puncture
entries: The Heart of Darkness makes a puncture attack.

legendary.name: Dissolution (2 Actions)
entries: The Heart of Darkness uses its dissolution.

legendary.name: Revelation (2 Actions)
entries: The Heart of Darkness uses its revelation.

trait.name: Archery
entries: The Horned Hunter gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls he makes with ranged weapons (included in the attack).

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the Horned Hunter is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the Horned Hunter instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

trait.name: Fey Conduit
entries: Before she sent him into the Material Plane, Nyrissa used the power of her home within the Fable to forge a link with the Horned Hunter. During his time on the Material Plane, she can observe the world as if seeing through his eyes and listening through his ears. She cannot bolster the Horned Hunter via this link, and uses it primarily to spy on the PCs and observe their tactics in preparation for what she hopes never occurs—their invasion of Thousandbreaths. If the Horned Hunter claims Briar, the sword causes this link to Nyrissa to end immediately.

trait.name: Fey Weapons
entries: The Horned Hunter's weapon attacks are magical. When the Horned Hunter hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 22 (5d8) radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Horned Hunter has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Horned Hunter makes three attacks.

action.name: Ram
entries: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 22 (5d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: rw 13 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 22 (5d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Panpipes
entries: The Horned Hunter plays pipes and chooses one of the following magical effects: a charming melody, a frightening strain, or a gentle lullaby. Any creature within 60 feet of The Horned Hunter that can hear the pipes must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be affected as described below. Other satyrs and creatures that can't be charmed are unaffected.

An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to these panpipes for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Charming Melody
entries: The creature is charmed by The Horned Hunter for 1 minute. If The Horned Hunter or any of its companions harms the creature, the effect on it ends immediately.

entries.name: Frightening Strain
entries: The creature is frightened for 1 minute.

entries.name: Gentle Lullaby
entries: The creature falls asleep and is unconscious for 1 minute. The effect ends if the creature takes damage or if someone takes an action to shake the creature awake.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Horned Hunter is a 20th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 19, 11 to hit with spell attacks). The Horned Hunter has the following ranger spells known:

trait.name: Dying Gasp
entries: When the Horror dies, they begin to rupture in a vile explosion of viscera and necrotic energy. The creature who reduced the Horror to 0 hit points can make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check to appeal to Elyas's departing soul (no action required). On a successful check, his soul transforms the explosion and each enemy of the Grave Order within 30 feet of the Horror gains 7 (2d6) temporary hit points. On a failed check (or if no check is made), each creature within 15 feet of the Horror must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) acid damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Spine Cleaver
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage against a grappled target.

action.name: Bone Hook
entries: rw 6 to hit, range 15 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 14) and the Horror can pull the target up to 15 feet toward them.
Until this grapple ends, the Horror can't make a Bone Hook attack against another target.

bonus.name: Valor's Death
entries: Each enemy within 10 feet of the Horror who can hear the Horror must succeed on a CD 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the Horror for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for them, the creature is immune to the Horror's Valor's Death for 24 hours.

trait.name: Life Hunger
entries: If a creature the Hungry can see regains hit points, the Hungry gains two benefits until the end of its next turn: it has advantage on attack rolls, and its bite deals an extra 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a hit.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Hungry makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 16) and is restrained until the grapple ends. While grappling a creature, the Hungry can't attack with its claws.

name: The Iron Teeth of Baba Yaga

action.name: Pinch
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (3d4 + 4) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Iron's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, 6 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verball components:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two greatclub attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Impacto: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ataque con arma a distancia: +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Impacto: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a CD 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Rock Catching
entries: If a rock or similar object is hurled at the giant, the giant can, with a successful CD 10 Dexterity saving throw, catch the missile and take no bludgeoning damage from it.

trait.name: Divine Eminence
entries: As a bonus action, the Knurly Witch can expend a spell slot to cause her melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 21 (6d6) necrotic damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Knurly Witch has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Knurly Witch makes three attacks: one with her bite and two with her claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: mw 13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Knurly Witch's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18). The Knurly Witch can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Knurly Witch is a 13th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 19, 11 to hit with spell attacks). The Knurly Witch has the following cleric spells prepared:

name: The Laethlyn
languages: Druidic, Primordial, Sylvan, three other languages

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Laethlyn fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Laethlyn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Nature Speech
entries: The Laethlyn can understand and be understood by all plants and beasts.

trait.name: Wrath of Nature
entries: The Laethlyn's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Laethlyn makes three vine strike attacks.

action.name: Vine Strike
entries: mw 11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one or two targets. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Thorn Spray
entries: A barrage of sharp thorns sprays from the Laethlyn in a 30-foot cone. Each non-plant creature in the area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (4d10 + 6) piercing damage on a failed save and have their speed reduced by 10 feet for 1 minute. Any creature succeeding on the save takes half as much damage and suffers no reduction of its speed. The speed reduction is cumulative, and a creature's speed returns to normal if they receive magical healing while affected by the reduction.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: The Laethlyn magically teleports, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, up to 90 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

legendary.name: Capture (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Vines attempt to grasp at a single target the Laethlyn can see within 120 feet. The target must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled and restrained by the vines (escape DC 15). The Laethlyn can only have two creatures so captured at any given time.

legendary.name: Rejuvenate (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The Laethlyn can root themself in the ground beneath her, reducing their speed to 0 until they teleport or use an action to uproot themself. While rooted, healing energy surges into them, allowing them to regain 30 hit points at the start of each of their turns. Any beast allies within 30 feet of the of the Laethlyn regain 30 hit points when they take this legendary action.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Laethlyn's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 20). They can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Psychic Leech
entries: At the start of each of the Lonely's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

trait.name: Thrives on Company
entries: The Lonely has advantage on attack rolls while it is within 30 feet of at least two other creatures. It otherwise has disadvantage on attack rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Lonely makes one harpoon arm attack and uses Sorrowful Embrace.

action.name: Harpoon Arm
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Large or smaller creature.
The Lonely has two harpoon arms and can grapple up to two creatures at once.

action.name: Sorrowful Embrace
entries: Each creature grappled by the Lonely must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. A creature takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In either case, the Lonely pulls each creature grappled by it up to 30 feet straight toward it.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the Lonely Warrior has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) check that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Lonely Warrior makes two greatsword attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

A humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a zombie under the Lonely Warrior's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The Lonely Warrior can have no more than 12 zombie under its control at one time.

name: The Lord of Blades
sourceGroup: Eberron: Rising from the Last War

trait.name: Adamantine Plating
entries: Any critical hit against the Lord of Blades becomes a normal hit.

trait.name: Bladed Armor
entries: A creature that grapples the Lord of Blades or is grappled by him takes 13 (3d8) slashing damage. A creature takes 13 (3d8) slashing damage if it starts its turn grappling or being grappled by the Lord of Blades.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the Lord of Blades moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with his adamantine sixblade on the same turn, the target takes an extra 11 (2d10) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

trait.name: Warforged Resilience
entries: The Lord of Blades has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned, is immune to disease, and magic can't put him to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Lord of Blades makes three attacks: two with his adamantine sixblade and one with his bladed wings.

action.name: Adamantine Sixblade
entries: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage.

action.name: Bladed Wings
entries: mw,rw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Fire Bolt (Cantrip)
entries: rs 10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d10) fire damage.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The Lord of Blades makes one weapon attack.

legendary.name: Cantrip
entries: The Lord of Blades casts one of his cantrips.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Lord of Blades casts a spell of 2nd level or lower from his spell list that takes 1 action to cast.

legendary.name: Blade Dash (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The Lord of Blades moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then makes one attack with his adamantine sixblade. He can make one bladed wings attack against each creature he moves past.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Lord of Blades is a 20th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 18, 10 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following artificer spells prepared:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Lost makes two arm spike attacks.

action.name: Arm Spike
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Embrace
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the target is frightened, and it takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage at the end of each of its turns. The Lost can embrace only one creature at a time.

reaction.name: Tightening Embrace
entries: If the Lost takes damage while it has a creature grappled, that creature takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

entries: The archmage has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Ataque (mw,rw): +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Impacto: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

name: The Miller
sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the the miller fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Time Loop
entries: Every day at dawn the Miller is returned to the farmstead and is fully restored, ending all lasting effects suffered from the previous day, even if he was destroyed. He does not retain memories from the previous day

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Miller uses winter's breath and makes two giant scythe attacks.

action.name: Giant Scythe

action.name: The Reaping (Recarga 4)
entries: The Miller moves up to its speed and makes a Giant Scythe attack against up to 4 creatures it passes. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

action.name: Winter's Breath
entries: The Miller transforms a farmhand within 20 ft. of itself into a frozen farmhand. A transformed farmhand becomes restrained by ice until it is destroyed. As long as it is frozen it can only use the following new actions:

Hollow Keening. A creature within 30 ft. of the frozen farmhand that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save the creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage is frightened for one minute. A frightened creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage at the end of its turn and must repeat the saving throw. On a successful save the creature is no longer frightened.
Thawing Soils. The frozen farmhand thaws and is no longer restrained. It transforms back into a farmhand.

entries: The Miller makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Miller moves up to half of his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Brave
entries: The Misbegotten Troll has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the Misbegotten Troll hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The Misbegotten Troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The Misbegotten Troll regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the Misbegotten Troll's next turn. The Misbegotten Troll dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Misbegotten Troll makes three melee attacks, two with his glaive and one with his bite, or two with his claws and one with his bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d6 + 9) piercing damage.

action.name: Glaive
entries: mw 15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d10 + 9) slashing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: mw 15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d6 + 9) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Counterattack
entries: When struck by an enemy with a melee weapon, the Misbegotten Troll makes one glaive or claws attack against the creature that hit him.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The Misbegotten Troll makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary.name: Glaive Attack
entries: The Misbegotten Troll makes a glaive attack.

legendary.name: Jangle the Chain (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Misbegotten Troll shakes his chain of caged sprites, causing the supernatural cages to amplify their despair. All creatures other than the Misbegotten Troll or his smilodon pets within 30 feet must attempt a DC 18 Wisdom save or become overwhelmed with sadness, causing them to be stunned until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The Nightmare Rook has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Nightmare Rook has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The Nightmare Rook's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The Nightmare Rook regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the Nightmare Rook takes damage from silvered weapons, this trait doesn't function at the start of the Nightmare Rook's next turn. The Nightmare Rook dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Nightmare Rook can use its Frightful Presence. Then it makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: mw 15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d8 + 9) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: mw 15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 22). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the Nightmare Rook can't use its talons on another target.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the Nightmare Rook's choice that is within 30 feet and aware of it must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Nightmare Rook's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Nightmare Rook's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18, 10 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The Pudding King has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

trait.name: Gnome Cunning
entries: The Pudding King has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

trait.name: Insanity
entries: The Pudding King has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

action.name: War Pick
entries: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: The Pudding King magically transforms into an ooze, or back into his true form. He reverts to his true form if he dies. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying is absorbed by the new form. In ooze form, the Pudding King retains his alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. His statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form.

action.name: Create Green Slime (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: The Pudding King creates a patch of green slime (see "Dungeon Hazards" in chapter 5 of the Dungeon Master's Guide). The slime appears on a section of wall, ceiling, or floor within 30 feet of the Pudding King.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Pudding King's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Pudding King is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, 6 to hit with spell attacks). The Pudding King knows the following sorcerer spells:

name: The Sleeper
sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark

trait.name: Constructing Carapace
entries: At the beginning of its turn, when the Sleeper has at least 1 hit point, it gains 20 temporary hit points.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the the sleeper fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Psionic Feedback
entries: Any creature that attempts to read the Sleeper's mind or invade its dream takes 42 (12d6) psychic damage and is stunned for one minute.

trait.name: Telekinesis
entries: Even with most of its consciousness in deep slumber, the Sleeper can interact with the world around it. The Sleeper can move or manipulate creatures or objects as if under the effect of the Telekinesis spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Sleeper uses Maddening Presence and makes three tentacle attacks.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: mw 13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Maddening Presence
entries: Each creature of the Sleeper's choice that is within 120 feet of the Sleeper and can see it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success, and taking 5 psychic damage on a failure. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Sleeper's Maddening Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Stirring (Recarga 5)
entries: The Sleeper stirs in its sleep and devastates the minds of any sentient creature within 120 ft. of itself. Each creature in the area with an intelligence score higher than 2 must make a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save a creature takes 88 (16d10) psychic damage and half as much on a successful save. A creature that fails the saving throw while being frightened by the Sleeper's maddening presence becomes stunned until the end of the Sleeper's next turn.

action.name: Awakening (Recarga 4)
entries: The Sleeper makes six tentacle attacks, it can target no single creature with more than three tentacle attacks.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Sleeper moves up to half of its speed.

legendary.name: Tentacle (2 Actions)
entries: The Sleeper makes a tentacle attack.

legendary.name: Telekinesis (2 Actions)
entries: The Sleeper uses its Telekinesis. The Sleeper must use 2 legendary actions at the end of its turn to maintain the grip on a restrained creature

legendary.name: Rouse (3 Actions)
entries: The Sleeper rolls to recharge one of its used attacks.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: The Stranger wears an invisible ring of mind shielding that thwarts magical attempts to read their thoughts. The Stranger also wears dimensional shackles but is eager to be rid of them. One touch from Omid's mace-key causes the shackles to fall off, freeing the Stranger.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The archmage has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Ataque (mw,rw): +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Impacto: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The archmage is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save CD 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The archmage can cast disguise self and invisibility at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:
footerEntries: *The archmage casts these spells on itself before combat.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thing uses shard and makes one bite attack and one vorpal strike.

action.name: Phase Gnaw

action.name: Vorpal Strike
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage. This attack scores a critical hit if the thing rolls a 19 or higher on the attack roll.

action.name: Vorpal Strike
entries: rw 4 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or is affected by one of the following effects, randomly determined by a 1d6 roll: 1-2: The creature is stunned until the end of the thing's next turn. 3-4: The creature is blinded until the end of the thing's next turn. 5-6: The creature has disadvantage on dexterity saving throws and it's movement speed is reduced to 0 until the end of the thing's next turn.

legendary.name: Return to the Stars
entries: The thing summons one Crystalline Aberration within 5 feet of itself and loses 5 hit points. If it is under any effects that causes it to repeat a saving throw at the end of its turn, it repeats said saving throw.

sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark

trait.name: The Flesh
entries: This creature is part of 'The Flesh' and has unique abilities that are listed under 'Special Rules: The Flesh'.

action.name: Spine Whip
entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or is stunned until the end of the flesh (Bone)'s next turn.

action.name: Spine Slam
entries: The flesh pounds a target creature within 10 feet of itself with a grotesque spine growth. The creature and any enemy creature within a 5-foot-radius of the target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save a creature takes 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. On a successful save a creature takes half that damage and is not knocked prone.

name: The Unstable Flesh (Head)
sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark

reaction.name: Snapping Bite
entries: If a hostile creature within the reach of the flesh (head) attacks an allied creature, the flesh (head) can use a reaction to make a bite attack against the triggering creature.

action.name: Healing Stroke

action.name: Lashing Bite
entries: mw 2 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage. The target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one

name: The Viscount
sourceGroup: Darkest Dungeon: Horrors of the Dark

trait.name: Cruel Cutlery
entries: If two cutlery attacks hit the same creature in one turn, it suffers a wound for one minute. A wounded creature suffers 10 (4d4) necrotic damage at the start of its turn for each wound and then makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, ending the effect of all wounds on a success. Alternatively a creature can use an action to make a DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check or spend one charge of a healer's kit to close all wounds on the creature and end the effect. A creature can have more than one wound.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The the viscount has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the the viscount fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Revolting Palette
entries: The Viscount has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned and can consume spoiled food.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Viscount uses Hungry Eyes and makes two cutlery attacks. The Viscount can make a skewer attack in place of two cutlery attacks.

action.name: Cutlery
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Skewer
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) piercing damage. If the creature is of large size or smaller, the creature must succeed a DC 20 Strength saving throw. On a failed save the Baron can either push the creature 10 ft. away from himself, or grapple the creature, escape DC 20. Until the grapple ends, the creature is restrained and the Baron cannot use its skewer attack.

action.name: Hungry Eyes
entries: The Viscount works up its appetite for a creature he can see within 60 ft. of himself. Any time Viscount makes an attack against the creature until the beginning of his next turn, he adds 1d6 to his attack roll. Additionally, as long as the Viscount can smell the creature, he knows its exact location as if he can see it until the beginning of his next turn.

reaction.name: It Bites Back
entries: When a creature under the effect of his Hungry Eyes attacks the Viscount, he makes a cutlery attack against the triggering creature.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Baron moves up to half of his speed.

legendary.name: Salavating (1/Round)
entries: The Viscount's appetite becomes tangible and unnerving. Any creature under the effect of the Viscount's Hungry Eyes must succeed a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw, or takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and is frightened until the end of the Viscounts next turn.

legendary.name: Cutlery (2 Actions)
entries: The Viscount makes a cutlery attack.

legendary.name: Feast (3 Actions)
entries: The Viscount makes two cutlery attacks against a creature restrained by its skewers. For each attack that hits, the Viscount regains 10 (4d4) hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The captain makes three melee attacks: two with its scimitar and one with its dagger. Or the captain makes two ranged attacks with its daggers.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The captain adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the captain must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Alluring Aura
entries: The Whispered Promise projects a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] of beguiling enchantment. A creature that ends its turn in the Emanation [Area of Effect] has the Charmed condition for 1 hour. Each time the creature takes damage other than Psychic damage, it makes a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the Charmed condition ends for that creature, and it is immune to the Alluring Aura of the Whispered Promise for 24 hours.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The Whispered Promise has no true form and chooses how they manifest to each creature (no action required). Their form can be anything they wish; they can appear like a creature, object, or even as a multisensory representation of an abstract concept. They can appear to be any form that is Large or smaller, but their game statistics are the same in each form.

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: The Whispered Promise is immune to any effect that would sense their emotions or read their thoughts, as well as any divination spell that they refuse. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the Whispered Promise's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

trait.name: Glibness
entries: When they make a Charisma (Deception) check, the Whispered Promise treats any roll of 14 or less on the d20 as 15.

trait.name: Unravelling Resolve
entries: Creatures grappled by the Whispered Promise can't benefit from Resistance and Immunity to Psychic damage or the Charmed condition.

action.name: The Whispered Promise always takes their turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On their turn, the Whispered Promise can use their movement and interaction as normal. However, they do not take an action or Bonus Action on their turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Whispered Promise takes one of the following Epic Action at the end of each player character's turn:

entries.name: Tendril
entries: m 17, reach 10 ft. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) Force damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 25). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.

entries.name: Whispers (1/Round)
entries: Salvación de Inteligencia (Intelligence): DC 25. one creature the Whispered Promise can see within 300 feet. Fallo: 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target is Dazed (save ends). Éxito: Half damage. Failure by five or more: Double damage, and the target is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Promises (1/Round)
entries: Salvación de Carisma (Charisma): DC 25, one creature the Whispered Promise can see within 300 feet. Fallo: 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target is Jinxed (1d10) (save ends). Éxito: Half damage. Failure by 5 or more: Double damage, and the target becomes cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain Hit Points and gains no benefits from taking a Short Rest or Long Rest.

action.name: Unfettered Glide
entries: The Whispered Promise moves up to their Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

action.name: Dominate (1/Round)
entries: Salvación de Sabiduría (Wisdom): DC 25, one creature the Whispered Promise can see within 300 feet. Fallo: The creature has the Charmed condition until the end of its next turn. While Charmed, the target obeys the Whispered Promise's commands and can't take Reactions. Failure by 5 or More: The Charmed condition instead lasts for 24 hours or until the Whispered Promise is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Each time the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. Éxito: The target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll against the Whispered Promise.

action.name: Epic Resistances
entries: The Whispered Promise chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on them. The Whispered Promise can use this action even if they would otherwise be unable to take actions, their actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters their game statistics.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics; 1/Round)
headerEntries: The Whispered Promise casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 25):

trait.name: Delerium Storm Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the World Ender takes 21 (6d6) Lightning damage and is subjected to the following effect. Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 24. Fallo: The target gains one Contamination level.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The World Ender is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Mutations Abound
entries: A creature that gains a Contamination level from the World Ender's Delerium Storm Aura must roll 2d6 and take the lower result to determine if they mutate. Whenever a creature within the aura gains a mutation, that creature must roll twice on the Mutations table and gains both mutations.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the World Ender is destroyed, it regains all of its Hit Points in 1 hour unless a Wish spell is used to prevent it from rejuvenating. This is a stressful use of the Wish spell.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The World Ender deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Unbound Arcana
entries: Whenever the World Ender is the target of a spell, an Arcane Anomalies is triggered on the caster.

action.name: The World Ender always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the World Ender can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the World Ender takes one of the following Epic Action at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Necrotic Claw
entries: m 19, reach 15 ft. Hit: 37 (5d10 + 10) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Bite (1/Round)
entries: m 19, reach 15 ft. Hit: 26 (3d10 + 10) Piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 27). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and the World Ender can't Bite another target.

action.name: Charge Eradication Beam (Recarga 5)
entries: Octarine energy ripples through the body of the World Ender from its tail up to its head. The World Ender's Eradication Beam recharges, and it chooses the direction it will face to unleash its Eradication Beam.

The World Ender can only use this Epic Action if it's the first Epic Action it has taken this round. After using this Epic Action, The World Ender can't use Bite, Bellowing Roar, or Devour until the start of the next round.

action.name: Eradication Beam (Special Recharge)
entries: The World Ender can only use this Epic Action if it's the last Epic Action it takes this round. Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 27, each creature and object in a 1000-foot long, 20-foot wide Line [Area of Effect]. Fallo: 110 (20d10) Force damage. Éxito: Half damage. Fallo o Éxito: A creature is disintegrated along with anything it is wearing or carrying if this damage leaves it with 0 Hit Points, and can't be revived except by a Wish spell.
The Eradication Beam destroys any Wall of Force, Forcecage, or Prismatic Wall spell within its area. It also damages unattended magic items in its area, including artifacts.

action.name: Octarine Lightning Strike
entries: Salvación de Destreza (Dexterity): DC 27, each creature in a 10-foot radius Sphere [Area of Effect] centered on a point within 500 feet. Fallo: 54 (12d8) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition until the start of its next turn. Éxito: Half damage only.

action.name: Bellowing Roar (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Salvación de Sabiduría (Wisdom): DC 27, each creature in a 120-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the World Ender that can hear it. Fallo: The target has the Deafened condition (save ends). While Deafened, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Ground Slam (1/Round)
entries: Salvación de Fuerza (Strength): DC 27, each creature on the ground in a 30-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. Fallo: 26 (4d12) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the World Ender and has the Prone condition. Fallo o Éxito: The Cone [Area of Effect] becomes Difficult Terrain until the start of the World Ender's next turn.

action.name: Devour
entries: The World Ender can't take this Epic Action if it has used its Bite Epic Action this round. The World ender makes a Bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it has Grappled. If the attack hits, the target takes the Bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, it has Cover against effects originating from outside the World Ender, and it takes 56 (16d6) Acid damage and gains a Contamination level at the start of each of the World Ender's turns.

If the World Ender takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the World Ender must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of the World Ender with the Prone condition. If the World Ender dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse by using 30 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The World Ender chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The World Ender can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

trait.name: Wretched Pack Tactics
entries: The Wretched has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Wretched's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated. The Wretched otherwise has disadvantage on attack rolls.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage, and the Wretched attaches to the target. While attached, the Wretched can't attack, and at the start of each of the Wretched's turns, the target takes 6 (1d10 + 1) necrotic damage.

The attached Wretched moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the Wretched's movement. The Wretched can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach a Wretched.

name: The Wriggling Man
languages: Abyssal, Aklo, Common, Draconic, Sylvan, Terran, Undercommon

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The Wriggling Man regains 18 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of The Wriggling Man's next turn. If the Wriggling Man starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate, he makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, dying on a failure. On a success, his form collapses into a mass of dead worms, as it does when he dies, but one worm survives. The Wriggling Man reforms from the remaining worm in 1d10 days, fully healed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Wriggling Man makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam

headerEntries: The Wriggling Man is a 17th-level spellcaster.

action.name: Bite

action.name: Claw

action.name: Tail
