A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: The dragon exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a CD 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (18d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The dragon makes a tail attack.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the dragon must succeed on a CD 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

trait.name: Spell Turning
entries: The chimera has advantage on a saving throw against any spell that targets only the chimera (not an area). If the chimera's saving throw is successful and the spell is of 4th level or lower, the spell has no effect on the chimera and instead targets the caster.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chimera makes three attacks: one with its claws, one with its head, and one with its tail. When its breath weapon is available, it can use the breath in place of its head or its claws.

action.name: Claws
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Head
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Breath Weapon (Recarga 5)
entries: The chimera exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 32 (5d12) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Relentless (Recharges after a Short or Long rest)
entries: If therizinosaurus would take 20 or less damage that would reduce it to less than 1 hp, it is reduced to 1 hp instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The therizinosaurus makes two claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put <$short_name$> to sleep.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, <$short_name$> has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Club
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Impacto: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: <$title_short_name$>'s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save CD <$spell_dc__cha$>). <$title_short_name$> can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Thessalar wields a +1 dagger coated with Thessaltoxin (see appendix C).

trait.name: Alchemical Homunculus
entries: Thessalar is accompanied by his Thessalar's homunculus. If the mending spell is cast on it, the homunculus regains 2d6 hit points.

trait.name: Healing Toxicity
entries: Any magic item that restores hit points and can be applied to a piercing or slashing weapon (a potion, an ointment, and so forth) causes a hit with that weapon to deal extra damage to Thessalar equal to the amount the item would normally heal.

trait.name: Greater Restoration (1/Day)
entries: Thessalar can cast greater restoration if he has access to Alchemist's Supplies.

action.name: Dagger
entries: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is affected as if by the polymorph spell, transforming into a random beast or a creature it has seen within the last 24 hours (as chosen by the DM). This effect lasts until the target finishes a long rest.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Thessalar is an 18th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16, 8 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following artificer spells prepared:

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically.

action.name: Bite
entries: Ataque con arma cuerpo a cuerpo: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Impacto: 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a CD 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is instead poisoned for 5 (1d10) minutes and unconscious while poisoned in this way.

action.name: Acidic Spittle
entries: Ataque con arma a distancia: +4 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Impacto: 5 (1d6 + 2) acid damage.

trait.name: Multiple Serpent Heads
entries: The thessalgorgon has eight serpent heads. While it has more than one serpent head, the thessalgorgon has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.
Whenever the thessalgorgon takes 5 or more damage in a single turn, one of its serpent heads dies.

At the end of its turn, it grows two serpent heads for each of its serpent heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire or acid damage since its last turn. The thessalgorgon regains 5 hit points for each serpent head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the thessalgorgon sleeps, at least one of its serpent heads is awake.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the thessalgorgon moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the thessalgorgon can make one attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thessalgorgon makes three attacks: one with its Flurry of Serpent bites, one to Gore or with its Hooves, and one with its Tail Pincer.

action.name: Flurry of Serpent Bites
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage for each serpent head it has.

action.name: Gore
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tail Pincer
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is also grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the thessalgorgon can't use its Tail Pincer attack on another target.

action.name: Petrifying Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: The thessalgorgon exhales petrifying gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained target must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends on the target. On a failure, the target is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

name: Thessalheart Construct
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: While the construct is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically.

action.name: Claws
entries: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is instead poisoned for 5 (1d10) minutes and unconscious while poisoned in this way.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thessalhydra makes one maw attack and one Flurry of Bites.

action.name: Flurry of Bites
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (4d4) poison damage.

action.name: Maw
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) acid damage.

action.name: Tail Pincer
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage, and the target is grappled. As an action, the target can escape the grapple by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check (its choice). Until this grapple ends, the thessalhydra can't use its tail pincer.

action.name: Acid Saliva (Recarga 5)
entries: The thessalhydra spits a glob of acid at a point it can see within 30 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The thessalhydra makes a Wisdom (Perception) check with advantage.

legendary.name: Tail Swipe
entries: The thessalhydra makes a tail pincer attack.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The thessalhydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Multiple Serpent Heads
entries: The thessalhydra has eight serpent heads. While it has more than one serpent head, the thessalhydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.
Whenever the thessalhydra takes 10 or more damage in a single turn, one of its serpent heads dies.

At the end of its turn, it grows two serpent heads for each of its serpent heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire or acid damage since its last turn. The thessalhydra regains 10 hit points for each serpent head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each serpent head the thessalhydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attack. The thessalhydra can only use its Serpent Bite attack for these extra opportunity attack.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the thessalhydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thessalhydra makes as many Serpent Bite attacks as it has serpent heads. It then makes two additional attacks. one with its Maw and one with its Tail Pincer.

action.name: Serpent Bite
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

action.name: Maw
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 17 (5d6) acid damage. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage.

action.name: Tail Pincer
entries: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is also grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the thessalhydra can't use its Tail Pincer attack on another target.

action.name: Spit Acid (Recarga 5)
entries: The thessalhydra spits a gob of acid at a point it can see within 60 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Thessalkraken
languages: understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, and Primordial but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The thessalkraken can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Freedom of Movement
entries: The thessalkraken ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thessalkraken makes one bite attack and two tentacle attacks. It can replace each tentacle attack with one use of Fling.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) acid damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature grappled by the thessalkraken, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the thessalkraken, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the thessalkraken's turns.

If the thessalkraken takes 35 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the thessalkraken. If the thessalkraken dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: mw 12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The thessalkraken has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Fling
entries: One Medium or smaller object held or creature grappled by the thessalkraken is thrown up to 40 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Acid Saliva (Recarga 5)
entries: The thessalkraken spits a glob of acid at a point it can see within 60 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Tentacle Attack
entries: The thessalkraken makes one tentacle attack.

legendary.name: Fling
entries: The thessalkraken uses Fling.

legendary.name: Ink Cloud (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: While underwater, the thessalkraken expels an ink cloud in a 60-foot radius. The cloud spreads around corners, and that area is Vision and Light to creatures other than the thessalkraken. Each creature other than the thessalkraken that ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of the thessalkraken's next turn.

trait.name: Multiple Serpent Heads
entries: The thessalmera has eight serpent heads. While it has more than one serpent head, the thessalmera has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.
Whenever the thessalmera takes 5 or more damage in a single turn, one of its serpent heads dies.

At the end of its turn, it grows two serpent heads for each of its serpent heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire or acid damage since its last turn. The thessalmera regains 5 hit points for each serpent head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the thessalmera sleeps, at least one of its serpent heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thessalmera makes four attacks: one with is Flurry of Serpent Bites, one with its Bite, one with its Claws, and one with its Tail Pincer.

action.name: Flurry of Serpent Bites
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage for each serpent head it has.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail Pincer
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the thessalmera can't use its Tail Pincer attack on another target.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recarga 5)
entries: The dragon head exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The thessaltrice has eight cockatrice heads. While it has more than one cockatrice head, the thessaltrice has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.
Whenever the thessaltrice takes 3 or more damage in a single turn, one of its cockatrice heads dies.

At the end of its turn, it grows two cockatrice heads for each of its cockatrice heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire or acid damage since its last turn. The thessaltrice regains 3 hit points for each cockatrice head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the thessaltrice sleeps, at least one of its cockatrice heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thessaltrice makes three attacks: one with its Flurry of Cockatrice Bites, one with its Maw, and one with its Tail Pincer.

action.name: Flurry of Cockatrice Bites
entries: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 +1) piercing damage piercing damage for each cockatrice head it has, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw against being magically petrified. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified for 24 hours.

action.name: Maw
entries: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage.

action.name: Tail Pincer
entries: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is also grappled (escape DC 10). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the thessaltrice can't use its Tail Pincer tack on another target.

name: Thicket of Brambleweeds
sourceGroup: L'Arsene's Ledger of Treasures and Trinkets

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the thicket is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the swarm move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Nature) check to discern that the thicket isn't an ordinary patch of thorny plants.

trait.name: Thorny Overgrowth
entries: At the start of the thicket's turn, it deals 7 (3d4) piercing damage to each creature in its space. Additionally, when a creature moves into or within the thicket's space, it takes 7 (3d4) piercing damage for every 5 feet it moves.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The thicket can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the thicket can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny brambleweed. The thicket can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Thorn Lashes
entries: mw +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the thicket's space. Hit: 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage, or 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage if the thicket has half of its hit points or fewer, plus 7 (3d4) piercing damage.

action.name: Wall Form (1/Day)
entries: The thicket arranges itself into an opaque wall of thorns that originates from one 5-foot space it currently occupies and extends out in a 5-foot-wide line that is up to 15 feet tall and up to 45 feet long. While in this form, a creature that attempts to move into or through the thicket's space for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Strength check to do so; if the creature fails the check, its movement ends in the thicket's space and it becomes grappled by the thicket (escape DC 15). The thicket reverts to its original form after 10 minutes, if it uses an action to do so, or if it dies. When the thicket reverts, it reforms in the space in the middle of the wall and ceases grappling creatures.

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: On each of its turns, the thief lord can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the thief lord is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the thief lord instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The thief lord deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the thief lord that isn't incapacitated and the thief lord doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thief lord makes two attacks with its rapier.

action.name: Rapier
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: rw 7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Protect Me
entries: When a creature the thief lord can see targets it with an attack, the thief lord can sidestep behind an ally within 5 feet of it, moving to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the ally. The chosen ally becomes the target of the attack instead.

trait.name: Contortionist
entries: The thin giant can contort its body into unnatural positions, allowing it to easily move through any opening large enough for a Medium creature. It can squeeze through any opening large enough for a Small creature. The giant's destination must still have suitable room to accommodate its volume.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thin giant makes three melee attacks, but it can use its Consuming Bite only once.

action.name: Consuming Bite
entries: mw +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target's hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the giant regains hp equal to that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw +10 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

trait.name: Avoidance
entries: If the Thing with the Writhing Tail is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the being's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

trait.name: Purring Aura
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail projects a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] of madness and dread. A creature that ends its turn in the Emanation [Area of Effect] has the Frightened condition for 1 hour. A creature can take an action to attempt to overcome its fear, making a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw. Fallo: The target takes 27 (5d10) Psychic damage. Éxito: The Frightened condition ends for that creature, and it becomes immune to the Purring Aura of the Thing with the Writhing Tail for 24 hours.

trait.name: Quantum Displacement
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail shifts between realities and timelines. Attack rolls against it have Disadvantage, and it has Advantage on saving throws. If it is hit by an attack or fails a saving throw, this trait is disrupted until it uses Phase Displacement. This trait is also disrupted while the Thing with the Writhing Tail has the Incapacitated condition or a Speed of 0.

action.name: The Thing with the Writhing Tail always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, The Thing with the Writhing Tail can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, The Thing with the Writhing Tail takes one of the following Epic Action at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Cosmic Claw
entries: m 15, reach 10 ft. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 8) Force damage.

action.name: Tail Whip
entries: Salvación de Inteligencia (Intelligence): DC 26, one creature the Thing with the Writhing Tail can see within 30 feet. Fallo: 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Dazed condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: 70 (20d6) Psychic damage, and the target instead has the Stunned condition (save ends). Éxito: Half damage only.

action.name: Manifest Duplicate (1/Round)
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail creates a perfect visual illusion of itself in an unoccupied space it can see within 300 feet. The illusion is intangible and doesn't occupy its space. The duplicate lasts for 1 minute, but it ends early if the Thing with the Writhing Tail dismisses it (no action required) or has the Incapacitated condition. The Thing with the Writhing Tail can have a up to eight illusory duplicates at a time. While it has one or more duplicates, it has the following benefits:

action.name: Attacks and Spells
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail can cast spells, use Tail Whip, and make Claw attacks as if was in an illusory duplicate's space.

action.name: Aura Expansion
entries: Each illusory duplicate emanates a Purring Aura. The effects of multiple overlapping auras do not stack; a creature is only affected once by the Purring Aura even if it is within range of multiple Emanations.

action.name: Move
entries: Each time the Thing with the Writhing Tail takes this Epic Action, it can move any number of illusions up to 60 feet to unoccupied spaces within 300 feet of itself.

action.name: Distract
entries: When both the Thing with the Writhing Tail and one of its illusory duplicates are within 10 feet of a creature that can see them, the Thing with the Writhing Tail has Advantage on attack rolls against that creature.

action.name: Sense
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail can see and hear through each of its illusory duplicates.

action.name: Phase Displacement
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail teleports, swapping places with one of its illusory duplicates. If its Quantum Displacement trait was disrupted, it is no longer disrupted.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting it and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Thing with the Writhing Tail can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics; 1/Round)
headerEntries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 26):

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The Think Tank is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The Think Tank may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

trait.name: Life Support System
entries: The Think Tank is protected by three machine nodes that make up its Life Support System. The nodes are positioned in a triangle, each no further than 30 feet apart from the rest. Each node is a Large object with AC 20, 25 Hit Points per player character, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. The Think Tank can't move or be moved more than 60 feet away from any two of its Life Support System nodes.

trait.name: Nightmare Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the Think Tank takes 14 (4d6) Psychic damage.

trait.name: Shield Generator
entries: As long as at least one machine node in the Life Support System remains, the Think Tank's Immunity can't be ignored except by effects caused by level 9 spells or artifacts. If all nodes are destroyed, the Think Tank loses its Immunity.

trait.name: Telepathic Eavesdropping
entries: The Think Tank can project its consciousness to see and hear any creature or location within 5 miles as if it had cast Scrying (no action required). It can read the thoughts of creatures in this area, communicate with them telepathically, and listen in on telepathic communications which occur between other creatures in the region. It remains aware of its own surroundings while doing so. It cannot observe the area within a Private Sanctum spell or locations and creatures protected by magic which blocks divination or scrying sensors.

action.name: The Think Tank always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the Think Tank can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Think Tank takes one of the following Epic Action at the end of each player character's turn:

entries.name: Contaminated Blast
entries: m,r 12, reach 10 ft., or range 120 ft. Hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) Necrotic damage. Salvación de Constitución (Constitution): DC 20. Fallo: The target gains a Contamination level.

entries.name: Telekinetic Grip
entries: The Think Tank reaches out with its mind to hold one creature or object it can see within 120 feet of it in its psychic grasp. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Salvación de Fuerza (Strength): DC 20. Fallo: 28 (8d6) Force damage, and the target is moved up to 30 feet in any direction and has the Restrained condition until it escapes or the Think Tank has the Incapacitated condition. The Think Tank can hold up to two creatures or objects in its grip at one time. On its turn, a held creature can take an action to repeat the save, escaping the grip on a success.

If the target is an object weighing 1,000 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is telekinetically moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The Think Tank can also exert fine control on objects with its telekinesis, such as manipulating surgical tools or opening a door or a container.

entries.name: Pluck the Puppet Strings
entries: Salvación de Sabiduría (Wisdom): DC 20, one creature within 120 feet of the Think Tank. Fallo: 14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the target must use its Reaction to move up to its Speed directly toward a creature of the Think Tank's choice. If the target ends this movement within reach of the chosen creature, it must make a melee weapon attack against that creature with Advantage.

action.name: Mind Cage (1/Round)
entries: Salvación de Inteligencia (Intelligence): DC 20, one creature the Think Tank can see within 120 feet. Éxito: 33 (6d10) Psychic damage. Fallo: 33 (6d10) Psychic damage, and the target perceives itself to be trapped within a nightmare conjured forth from the depths of its own psyche until it escapes. While trapped, the target has the Immobilized, Blinded, and Deafened conditions. On its turn, the target can take an action to repeat the save. Each time it does, it takes 33 (6d10) psychic damage. On a success, the effect ends for it.

action.name: Unbind Gravity (1/Round)
entries: The Think Tank controls gravity in a 200-foot Cube [Area of Effect] centered on itself until the end of the next round. Each time the Think Tank uses this Epic Action, it decides which direction gravity pulls within the area. All creatures and objects that aren't somehow anchored to the ground in the area fall in the chosen direction until they reach the edge of the area. A creature can make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw to grab onto a fixed object it can reach, avoiding the fall on a success.

If some solid object (such as a ceiling) is encountered in this fall, falling objects and creatures strike it just as they would during a normal downward fall. If an object or creature reaches the edge of the area without striking anything, it remains there, oscillating slightly, for the duration.

Alternatively, the Think Tank can decide to prevent gravity from acting within the area. When it does, creatures within the area without a Fly Speed levitate in midair, and must move by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows them to move as if they were climbing. Unattended objects float around randomly.
If the Think Tank doesn't use this Epic Action during the next round, the effect ends and affected objects and creatures fall back down.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Think Tank chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Think Tank can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

entries: The thornblood is a mass of thick, thorny vines that grow from a Medium humanoid corpse. When the thornblood is reduced to 0 hit points, they are reduced to 1 hit point instead and retreat into the corpse that grew them.

The thornblood becomes immune to all damage until the end of their next turn. Additionally, until the thornblood finishes a long rest, their size becomes Medium, their walking and climbing speeds become 60 feet, and they can't make Throttle attacks or benefit from the Overgrowth trait.

action.name: Possession (Recarga 6)
entries: One humanoid that the ghost can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a CD 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the ghost; the ghost then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The ghost can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the ghost ends it as a bonus action, or the ghost is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the ghost reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

During the first 24 hours, the thorn can be removed, but doing so requires someone who has proficiency in the Medicine skill to succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

If the thorn remains, at the end of each long rest, the infected creature must succeed on a DC 12 (+1 per thorn, up to DC 15) Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion. If the creature dies from exhaustion, its soul departs its still-living body and it becomes a new thornhost with no levels of exhaustion.

trait.name: Bound
entries: The dragon is magically bound to three circlets. As long as the dragon is within 1 mile of a circlet wearer on the same plane of existence, the wearer can communicate telepathically with the dragon. While the dragon is active, the wearers see through its eyes and hear what it hears. During this time, the wearers are deaf and blind with regard to their own senses.

If only two circlet wearers are within 1 mile of the active dragon each hour spent wearing the circlets imposes one level of exhaustion on those wearers. If only a single wearer is within 1 mile of the active dragon, each minute spent wearing the circlet gives that wearer one level of exhaustion. If no circlet wearers are within 1 mile of the dragon, it views all creatures it can see as enemies and tries to destroy them until a circlet wearer communicates with the dragon or the dragon is destroyed. A circlet wearer can use its action to put the dragon in an inactive state where it becomes incapacitated until a wearer uses an action to switch the dragon to active.
Each circlet is a magic item that must be attuned.

trait.name: Penitentiary Gaze

On a failed save, the creature becomes wracked with guilt and filled with remorse over its life's actions that weren't lawful or good, and suffers an effect depending on its alignment.
LN or NG. The target suffers the effect of the confusion spell without making a saving throw. The effect lasts until the end of its next turn. The archon doesn't need to concentrate on the spell.
CG, CN or N. Gain 1 level of exhaustion.
CE, NE, or LE. Gain 1 level of exhaustion and take 5 (1d10) psychic damage and 5 (1d10) radiant damage.

entries: The thug gang boss uses Maneuver Allies, if available. It then makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Great Mace
entries: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: rw 4 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

action.name: Maneuver Allies (Recarga 5)
entries: Up to four allies within 60 feet of this thug gang boss that can hear it can each use their reaction to move up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attack.

reaction.name: Redirect Attack
entries: When a creature the thug gang boss can see targets it with an attack, the thug gang boss chooses an ally within 5 feet of it. The thug gang boss swaps places with the chosen ally, and the chosen ally becomes the target instead.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The thug gang boss moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attack.

legendary.name: Cheap Shot
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The thug gang boss makes a melee or ranged weapon attack.

bonus.name: Battle Command
entries: The thug gang boss one ally it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see or hear the thug gang boss, the target can use its reaction to make one melee attack or to take the Dodge or Hide action.

name: Thunder Serpent Narwa

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the narwa fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The narwa has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magnetism (1/round)
entries: The first time the narwa uses an action, legendary action, or effect that deals lightning damage on a turn, she causes four chunks of terrain within 60 feet of it to rise into the air until the start of its next turn. The raised terrain fills a 10-foot squared by 5-foot deep area. If there are large objects made of metal, like ballistas or pockets of ore, those areas targeted first by this trait.

trait.name: Resonance
entries: The first time an elf, wyverian, creature who can deal psychic damage, or has psionic abilities enters a location 1 mile of the narwa, they must succeed on a DC 25 Intelligence or Wisdom saving throw (target's choice). A creature with psionic abilities makes their save with advantage.

On a successful save, the target resonates with the narwa. When the resonating creature is within 1 mile of the narwa, its eyes glow a yellow color, it can hear the narwa's thoughts. The creature can also sense the narwa's presence and may speak the narwa's thoughts out loud when they are within 600 feet of it. On a failed save, the creature does not resonate with the narwa and is immune to the narwa's Resonance forever.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The narwa deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The narwa uses her Lightning Coil. She then makes two attacks with her bite or one with her tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: mw 11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from the narwa.

action.name: Tail
entries: mw 11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Homing Bolts
entries: rw automatic hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d4 + 6) lightning damage.

action.name: Lightning Coil
entries: The narwa uses one of the following coils:

entries.name: Coil Burst
entries: The narwa unleashes a number of lightning coils in a 60-foot cone in front of her. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Imploding Coil
entries: The narwa releases an already expanded lightning coil that slowly shrinks until it explodes at a point within 120-feet of him. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Triple Coil Slam
entries: The narwa summons three lightning coils that come crashing down in a 15-foot radius around her. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Divine Ire (1/day)
entries: The narwa rises up to 90 feet into the air without provoking opportunity attacks before exhaling lightning in a 30-foot-radius, 90-foot-high cylinder centered directly below her. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Terrain created by its magnetism due to this action remains until the end of its next turn.

On her subsequent turn, if the narwa flies towards the ground as part of its movement, she can use its action to release a lightning bomb that explodes in a 60-foot radius centered on the ground directly below the narwa. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 49 (14d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Divine Light Show (1/round)
entries: The narwa unleashes eight 5-foot wide, 40-foot tall lightning spires each appearing in a space adjacent to the narwa. The spires travel 60 feet in a straight line directly away from narwa. Additionally two 5-foot tall lightning coils (one 5 feet above the ground and another 15 feet above the ground) expand outward from the narwa in a 30-foot radius. Each creature in the spires line, or coils area must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature on raised terrain from the narwa's magnetism automatically succeeds on their saving throw.

legendary.name: Dragon's Corkscrew (1/round)
entries: The narwa moves up to her fly speed in a straight line while spinning. During this move she can move through the spaces of other creatures without provoking opportunity attacks. Each creature the narwa moves through must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone on a failed save, or half as much damage and is pushed 5-feet into an unoccupied space out of the way of the narwa's path (PC choice). If there are no unoccupied spaces available, the creature automatically fails their saving throw.

legendary.name: Thundersac Beam (1/round)
entries: The narwa releases beams of lightning from her belly in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (4d10) lightning damage and be afflicted by thunderblight for 1 minute on a failed save, or half as much damage and isn't afflicted with thunderblight on a successful one.

legendary.name: Lightning Cannon (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The narwa exhales lightning in a 90-foot line that is 5-feet wide. Each creature in that line must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 49 (14d6) lightning damage and be afflicted by thunderblight for 1 minute on a failed save, or half as much damage and isn't afflicted with thunderblight on a successful one.

legendary.name: Spark Blast (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The narwa electrifies the air in a 40-foot long, 20-foot wide area that combusts in a cascade of lightning blasts. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) lightning damage and be stunned until the end of their next turn on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one and isn't stunned.

legendaryHeader: The narwa can take 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The ibushi regains spent legendary actions at the start of her turn.

action.name: Bite

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the thunderblossom remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from ordinary flowering plants.

action.name: Boom Bloom
entries: One of the thunderblossom's blooms explodes with significant concussive force that can be heard up to 150 feet away. Each other creature within 10 feet of the thunderblossom must make a DC 11 Strength saving throw or take 14 (4d6) thunder damage and deafened until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails by 3 or more is also stunned until the end of their next turn. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw takes half damage and is not deafened.

action.name: Thunderous Bellow (Recarga 5)
entries: The thundercall hadrosaur unleashes a ground-shattering bellow in a 120-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 38 (7d10) thunder damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

reaction.name: Sonic Shield
entries: The hadrosaur adds 4 to its AC against one ranged attack that would hit it. To do so, the hadrosaur must see the attacker and not be in an area of magical silence.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Thurl adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Thurl must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Cast Iron Stomach
entries: The thursir has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

trait.name: Alignment
entries: The alignment of an thursir is neutral evil (50%) or lawful evil (50%).

entries: mw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, or 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

bonus.name: Runic Blood (3/Day)
entries: The thursir touches a weapon, painting the thurs rune on the weapon in the thursir's blood. When the thursir hits with the weapon while the rune is active, the weapon deals an extra 9 (2d8) lightning damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of its next turn. The rune lasts for 1 minute.

trait.name: Forged Forgery
entries: Thursir armorers wear armor that has been forged from dwarven armor and shaped to resemble dwarven armor. Skilled blacksmiths can recognize and exploit this design quirk. When a creature proficient with smith's tools scores a critical hit against the thursir armorer, the armorer's armor breaks, reducing the armorer's Armor Class by 5 until the thursir armorer repairs the armor. If the thursir armorer is critically hit by any creature while its armor is broken, its armor shatters and is destroyed, reducing the armorer's Armor Class to 12.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thursir armorer uses Flinging Smash, if available. It then makes two Battleaxe attacks or one Battleaxe attack and one Shield Bash attack.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage, or 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Flinging Smash (Recarga 5)
entries: The armorer makes a sweeping strike with its shield. Each creature within 10 feet of the armorer must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from the armorer and knocked prone.

action.name: Runic Armor (3/Day)
entries: The armorer can inscribe the thurs rune on its armor. When a creature hits the armorer with a melee weapon attack while the rune is active, the creature takes 4 (1d8) lightning damage and can't take reactions until the start of its next turn. The rune lasts for 1 minute.

bonus.name: Harness Dwarven Soul
entries: The thursir armorer draws on the soul fragment trapped in one of the dwarven skulls on its belt. The armorer has advantage on ability checks when using smith's tools and on attack rolls using a battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, or warhammer until the start of its next turn. The armorer carries six skulls on its belt.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The priestess's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Protect the Hearth
entries: When the priestess is hit by a weapon attack, up to two friendly creatures within 60 feet of her that can see her can use their reactions to move up to their speed toward the hearth priestess.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hearth priestess uses Hearth Blessing, then makes two Runic Staff attacks.

action.name: Runic Staff
entries: mw 5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and 4 (1d8) fire damage.

action.name: Hearth Blessing
entries: The hearth priestess calls upon her deity and connection with the hearth to enhance her allies. The priestess empowers one friendly creature she can see within 30 feet of her with one of the following options until the start of her next turn.

entries.name: Hearth's Burn.
entries: The target's weapon ignites, and when the target hits with the weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire damage.

entries.name: Hearth's Comfort.
entries: If the target is charmed or frightened, the condition immediately ends. In addition, the target gains 5 (1d10) temporary hp.

entries.name: Hearth's Protection.
entries: The target's Armor Class increases by 2, and its armor is immune to spells and effects that target or affect the armor, such as the heat metal spell or a rust monster antennae.

entries: Flame-like radiance descends on one creature Thurstwell can see within 60 feet of him. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 4 (1d8) radiant damage, gaining no benefit from cover.

name: Tiamat

trait.name: Discorporation
entries: When Tiamat drops to 0 hit points or dies, her body is destroyed but her essence travels back to her domain in the Nine Hells, and she is unable to take physical form for a time.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Tiamat fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: Unless she wishes to be affected, Tiamat is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. She has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Tiamat's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: Tiamat can take one reaction per turn, rather than only one per round. She also has advantage on saving throws against being knocked unconscious. If she fails a saving throw against an effect that would stun a creature, one of her unspent legendary actions is spent.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Tiamat regains 30 hit points at the start of her turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tiamat can use her Frightful Presence. She then makes three attacks: two with her claws and one with her tail.

action.name: Claw
entries: mw 19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: mw 19 to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) piercing damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of Tiamat's choice that is within 240 feet of Tiamat and aware of her must succeed on a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Tiamat's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Bite
entries: mw 19 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage (black dragon head), lightning damage (blue dragon head), poison damage (green dragon head), fire damage (red dragon head), or cold damage (white dragon head).

legendary.name: Black Dragon Head: Acid Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Tiamat breathes acid in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 67 (15d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Blue Dragon Head: Lightning Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Tiamat breathes lightning in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 88 (16d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Green Dragon Head: Poison Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Tiamat breathes poisonous gas in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 27 Constitution saving throw, taking 77 (22d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Red Dragon Head: Fire Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Tiamat breathes fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 91 (26d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: White Dragon Head: Cold Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Tiamat breathes an icy blast in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 72 (16d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Tiamat regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn. Tiamat's legendary action options are associated with her five dragon heads (a bite and a breath weapon for each). Once Tiamat chooses a legendary action option for one of her heads, she can't choose another one associated with that head until the start of her next turn.

The net has no effect on creatures that are formless, or creatures that are Huge or larger. A creature can use its action to make a DC 15 Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Dealing 15 slashing damage to the net (AC 13) also frees the creature without harming it, ending the effect and destroying the net.
